episodes.overview: After the All Stars perform a finale number and reconvene with the eliminated queens, India Ferrah and Alexis Mateo make peace, and the Top Three queens prepare for their final lip sync.

episodes.name: All Star Variety Extravaganza
episodes.overview: Back in the Werkroom, after a glittering All Stars Variety Show, the queens reunite for the first time to untuck and spill the T. They anticipate the upcoming season which promises to be legendary, right out of the gate!

episodes.name: The Blue Ball
episodes.overview: After the first elimination the pressure is already on, the queens untuck and kiki about which All Star was the belle of the Ball and who dropped the ball altogether. They discuss voting strategies, and a friendship is put to the ultimate test!

episodes.name: Side Hustles
episodes.overview: The All Stars untuck and open up about the toughest elimination yet. Two past season sisters confront an old grudge, can they reinvest in a future of renewed drag sisterhood?

episodes.name: Halftime Headliners
episodes.overview: After an All Star studded stadium halftime show, the queens untuck and dish on their experiences from celebrities to go-go boys. Everyone slayed in the spotlight, but despite the lovefest, one queen must still sashay away.

episodes.name: Pink Table Talk
episodes.overview: The All Stars can make opposing patterns mesh, but it doesn’t mean their personalities will mesh too. The voting process has tensions flaring and certain queens struggle to cool down and get out of their heads, but the Tea just keeps flowing.

episodes.name: Ru-Merican Horror Story: Coven Girl
episodes.overview: RuPaul’s Drag Race All Stars: Untucked! is the access-all-areas pass to the drama that you didn’t see on the runway. See what happens behind the scenes when the queens let their tucks breathe… and let their emotions flow.

episodes.name: Show Up Queen
episodes.overview: Our All Stars untuck to spill the Tea, honey, about their personal connection to the legendary RuPaul herself. They gag over how Ru has affected their lives in and out of the werkroom. The Tea is spilled and the shenanigans are brought.

episodes.name: Snatch Game of Love
episodes.overview: The All Stars untuck, kiki and sip some well-deserved bubbly to celebrate the Pop Art of it all. As the competition narrows, jaws are dropped and dream bubbles get popped.

episodes.name: Drag Tots
episodes.overview: After tooning out in the Drag Tots challenge, the final 5 queens are spilling all the hot Tea. When Ru makes the rules you never know what you're gonna get except for twisted. So don't get caught without your wig on!

episodes.name: Rudemption Lip-Sync Smackdown
episodes.overview: The Big Ruveal has the All Stars Queens gagging on a twist none of them saw coming, but there's still time for final tête-à-têtes in the spirit of All Stars Drag sisterhood.

episodes.name: The Charisma, Uniqueness, Nerve and Talent Monologues
episodes.overview: One All Star proved herself by fighting her way back into the competition, but can she Shantay and stay? Heading into the battle of a Fierce Final Four means it's time to untuck and leave it all on the runway.

episodes.name: This is Our Country
episodes.overview: The Final Four All Stars reflect upon their growth. It's time for all but one legendary All Star to untuck and pack it all up in this Untucked finale.

episodes.name: Legends
episodes.overview: Backstage after their first performance and runway, 8 competing champions speculate about how new rules and potential alliances may may affect the season ahead. Guest Judge and Superfan Cameron Diaz visits the werkroom to kiki with the queens.

episodes.name: Snatch Game
episodes.overview: After an epic Snatch Game, the queens are wondering who's on top, and who's getting blocked? Plus, a rousing game of "Kiki, Kai Kai, Marry" reveals some surprises about how the Queens really feel about each other. Guest Judge and fashion icon Daphne Guiness pops by to share some of her own style secrets.

episodes.name: The Realness of Fortune Ball
episodes.overview: As the Queens gush about each others' gorgeous ball looks and kiki about whose drag they would mop, the conversation takes an emotional turn. Guest Judge Kirby Baptiste-Howell talks fashion and gardening during her visit to the werkroom and scores herself an invite to the Drag Queen BBQ.

episodes.name: Fairytale Justice
episodes.overview: One queen is riding high after this week's challenge, but another gets salty when the group agrees that she'll be the next to get blocked; guest Judge Jeffrey Bowyer-Chapman visits and shares how Drag Race has affected the entire world.

episodes.name: Dragulation Speeches
episodes.overview: After their Draguation Speeches, the Queens share how their high school experiences shaped who they are today; a twist in the rules has everyone speculating how things will play out; Guest Judge Nikki Glaser joins the queens for a chat about passion.

episodes.name: Total Ru-quest Live
episodes.overview: The Queens reflect on their runway and share how Dolly Parton has inspired them. One queen's frustrations lead to an very stress relief moment for all the girls. And, just before the lip sync, two queens share a heartfelt moment, while another has an epiphany. Plus, Guest Judge Tove Lo talks to the queens about songwriting and style.

episodes.name: Legendary Legend Looks
episodes.overview: The competition heats up as the Queens realize that everyone is a threat, and this is still anyone's game. Legendary Guest Judge Betsey Johnson brings her quirky energy to the werkroom, shares stories of her epic life and offers insight about how to make it as an artist.

episodes.name: Santa's School for Girls
episodes.overview: The Queens cool off after the hottest runway yet. Following the acting challenge, the performances continue in the werkroom with the Queens serving up spot-on impressions of Queens from past seasons - and each other!

episodes.name: Dance Like Drag Queen
episodes.overview: As the end of the competition draws near, the Queens reminisce about the Queens they have blocked. Guest Judge Ben Platt stops by, the queens grill him about his nail polish, his boyfriend and his own possible drag future.

episodes.name: The Kennedy Davenport Center Honors Hall of Shade
episodes.overview: After an illuminating runway, a surprise guest awaits the Queens in the werkroom. Then, Guest Judge Ronan Farrow visits to ask some probing questions, and then the queens ask a few of their own. And finally, a game of "Two Truths and a Lie" uncovers a juicy secret that has everyone gooped!

episodes.name: Drag Race Gives Back Variety Extravaganza
episodes.overview: The penultimate episode has the Queens gagging over their variety show performances. Guest Judge Hannah Einbinder fangirls over the ladies - and the feeling is mutual. And, things get turnt when the girls play "Tower of Truth" and some piping hot tea is spilled!

episodes.name: Lip Sync LaLaPaRuza
episodes.overview: After an emotional moment with Ru on the main stage, the Queens head to the werkroom to get ready for the LaLaparuza Lip-Sync Smackdown for the Crown; the stakes couldn't be higher, as the Queens watch each other battle for big money.

episodes.name: The Fame Games
episodes.overview: After an emotional deliberation and a visit from guest judge Indina Menzel, the Queens realize that sending their competitors home is harder than expected.

episodes.name: It's RDR Live!
episodes.overview: In their second deliberation of the season, the All Stars discuss whether personal relationships or track record matter most when determining who goes home. And, the Fame Games kick off, featuring the runway looks of eliminated queens.

episodes.name: The Supermarket Ball
episodes.overview: After the Supermarket Ball, the Queens are in their feelings, and one contemplates a drastic decision. Guest judge and pop star Jojo Siwa kikis with the Queens about the importance of being yourself.

episodes.name: Screen Queens
episodes.overview: This week, the Queens are judged as a group, which has Queens pointing fingers and scrambling to save themselves. Guest judge Maude Apatow visits the Werk Room to fangirl over the All Stars.

episodes.name: Snatch Game of Love
episodes.overview: After a shocking turn of events, the Queens are left wondering how it will affect the game. Guest Judges Bowen Yang and Matt Rogers visit the Werk Room and share what Drag Race means to them.

episodes.name: JOAN: The Unauthorized Rusical!
episodes.overview: Deliberations continue to get more difficult as the Queens struggle to decide who should get the chop. Guest Judge Adam Shankman visits the Queens to celebrate the success of the Rusical challenge.

episodes.name: Forensic Queens
episodes.overview: After an emotional week, one of the Queens finds herself in the bottom again, while another tries to win favor with her fellow All Stars. Guest Judge and actress Javicia Leslie visits the Werk Room.

episodes.name: You’re a Winner Baby!
episodes.overview: As one All Star reconsiders a promise she made, the remaining contestants fight to keep their spot in the competition. Guest judge and Incubus frontman Brandon Boyd pops into the Werk Room.

episodes.name: Carson Kressley, This is Your Gay Life
episodes.overview: The All Stars are excited to receive words of encouragement from loved ones back home, but with so few queens left, figuring out who to eliminate is intense. Will one queen’s strategy to stay in the game pay off?

episodes.name: The Letter “L”
episodes.overview: After the makeover challenge, the Queens reflect on their amazing experiences with their new lesbian sisters. And Guest Judge Zooey Deschanel visits to talk nerves with the All Stars.

episodes.name: The Fame Games Variety Extravaganza
episodes.overview: While the finalists jockey for the crown, the competition revs up for the returning queens vying for the title, “Queen of the Fame Games!” Plus, Guest Judge Ego Nwodim visits with the Queens.

episodes.name: Grand Finale
episodes.overview: The Queens of All Stars 8 celebrate a gagworthy season. The Top Queens prepare for one ,final performance, and everyone wonders who will be the next Queen to be inducted into the Drag Race Hall of Fame!

episodes.name: Drag Queens Save The World
episodes.overview: The Queens are excited to raise money for their charities and showcase their talents on the mainstage! They speculate about who'll win the first Benefactress Badges of the season, and who'll get cut off. Guest Judge Keke Palmer pops in for a kiki!

episodes.name: The Paint Ball
episodes.overview: As the All Stars gag over each other's Paint Ball looks, they reflect on their walk-throughs with RuPaul. The Queens keep the arty party going with a raucous game of "Win, Lose or Bra." Guest Judge Stephanie Hsu visits.

episodes.name: Snatch Game of Love
episodes.overview: After The Snatch Game of Love, the Queens are gooped thinking about how this week's twist could impact the game - and their sisterhood. Guest Judge Anitta shows up to turn the party.

episodes.name: Smokin' Hot Firefighter Makeover
episodes.overview: After the makeovers, the Queens kiki with their hunky firemen. Guest Judges John & T.J. Osborne visit, and T.J. discuss the struggle of being gay in country music. And as a bonus, Firefighter Bradley shares his own extra-special party skills.

episodes.name: Property Queens
episodes.overview: As the All Stars struggle with the stress of the competition, Guest Judge Alec Mapa drops by to boost their spirits. Later, the Queens kiki and serve up impressions of past Ru girls and each other - until one cuts too close to home.

episodes.name: The National Drag Convention Roast
episodes.overview: After a surprise visit with Bob the Drag Queen, the All Stars get serious and discuss how they plan to use their platforms politically. Then, when Guest Judge Ruta Lee joins the queens, things get genuinely emotional and heartfelt.

episodes.name: Meeting In The Ladies Room
episodes.overview: After the Queens rave about acting opposite Mama Ru, one All Star uses her math skills to avoid getting snipped! Guest Judge Colton Haynes visits the Untucked Lounge, and a message from Drag Race Royalty brings one Queen to tears.

episodes.name: Make Your Own Kind Of Rusic
episodes.overview: After weeks of feeling out of sorts, one Queen opens up to her sisters. An emotional message from home gets the All Stars talking about their love lives. And guest judge Jeremy Scott dazzles in the Untucked Lounge.

episodes.name: Rosemarie's Baby Shower: The Rusical
episodes.overview: The All Stars praise each other for their sickening Rusical performances. Messages from home lead one Queen to discuss her journey of family acceptance. Guest Judge Kristine W, stops by and serenades the All Stars.

episodes.name: Lip Sync LaLaPaRuza Smackdown
episodes.overview: Two Queens prepare for their final battle in the Lip Sync Lalaparuza Smackdown. After they leave it all on the stage, the All Stars celebrate the winner and anticipate the final push towards the finale.

episodes.name: Grand Finale Variety Extravaganza: Part 1
episodes.overview: On an extra-special episode, crew members-turned-queens kiki in the Untucked Lounge. They dish about working on the show, and share what they really think of the queens! Ts Madison pops by to find out more.

episodes.name: Grand Finale Variety Extravaganza: Part 2
episodes.overview: After their final Runway, Guest Judge Connie Britton visits the Untucked Lounge. But as the Queens prepare to meet their fates on the main stage, uncertainty looms. Tonight, any of these Queens could make the Top Three and take home the Crown!

episodes.name: Winner Winner, Chicken Dinner
episodes.overview: The Bracket 1 Queens storm the Untucked Lounge for the first time in the Tournament of All Stars to dissect the points twist, which seriously affects how they play the game. Guest judge Ice Spice gags for the Queens’ looks.

episodes.name: Murder on the Dance Floor
episodes.overview: This week, the All Stars need more than a crystal ball to predict how many points they’ll have at the end of the night. Alliances crumble as the Queens wonder how they will make it to the semi-finals. Guest judge Colman Domingo helps the Queens loosen up.

episodes.name: Hoop Queens Makeovers
episodes.overview: Tensions peak as the Bracket 1 Queens face their final judgment before the semi-finals! The Lady Ballers join for a kiki and guest judge Kate Beckinsale brings Hollywood glamour to the Untucked lounge.

episodes.name: Eight Ball
episodes.overview: The Bracket 2 Queens stir the pot in the Untucked Lounge. As playful tension starts to brew, it's clear these girls aren't here for kumbaya... And one Queen's bottom placement pushes her to start playing strategically.

episodes.name: Rappin' Roast
episodes.overview: An emotional reveal on the main stage strikes a chord between two Queens. But as sisterhood blooms, another Queen presents a controversial proposal that could tear it apart. Guest judge Chappell Roan cements her icon status with the girls.

episodes.name: Starrbooty: The Rebooty
episodes.overview: The Bracket 2 Queens strategize right up until the final moments on the main stage. Despite some rocky moments, they agree that returning to All Stars was truly special. After a shocking twist, the semi-finalists celebrate.

episodes.name: Wicked Good
episodes.overview: The Bracket 3 Queens are feeling confident in the aftermath of the design challenge, while new friendships are forming in the Untucked Lounge. The wicked-fabulous Guest Judges Ariana Grande and Cynthia Erivo surprise the Queens with a sweet treat!

episodes.name: Stagecooch
episodes.overview: The Queens are feeling their Miley Cyrus looks. After a day of discussing points, gameplay is on everyone's minds - and one Queen worries that her sisters are not behind her. Another Queen's bold proclamation may have backed her into a corner.

episodes.name: The Golden Bitchelor
episodes.overview: The All Stars of Bracket 3 untuck one last time. Emotions run high as they wonder who will win this week's Maxi Challenge, how queens will award their final MVQ Points, and who will move on to the Semi-Finals.

episodes.name: Tournament of All Stars Snatch Game
episodes.overview: Before the first elimination, the Semi-Finalists face the heat in the Untucked Lounge. One Queen's gameplaying backfires, while guest judge Sarah Michelle Gellar's visit leaves everyone gagged.

episodes.name: Tournament of All Stars Talent Invitational
episodes.overview: With the Talent Show behind them, the Queens argue over who is in danger this week - and one Queen reflects on her emotional journey, as the final elimination looms.

episodes.name: Tournament of All Stars Smackdown for the Crown
episodes.overview: Excitement and nerves fill the werkroom as the Queens prep for the Lip Sync Smackdown for the Crown. After each elimination, the Queens dish and kiki as they wait to see who will take home the Crown.

shows.name: RuPaul's Drag Race UK
shows.overview: RuPaul has made the trip across the pond in search of a queen with the most charisma, uniqueness, nerve and talent in all the land.

episodes.name: Meet the Queens: Series 1
episodes.overview: Mama Ru has made the trip across the pond in search for a queen with the most charisma, uniqueness, nerve and talent in all the land. Here are our RuPaul's Drag Race UK queens!

episodes.name: It's a Wrap!
episodes.overview: Witness the reactions of the finalists of RuPaul's Drag Race UK as they watch the final episode for the very first time, awaiting the big Ru-veal.

episodes.name: Meet the Queens: Series 2
episodes.overview: Ahead of the long-awaited second series, Mama Ru introduces the 12 fabulous new queens competing for the title of the UK’s next Drag Race superstar.

episodes.name: Queens on Lockdown
episodes.overview: A look into the lockdown lives of the queens of RuPaul's Drag Race UK when they were sent home for a seven-month break in filming due to the Covid-19 pandemic.

episodes.name: Meet the Queens: Series 3
episodes.overview: Ahead of RuPaul’s Drag Race UK series 3, it’s time to Meet the Queens! In this special preview, RuPaul introduces the hotly anticipated twelve new queens due to compete for the coveted title of The UK’s Next Drag Race Superstar. Snatch a glimpse of their charisma, beauty and varied skill sets as they share their dreams, ambitions and fears for the forthcoming competition. Place your bets now and may the best Drag Queen win!

episodes.name: Meet the Queens: Series 4
episodes.overview: Ahead of the return of the next series of RuPaul’s Drag Race UK Series 4, get ready to meet the queens! RuPaul unleashes a brand new cast, introducing 12 fabulous new queens ready to compete for the title of the UK’s next Drag Race superstar.  Here the queens flash their uniqueness, charisma, nerve and talent for all to see as they share their hopes - and fears - about what the competition may have in store. May the best Drag Queen win!

episodes.name: Meet the Queens: Series 5
episodes.overview: RuPaul presents the new queens competing to be the UK’s next Drag Race superstar.

seasons.name: Series 1
seasons.overview: RuPaul brings the award-winning global phenomenon to the UK for the first time. Ten of the country’s most fabulous drag queens will compete in the Olympics of drag in the hope that RuPaul, queen of queens, will crown them as the UK’s first Drag Race Superstar.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Ten of the UK's most fabulous drag queens will compete in the Olympics of drag in the hope that RuPaul, queen of queens, will crown them as the UK’s first Drag Race superstar.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: The queens' acting skills are put to the test as they star in a sumptuous new comedy costume drama – Downton Draggy.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: This week RuPaul tests the queens’ sewing skills and fashion sense as they are challenged to create show stopping outfits from junk found at a car boot sale.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: This week the queens take on the iconic Snatch Game challenge where they must deliver their best celebrity impersonations against a classic TV game show backdrop.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: The remaining queens are split into two teams for a girl group battle.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: This week the queens’ creative marketing skills are put to the test as they are asked to create an advert and brand themselves.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Only four queens remain. Tensions are high and emotions are charged as they are challenged to give family members a very special drag makeover.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Strictly Come Dancing’s AJ Pritchard and his brother Curtis choreograph the three queens as they take on an all-singing, all-dancing final challenge.

seasons.name: Series 2
seasons.overview: The award winning RuPaul’s Drag Race UK returns for a second series. Over the course of ten weeks twelve of the country’s most fabulous drag queens will compete to be crowned the UK’s Next Drag Race Superstar.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: The queens enter the werk room for the first time and quickly take on their first challenge – a photo shoot with Ru. Then, in an added twist, the queens are asked to serve two looks on the Drag Race runway. Actress and fashion icon Elizabeth Hurley joins Michelle Visage and Graham Norton on the judging panel as the first queen sashays away from the competition.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: RuPaul’s search for the UK’s next Drag Race superstar continues. The queens are settling in, but the pressure is on as their singing, acting and dancing skills are truly challenged in Rats – The Rusical, Drag Race’s first ever live musical. West End star Sheridan Smith joins Michelle Visage and Alan Carr on the judging panel as another queen exits the competition.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: The search for the UK's Next Drag Race Superstar continues. This week RuPaul tests the queens' creative sewing skills – and their friendships – as they're pitted against each other in a design challenge called Who Wore it Best? Supermodel Jourdan Dunn joins Michelle Visage and Graham Norton as a third queen leaves the competition.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: RuPaul’s search for the UK’s next Drag Race superstar continues. This week, the queens’ presenting skills are challenged as they host their own daytime magazine show, Morning Glory. The queen of British daytime TV, Lorraine Kelly, joins Michelle Visage and Alan Carr on the judging panel as a fourth queen exits the competition.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: RuPaul and the queens return from their lockdown hiatus and the search for the UK’s Next Drag Race Superstar resumes. With the queens reunited and added twists, there is much excitement in the air, but the competition picks up quickly as the queens form two groups for a Europop battle – The RuRuvision Song Contest. In a glorious homage to Eurovision, the queens record and perform the same catchy song, but can they swerve the dreaded nul points?! MNEK joins Michelle Visage and Graham Norton on the judging panel as a fifth queen sashays away from the competition.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: This week the queens showcase their best celebrity impressions and improv skills, as they take on the iconic Snatch Game. Gemma Collins plays along too, but can the queens match her blankety blank? On the judging panel singer Jessie Ware joins Michelle Visage and Alan Carr as another queen sashays away...

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: This week, RuPaul challenges the queens to create show-stopping superhero outfits. US Drag Race star Raven pops in for moral support, and TV presenter Maya Jama joins Michelle Visage and Graham Norton on the judging panel, as Ru decides which queens should lip sync for their lives.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: This week the queens face one of their toughest challenge, yet as they are asked to write and perform their own comedy stand up routines. Comedy legend Dawn French joins Michelle Visage and Alan Carr on the judging panel as another queen takes her leave.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: This week the queens’ acting skills are put to the test as they star in a new soap opera BeastEnders. To help them with their roles, EastEnders legend Natalie Cassidy, aka Sonia, gives the girls a soap acting masterclass whilst Michelle Visage and Graham Norton and an extra special guest judge join RuPaul to deliberate the fate of the remaining queens.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: It’s the Finale! The competition concludes in an all singing all dancing extravaganza fight for the crown. Choreographer Jay Revell coaches the queens through their intense final challenge, and Michelle Visage, Alan Carr, Graham Norton and all of the eliminated queens return to witness who RuPaul awards the coveted title of UK’s Next Drag Race Superstar.

seasons.name: Series 3
seasons.overview: The multi award winning RuPaul’s Drag Race UK is back for series 3! Over the course of ten weeks twelve fabulous drag queens will compete to be crowned The UK’s Next Drag Race Superstar.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: In this opening episode, Judge Supremo, RuPaul ushers a brand new set of queens into the werk room, sets them their first cheeky challenge, and asks the queens to take to the runway to serve not one, but two looks. Comedy legend Matt Lucas joins Michelle Visage and Graham Norton on the judging panel.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: RuPaul’s search for the UK’s Next Drag Race Superstar continues. The queens are settling in, but the pressure is on as their werk out skills are put to the test in the high energy dance challenge. Two-time Strictly champion Oti Mabuse puts the queens through their paces for the dance performance. Later, Oti joins Michelle Visage and Alan Carr on the judging panel.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: The search for the UK’s Next Drag Race Superstar continues. The queens camp it up as RuPaul tests their sewing skills – in a Great Outdoors themed design challenge. US Drag Race All Star Raven is on hand to offer the queens makeup advice while Bridgerton’s Nicola Coughlan joins Michelle Visage and Graham Norton on the panel as a third queen leaves the competition.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: The search for the UK’s Next Drag Race Superstar steps up with the return of the now iconic Girl Group challenge. With on hand support from pop superstars Steps, the queens split into two groups to record and perform a brand new single. Spice Girls legend Emma Bunton joins Michelle Visage and Alan Carr on the judging panel.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: RuPaul’s search for the UK’s first Drag Race Superstar continues. This week the queens’ marketing skills are put to the test as they produce adverts for a brand new in-home smart assistant - Draglexa. Little Mix star Leigh-Anne Pinnock joins Michelle Visage and Alan Carr on the judging panel as another queen exits the competition.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: The search for the UK’s Next Drag Race Superstar continues. This week the queens showcase their best celebrity impressions as they take on the ultimate comedy improv challenge - the Snatch Game. Loose Woman Judi Love and pop icon Nadine Coyle join in the fun.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: In a Drag Race first, Ru tests the queens’ showstopping stamina as they are challenged to serve three separate looks on the runway - all against the clock. The pressure is on, but thankfully fashion icon and internet sensation Charity Shop Sue is on hand to share her extensive fashion retail experience.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: This week the queens’ over acting skills are put to the test as they star in a new sci-fi blockbuster: Bra Wars - The Fempire Claps Back. Actor, Russell Tovey joins RuPaul as his extra special guest judge, alongside Michelle Visage and Graham Norton as the queens once again fight for their survival.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: It’s the Semi Finals! The remaining queens take to the mic, writing their own material for a stand up comedy challenge that sees them roasting the most challenging of victims - themselves. Comedy legend Kathy Burke joins RuPaul as his extra special guest judge alongside, Michelle Visage and Alan Carr as another queen is asked to sashay away.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: It’s the grand finale, and a Christmas wish is about to come true for one lucky queen, as the search to find the UK’s Next Drag Race superstar concludes with a festive fight for the crown. Choreographer Jay Revell returns to coach the finalists through their all singing, all dancing final challenge, while Michelle Visage, Alan Carr, Graham Norton are on hand as RuPaul chooses his winner and awards the coveted title of UK’s Next Drag Race Superstar.

seasons.name: Series 4
seasons.overview: RuPaul presides as twelve queens compete to be crowned the next Drag Race UK superstar.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Twelve fabulous new drag queens enter the werk room for the first time. Dame Joanna Lumley joins Michelle Visage and Graham Norton as RuPaul determines which queen is the first to go.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Girl Group week comes early! FKA twigs joins Ru, Michelle Visage and Graham Norton on the panel, and Cathy Dennis pops by to share her song writing wisdom.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Supermodel Leomie Anderson joins Michelle Visage and Alan Carr on the judging panel as the queens tackle a bingo-themed design challenge.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: The queens’ improv skills are tested as they star on Alan Carr’s chat show Catty Man. Queen of daytime TV Alison Hammond guest judges.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: It’s Rusical week! Star of stage and screen Hannah Waddingham joins Michelle Visage and Alan Carr on the judging panel as the curtain falls on another queen.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Strictly stars Tess Daly and AJ Odudu play the iconic Snatch Game, while Spice Girl Mel B joins RuPaul as his extra special guest judge alongside Michelle Visage and Alan Carr.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: It’s the return of the much-loved makeover challenge as the queens share the art of drag with six very special makeover subjects. Boy George and US Drag Race star Raven join the fun.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: The queens’ acting skills are tested as they star in a murderous twist on a reality TV classic. Celebrity chef Lorraine Pascale guest-judges alongside Michelle Visage and Alan Carr.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: The queens' stand-up skills are tested as they campaign for a place in the grand finale. Comedy star Aisling Bea and actor and singer Olly Alexander guest-star.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: It’s the grand finale! Michelle Visage, Alan Carr, Graham Norton and the eliminated queens are all on hand as RuPaul crowns the UK’s next Drag Race superstar.

seasons.name: Series 5
seasons.overview: A brand spanking new series of RuPaul’s Drag Race UK returns! Over the next ten weeks, a cast of fabulous new drag queens will compete for RuPaul’s seal of approval and the much coveted title of UK’s Next Drag Race Superstar.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: A new cast of queens enter the workroom and RuPaul sets their first surprise challenge. Supermodel Kristen McMenamy, Michelle Visage and Alan Carr join Ru on the judging panel.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Editor of British Vogue Edward Enninful and Heartstopper star Yasmin Finney drop by to help RuPaul as the queens showcase their creative skill and style in the design challenge.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: The queens take on a 90s rave banger for the girl group challenge. Pop legend Sophie Ellis-Bextor joins RuPaul, Michelle Visage and Graham Norton on the judging panel.

episodes.overview: It's the semi-final! In a Gladiators-themed roast, our ru-maining contenders step into the ring and wrestle for a place in the finale. Comedian Aisling Bea joins as guest judge.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: It’s the grand finale! Michelle Visage, Alan Carr, Graham Norton and the eliminated queens all return to bear witness as RuPaul crowns the UK’s next Drag Race Superstar.

seasons.overview: Mama Ru is back with a hot new cast of rambunctious drag queens ready to do battle for the crown! Over the next ten weeks, the queens compete in a range of spicy challenges designed to test their drag mettle as they bid for the coveted title of the UK’s Next Drag Race Superstar.

episodes.overview: It’s Rusical week! Pop diva and West End star Beverley Knight joins Mama Ru, Michelle Visage, and Graham Norton on the judging panel as the curtain comes down on yet another queen.

episodes.overview: The queens are tasked with giving drag makeovers to some extra special subjects - their own family members. AJ Odudu joins RuPaul on the judging panel.

episodes.overview: It's the semi-finals! Derry Girls' Siobhan McSweeney joins Ru as he asks the queens to show off their best stand-up skills in a roast challenge to secure a place in the finale.

episodes.name: Grand Finale
episodes.overview: It’s the grand finale! Michelle Visage, Alan Carr, Graham Norton and the eliminated queens are all on hand as RuPaul crowns the UK’s next Drag Race superstar.

episodes.overview: It's the semi-finals! BAFTA winner Sophie Willan joins RuPaul as the queens to show off their best stand-up skills in a roast challenge to secure a place in the finale.

episodes.name: Sing for the Crown
episodes.overview: It’s the grand finale! Michelle Visage, Alan Carr, Graham Norton and the eliminated queens are all on hand as RuPaul crowns the UK’s Next Drag Race Superstar.
