episodes.name: Glitter Ball
episodes.overview: There is fallout in the lounge after one queen accuses another of "sailing" through the race.

episodes.name: Sissy That Walk
episodes.overview: Following their final challenge, the queens head to the Untucked lounge one last time.

seasons.name: Season 6
seasons.overview: An access-all-areas pass to the drama that you didn't see on the runway of the seventh season of RuPaul's Drag Race.

episodes.name: Born Naked
episodes.overview: The Untucked Season Premiere takes us backstage as the queens face their worst fear: a naked runway! Tensions run high as their interpretations of the challenge are questioned.

episodes.name: Glamazionian Airways
episodes.overview: Behind-the-scenes, drama ensues, as the queens defend their Glamazonian Airways safety videos. The claws come out when they attack each other’s style.

episodes.name: ShakesQueer
episodes.overview: Behind-the-scenes, things get hairy as the queens throw shade and blame on a Shakespearean level.

episodes.name: Spoof! (There It Is)
episodes.overview: Behind-the-scenes, bonds are forming, and the queens face lip-synching against their friends when their parody music videos hit a flat note.

episodes.name: The Despy Awards
episodes.overview: Behind-the-scenes, tempers boil and personalities clash after the queens' comedy skills are put to the test as awards show presenters. A message from home for one of the queens takes everyone on an emotional ride.

episodes.name: Ru Hollywood Stories
episodes.overview: Behind-the-scenes, the tension is deadly after the queens’ Ru Hollywood Stories re-enactment challenge.

episodes.name: The Snatch Game
episodes.overview: Behind-the-scenes, drama unfolds as the queens discuss who hit the mark and who fell short with their celebrity impersonations.

episodes.name: Conjoined Twins
episodes.overview: Behind-the-scenes, the conjoined twins get torn apart. Things get intense as one eliminated queen hopes she’s done enough to re-enter the competition.

episodes.name: Divine Inspiration
episodes.overview: Behind-the-scenes, things get ugly as friendships are put to the test and rivalries are heightened. The queens need some Divine intervention.

episodes.name: Prancing Queens
episodes.overview: Behind-the-scenes, the queens tell the “T" about being homesick. A queen gets a surprise message from a RuPaul’s Drag Race alumnus.

episodes.name: Hello, Kitty Girls!
episodes.overview: Behind-the-scenes, the queens dish about their struggles with the challenges and the judges. With only five queens remaining, the eliminations are getting emotional.

episodes.name: And the Rest Is Drag
episodes.overview: Behind-the-scenes, tempers flare, as the competition to be America’s Next Drag Superstar narrows. The queens are set to boil as they battle for a position in the top three.

seasons.name: Season 7
seasons.overview: An access-all-areas pass to the drama that you didn't see on the runway of the eighth season of RuPaul's Drag Race.

episodes.name: Keeping It 100!
episodes.overview: The 100th episode of RuPaul's Drag Race is already off to a shady start! The Queens get to know each other and talk about who's on top and who's on bottom and have a runway critique all their own. Alliances develop, but tempers start to flare as the queens talk about their runway looks.

episodes.name: Bitch Perfect
episodes.overview: After a Bitch Perfect musical extravaganza, the queens untuck backstage and the bitching really begins. As the queens discuss each other's runway looks and how the judges are living for Kim Chi and Acid Betty's looks, Bob proclaims black is the new nude. It becomes all about the suspect padding of Dax's posterior and Ru seems to have double vision.

episodes.name: RuCo’s Empire
episodes.overview: After the queens roll their way through an Empire of a challenge, they untuck backstage and Naysha is established as the second queen in herstory to come back and stay. Chi Chi gets spicy and has the other queens rolling with her southern charm, y'all. Cynthia gets a short fashion lesson from the other queens and Kim Chi gets a special message from a living doll back at home.

episodes.name: New Wave Queens
episodes.overview: The queens untuck after a new wave battle of the bands. Backstage it’s a punk girl, new wave chick square off as the queens butt heads over their looks and performances. One of our queens breaks down after she gets a message from home and it gives the other queens an emotional look into her life.

episodes.name: Supermodel Snatch Game
episodes.overview: The queens kiki backstage about what the judges thought of their Snatch Game characters and Madonna runway looks. One queen’s sister sends a message of support from back home and another queen gets fashion silhouette advice. Chanel Iman and Gigi Hadid cause a commotion when they pay the queens a backstage visit.

episodes.name: Wizards of Drag
episodes.overview: After strutting down the yellow brick road, the queens untuck and the broomsticks come out. Two queens dive into a stitches verses hot glue shade throwing standoff. The queens' Little Women join them and bring along some big opinions. Honey, we are not in Kansas anymore.

episodes.name: Shady Politics
episodes.overview: The queens untuck backstage waiting for the votes to be tallied on their presidential campaigns. The shade becomes very political as they discuss the judge’s critiques and see everything isn’t always black and white.

episodes.name: RuPaul Book Ball
episodes.overview: After a triple runway at RuPaul’s Book Ball, the queens untuck and read each other cover to cover. One of our queens is shaken after her cardboard cutouts fail to impress the judges, and the other queens are not shy about giving her some "friendly" advice.

episodes.name: The Realness
episodes.overview: After the last chance runway, it's final four time in the Untucked Lounge. The queens critique one another's final speeches to the judges and one queen gets a herstory lesson. But do they all believe the most deserving queens made it to the top four?

seasons.name: Season 8
seasons.overview: An access-all-areas pass to the drama that you didn't see on the runway of the ninth season of RuPaul's Drag Race.

episodes.name: Oh. My. Gaga!
episodes.overview: RuPaul's Drag Race is off to a stellar start! It's a love fest as the queens get to know each other and talk about their runway looks. Before heading back to the main stage, the queens get a backstage visit that leaves them gagged.

episodes.name: She Done Already Done Brought It On
episodes.overview: After cheering each other through possibly the most physical challenge in Drag Race herstory, the queens untuck and discuss the judge’s opinions of their looks and performances. The reality of who’s on top and who’s on bottom settles in because for the first time this season, someone will sashay away.

episodes.name: Draggily Ever After
episodes.overview: After a fairytale runway fit for a princess, the Queens untuck backstage and ki-ki about who they’d “kai-kai” with. One queen who thinks her happily ever after will be in the top is thrown when being in the bottom becomes a reality.

episodes.name: Good Morning Bitches
episodes.overview: After the queens get naughty on the runway, they settle in backstage. The safe Queens spill the T on their looks and talk about whose runway didn’t impress. When the other queens join, things backstage start getting shady.

episodes.name: Reality Stars: The Musical
episodes.overview: After the queens pay tribute to America’s favorite family, The Kardashians, in a musical extravaganza, they untuck backstage. One accuses the others of sabotage as the bottom queens prepare to lip-sync.

episodes.name: Snatch Game.
episodes.overview: The queens settle in after a star-studded snatch game and it gets real when two queens go at each other about who should be in the bottom two.

episodes.name: 9021-HO
episodes.overview: After the queens’ successful acting debut they untuck backstage. The sisterhood builds stronger bonds after a queen gets a message from back home.

episodes.name: RuPaul Roast
episodes.overview: The queens cool down backstage after the RuPaul Roast. They discuss which queens of comedy were on fire and which ones went down in flames.

episodes.name: Your Pilot’s on Fire
episodes.overview: After making their own TV pilots, the queens settle in and get shady about who might get the green light and who might be canceled.

episodes.name: Makeovers: Crew Better Work
episodes.overview: After teaching the crew to beat their mugs and strut the runway, they untuck backstage and kiki with their new sisters.

episodes.name: Gayest Ball Ever
episodes.overview: The queens untuck after the Gayest Ball Ever. Emotions run high as the top 5 discuss their runway looks and who might be top 4.

episodes.name: Category Is
episodes.overview: After the facing their final challenges, the queens untuck backstage and kiki about how this experience has changed them and the legacy they hope to leave.

seasons.name: Season 9
seasons.overview: An access-all-areas pass to the drama that you didn't see on the runway of the tenth season of RuPaul's Drag Race.

episodes.name: 10s Across the Board
episodes.overview: The Queens untuck backstage and spill the T. Christina Aguilera pays them a gag-worthy visit before our first Queen sashays away.

episodes.name: PharmaRusical
episodes.overview: The queens must wow the judges in a lip-sync, dance number inspired by pharmaceutical TV ads; Halsey and Padma Lakshmi guest judge; guests Andy Cohen and Alyssa Edwards.

episodes.name: Tap That App
episodes.overview: The Queens untuck and discuss the struggles of this weeks challenge. Feathers fly over whether or not a certain queen brought her best drag.

episodes.name: The Last Ball on Earth
episodes.overview: Underlying tension between two queens reaches its boiling point, and another queen struggles to deal with the judges’ critiques.

episodes.name: The Bossy Rossy Show
episodes.overview: The queens settle in after a bossy challenge and spill the tea on boyfriends, attractions and who they think should be packing up.

episodes.name: Drag Con Panel Extravaganza
episodes.overview: The queens untuck backstage and discuss difficult moments from their past, and one queen comes to terms with a traumatic moment that changed her life.

episodes.name: Snatch Game
episodes.overview: Things heat up in Untucked after the Queens throw each other under the bus on the main stage. Feeling betrayed by her closest friends in the competition, one Queen fights harder to hold on to her dreams.

episodes.name: The Unauthorized Rusical
episodes.overview: The queens pay tribute to one of the greatest stars of all time in Cher: The Unauthorized Rusical. Andrew Rannells and Billy Eichner guest judge.

episodes.name: Breastworld
episodes.overview: When the queens untuck backstage, Miz Cracker gets to see a touching video from her family, and Kameron Michaels struggles with feeling discouraged.

episodes.name: Social Media Kings Into Queens
episodes.overview: The queens welcome unexpected guests backstage for some kiki and real talk, and one queen admits that she upped her strategy game.

episodes.name: Evil Twins
episodes.overview: The queens are beside themselves after the week’s challenge. One queen is close to giving up, and a strong queen is unexpectedly heartbroken by the words of another.

episodes.name: American
episodes.overview: The final four Queens share their dreams of making it to the finale and how much they’ve grown in the competition. A surprise message hits close to home for everyone.

seasons.name: Season 10
seasons.overview: An access-all-areas pass to the drama that you didn't see on the runway of the eleventh season of RuPaul's Drag Race.

episodes.name: Whatcha Unpackin?
episodes.overview: The Season 11 contestants chat backstage for the first time and have a surprise kiki with guest judge Miley Cyrus, and the first eliminated queen has an emotional pack-up.

episodes.name: Good God Girl, Get Out
episodes.overview: After the Good God, Girl, Get Out challenge and zodiac runway, Silky talks about the struggles of being a plus-size queen, and Bobby Moynihan shows off his death-drop skills.

episodes.name: Diva Worship
episodes.overview: After the Diva Worship challenge, Silky Ganache explains why the religious aspect of the competition made her uncomfortable, and Troye Sivan and Guillermo Diaz head backstage.

episodes.name: Trump: The Rusical
episodes.overview: After their Trump-inspired Rusical, Scarlet Envy discusses her tense relationship with Yvie Oddly, and Tiffany Pollard probes the queens about a possible backstage romance.

episodes.name: Monster Ball
episodes.overview: After competing in the monster-inspired ball, Nina West shares her coming out story, Shuga Cain gets a heartfelt message from her fiance, and Elvira drops in to see the girls.

episodes.name: The Draglympics
episodes.overview: After the Draglympics challenge, Yvie Oddly details her ankle injury, Silky Ganache and Plastique Tiara spar over leftover wigs, and Adam Rippon and Mirai Nagasu drop in.

episodes.name: From Farm To Runway
episodes.overview: After the farm-to-runway challenge, Yvie Oddly and Silky Ganache let out their werkroom frustrations, Plastique Tiara's boyfriend phones in, and Brooke Lynn dodges drama.

episodes.name: Snatch Game at Sea
episodes.overview: Plastique Tiara addresses Ra'Jah O'Hara's accusations, the queens reflect on their Snatch Game performances, and Yvie Oddly and A'Keria Davenport get messages from home.

episodes.name: L.A.D.P.!
episodes.overview: While untucking after the LADP! challenge, Natasha Lyonne drops in, Silky Ganache gets a message from back home, and the bottom queens share a moment before their lip sync.

episodes.name: Dragracadabra
episodes.overview: After putting on magic shows, Vanessa Vanjie and Yvie Oddly sort out a tense moment from the runway, Brooke Lynn Hytes gets a message from home, and another queen goes home.

episodes.name: Bring Back My Queens!
episodes.overview: After the makeover challenge, Yvie Oddly defends her attitude, Silky Ganache gets emotional over Brooke Lynn Hytes's critiques, and Vanessa Vanjie gets a message from home.

episodes.name: Queens Everywhere
episodes.overview: After the season's final challenge, Silky Ganache and A'Keria Davenport open up about their insecurities, and Vanessa Vanjie Mateo and Brooke Lynn Hytes share a tender moment.

seasons.name: Season 11
seasons.overview: An access-all-areas pass to the drama that you didn't see on the runway of the twelfth season of RuPaul's Drag Race.

episodes.name: I'm That Bitch
episodes.overview: After the first seven Season 12 queens rap in a girl group number, Widow Von'Du calls out her difficult teammates, and Nicki Minaj drops in with makeup and performance advice.

episodes.name: You Don’t Know Me
episodes.overview: After the final set of queens perform a musical number, Rock M. Sakura gets emotional reflecting on the challenge, and Robyn gives the girls advice on creative collaboration.

episodes.name: World's Worst
episodes.overview: After the queens compete on a parody TV talent show, Crystal Methyd gets a confidence boost after some harsh critiques, and Nicky Doll fights back against her inner saboteur

episodes.name: The Ball Ball
episodes.overview: The queens are on the ball this week but the bottoms are not ready to bounce. One queen sees simplicity where others see a lazy attempt at style. Leslie Jones drops in for a kiki.

episodes.name: Gay's Anatomy
episodes.overview: After the queens act in a Grey's Anatomy parody sketch, Aiden Zhane is forced to defend her performance, and Brita gets emotional over her standing in the competition.

episodes.name: Snatch Game
episodes.overview: Miss Vanjie drops by to visit this week’s safe queens. Tempers flare over the Snatch Game, but Jonathan Bennet and Daniel Franzese stop by and turn these mean girls around.

episodes.name: Madonna: The Unauthorized Rusical
episodes.overview: Safe queens settle and discuss the past week’s conflicts. One queen confronts another over a shady comment and it causes a commotion. U.S. Representative Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez stops by to discuss the politics of drag.

episodes.name: Droop
episodes.overview: It’s a somber beginning as the queens discuss their answers to Ru’s question of who should go home this week. Chaka Khan pops in to perk the queens up and remind them that they are every woman.

episodes.name: Choices 2020
episodes.overview: After the queens campaign for president, Gigi Goode owns up to being apolitical, Jackie Cox discusses Muslim visibility, and Widow Von'Du gets defensive about her performance.

episodes.name: Superfan Makeover
episodes.overview: After the queens make over Drag Race superfans, Heidi N Closet discusses her goals in the competition, Jaida Essence Hall reflects on drag fandom, and Daisy Ridley drops by.

episodes.name: One-Queen Show
episodes.overview: After the queens perform one-woman shows, Jackie Cox calls out Jaida Essence Hall for not being honest on the runway, and Whoopi Goldberg shares her words of wisdom.

episodes.name: Viva Drag Vegas
episodes.overview: After performing a Las Vegas-style musical medley in the season's last challenge, the queens reflect on their Top Five status and relive their favorite Untucked moments.

seasons.name: Season 12
seasons.overview: An access-all-areas pass to the drama that you didn't see on the runway of the thirteenth season of RuPaul's Drag Race.

episodes.name: The Pork Chop
episodes.overview: After the queens kick off Season 13 with a series off-lipsync battles, Tamisha Iman reveals why she dropped out of Season 12, and Symone discusses the inspiration behind her entrance lewk.

episodes.name: Condragulations
episodes.overview: After the queens perform Condragulations, Kandy Muse gets emotional over her critiques, Elliott with 2 Ts reflects on her journey, and Gottmik comes out to the group as transmasculine.

episodes.name: Phenomenon
episodes.overview: Backstage in Untucked, the queens open up about their families and the fear of not being accepted. A queen comes to terms with the possibility that she may have to fight to stay in the competition.

episodes.name: RuPaulmark Channel
episodes.overview: After a challenging group performance, the queens size up the competition. While a queen gets called out for being safe, the bottom queens face the fact that one of them might be going home tonight.

episodes.name: The Bag Ball
episodes.overview: After the Bag Ball, some of the safe queens question the tops, Kandy Muse offers up (more) unsolicited advice to Elliott with 2 Ts, and Tamisha Iman gets blunt about her competition.

episodes.name: Disco-Mentary
episodes.overview: After the queens' disco performances, Rose opens up about her frustrations in the competition, Gottmik gets emotional watching a message from her parents, and two one-time rivals make peace.

episodes.name: Bossy Rossy Ruboot
episodes.overview: After the queens' trashy talk show improv challenge, Denali expresses frustration at not being in the top once again, and Kandy Muse gives Elliott with 2 Ts a pep talk.

episodes.name: Social Media: The Unverified Rusical
episodes.overview: After the queens star in a social media-themed musical, Olivia Lux does a backstage ruveal, Rose and Denali clear the air after fighting over a role, and the bottoms prepare for battle.

episodes.name: Snatch Game
episodes.overview: The queens weigh in on each other's Snatch Game performances, Olivia Lux and Rose question Utica's unflattering off-camera behavior, and Ts Madison drops by for a pep talk.

episodes.name: Freaky Friday Queens
episodes.overview: After the makeover challenge, the queens vent over having to call out one of their sisters, Denali and Olivia Lux get emotional at the idea of leaving, and Kandy Muse gets a moving message.

episodes.name: Pop! Goes the Queens
episodes.overview: After a soda branding challenge, Olivia Lux admits she feels overlooked, the queens reveal their top competition, and Tina Burner gets a message from her mom.

episodes.name: Nice Girls Roast
episodes.overview: After the roast challenge, Gottmik reflects on her growth in the competition, and former Miss Congeniality winners Nina West, Valentina and Heidi N Closet drop in to chat with the queens.

episodes.name: Henny, I Shrunk the Drag Queens!
episodes.overview: After their star turns in a sci-fi spoof, Olivia Lux feels the sting of the other queens' critiques, Kandy Muse needs medical attention, and Cynthia Erivo pops in to chat with the girls.

episodes.name: Gettin' Lucky
episodes.overview: After performing in the season's last challenge, the queens react to seeing their baby photos and addressing their younger selves, and Rose and Symone receive messages of support from home.

seasons.name: Season 13
seasons.overview: An access-all-areas pass to the drama that you didn't see on the runway of the fourteenth season of RuPaul's Drag Race.

episodes.name: Big Opening No. 1
episodes.overview: Seven queens untuck and kiki about their performances in the first Maxi Challenge. Sisterly bonds build, as they discuss the art of drag and the trouble with first impressions.

episodes.name: Big Opening No. 2
episodes.overview: Seven new queens untuck and hash out the struggles of their first week in the competition. After hearing the others' stories, one queen shares how her drag journey is different from theirs.

episodes.name: A Pair of Balls
episodes.overview: With all the Season 14 queens together for the first time, the kiki heats up and cracks in the sisterhood begin to show.

episodes.name: She's a Super Tease
episodes.overview: The Maxi Challenge has the queens in their feelings as they discuss the week's placements. Emotions run raw, putting their sisterly bonds to the test.

episodes.name: Save a Queen
episodes.overview: Queens from seasons past return to Untucked to kiki with the Season 14 queens and give them advice on life after the competition. Safe queens question how they can break through to get the judges’ attention.

episodes.name: Glamazon Prime
episodes.overview: Tensions run high after an unconventional runway gets some of the queens in their feelings. A kiki with guest judge Taraji P. Henson inspires the queens and gets them primed for the lip sync.

episodes.name: The Daytona Wind
episodes.overview: The competition strengthens the bonds between the queens. Guest Ts Madison stops by for a little sisterly advice, and one queen reveals a truth she can’t keep hidden any longer.

episodes.name: 60s Girl Groups
episodes.overview: After spilling their hearts on the runway, the queens bond as they reminisce about their time in the competition. It’s an emotional moment as the bottoms discuss the possibility of sashaying away.

episodes.name: Menzeses
episodes.overview: A DragCon challenge has the queens baring it all. Guest judge Nicole Byer gets everyone roaring with laughter, and the bottom queens prepare for a battle royal.

episodes.name: Snatch Game
episodes.overview: The queens weigh in on their Snatch Game impersonations and debate whose performance was a total bottom. An emotional video from home lifts the spirits of one queen and a kiki with Dove Cameron hits home for all.

episodes.name: An Extra Special Episode
episodes.overview: After a Lip Sync Lalaparuza Smackdown, the queens reflect on their memorably lackluster Snatch Game performances, and Angeria Paris VanMicheals gives Daya Betty constructive feedback.

episodes.name: Moulin Ru: The Rusical
episodes.overview: After the queens' Moulin Rouge! parody performance, Jorgeous prepares for the worst, Bosco and Lady Camden talk it out after having a pre-challenge tiff, and Andra Day drops by backstage.

episodes.name: The Ross Mathews Roast
episodes.overview: After Ross Mathews gets roasted, DeJa Skye gets emotional thinking about her coaching session, Willow Pill gets a message from home, and Dulcé Sloan gets a pulse check on the queens.

episodes.name: Catwalk
episodes.overview: After performing in their final challenge, the queens discuss addressing their younger selves, rate their chances of making the finale, and recall their favorite moments of the competition.

seasons.name: Season 14
seasons.overview: An access-all-areas pass to the drama that you didn't see on the runway of the fifteenth season of RuPaul's Drag Race.

episodes.name: One Night Only (1)
episodes.overview: The cameras go backstage to meet the 16 new queens as they prepare to introduce themselves to the world in their werk room entrances and begin their first challenge.

episodes.name: One Night Only (2)
episodes.overview: The queens take time to get to know each other after a talent show challenge, Ariana Grande visits backstage, and the first to depart lets her voice be heard before her sashay.

episodes.name: All Queens Go to Heaven
episodes.overview: After the queens film ads for Heaven, Mistress Isabelle Brooks gives makeup advice, Princess Poppy explains her approach to the competition, and Maren Morris doles out words of wisdom.

episodes.name: Supersized Snatch Game
episodes.overview: The queens assess their Snatch Game performances, Malaysia Babydoll Foxx grapples with old insecurities, and Sugar and Spice strategize how to express their individuality as drag twins.

episodes.name: House of Fashion
episodes.overview: The queens are stitched, glued and gooped after turning home décor into haute couture. A kiki with Janelle Monáe reminds them how inspiring they are to others.

episodes.name: Old Friends Gold
episodes.overview: The temperature rises backstage following a heated Girl Group challenge that leaves the queens shaken, rattled and rolled. Sage advice from some old friends remind our queens of the importance of friends and chosen family.

episodes.name: The Daytona Wind 2
episodes.overview: After the winds settle the queens untuck and discuss the art of comedic timing. Harvey Guillen drops in and gives the queens some valuable advice.

episodes.name: LipSync Lalaparuza Smackdown
episodes.overview: The queens kiki after a dramatic LipSync Lalaparuza Smackdown and debate who is proving to be the fiercest at this halfway point in the competition.

episodes.name: The Crystal Ball
episodes.overview: After a ball challenge, Malaysia Babydoll Foxx compliments her fellow competitors' design skills, Mistress Isabelle Brooks gets real with Spice, and Julia Garner visits backstage.

episodes.name: 50/50's Most Gagworthy Stars
episodes.overview: Many queens possess the gift of gab, but some were left speechless after this week’s talk show segments. Ts Madison stops by to discuss the judges critiques and lift some spirits.

episodes.name: Two Queens, One Jok
episodes.overview: The queens yuck it up backstage following the comedy challenge, but the laughter soon gives way to tears. Comedian Ali Wong stops by for a kiki with the queens.

episodes.name: Wigloose: The Rusical!
episodes.overview: After cutting loose in the Rusical, tensions flare as the queens hash out their answers to Ru's question.

episodes.name: Teacher Makeovers
episodes.overview: After the queens make over teachers, Loosey LaDuca lets off some steam, the queens assess their drag family resemblances, and Sasha Colby gets a message from Drag Race alum Kerri Colby.

episodes.name: Blame It on the Edit
episodes.overview: After the intergalactic music video premiere, the final four queens reflect on their achievements over the season and recount their proudest and least favorite moments of the competition.

seasons.name: Season 15
seasons.overview: An access-all-areas pass to the drama that you didn't see on the runway of the sixteenth season of RuPaul's Drag Race.

episodes.name: Rate-A-Queen
episodes.overview: The queens toast to a new season and discuss Xunami Muse's catchy song, Mirage's fabulous dance moves and O's stunning costume, and guest judge Charlize Theron joins for a heart-to-heart.

episodes.name: Queen Choice Awards
episodes.overview: The queens unwind and discuss Mhi'ya Iman LePaige's showstopping flips, Nymphia Wind's gag-worthy ruveal, and Megami's solemn performance, and Becky G drops in with encouraging words.

episodes.name: The Mother of All Balls
episodes.overview: The lounge gets tense as the queens offer each other brutally honest and unsolicited critiques, and the first to be eliminated proudly stands by her runway looks.

episodes.name: RDR Live!
episodes.overview: RDR Live! served up plenty of jokes, but it's no laughing matter when an ongoing conflict resurfaces, and Sarah Michelle Gellar crashes the party and slays the queens.

episodes.name: Girl Groups
episodes.overview: After a gag-worthy performance, the winning girl group revels in their victory, Q hits a nerve when she critiques Xunami Muse, and Icona Pop drops in for a visit.

episodes.name: Welcome to the DollHouse
episodes.overview: The queens discover that some amongst them are shadier than others following the week's design challenge, and fashion icon Law Roach drops in with some critiques.

episodes.name: The Sound of Rusic
episodes.overview: After performing in a rusical, tensions are high as the queens compare choreography and debate who had the most steps in the Swish Alps, and Adam Shankman drops in for a kiki.

episodes.name: Snatch Game
episodes.overview: Fallout from Snatch Game is anything but a laughing matter as the queens discuss who scored and who flopped, and Kyra Sedgwick stops by to remind everyone that attitude is everything.

episodes.name: See You Next Wednesday
episodes.overview: After the spooky design challenge, the queens are coming apart at the seams, and runway model Kaia Gerber sashays in for a fashionable kiki.

episodes.name: Werk the World
episodes.overview: Things get funky in the Untucked Lounge when the queens ponder the power of their Werq the World performances, and Jamal Sims struts in to break it down for them.

episodes.name: Corporate Queens
episodes.overview: After their critiques, the queens settle in and have a kiki with Joel Kim Booster about the magic of drag, and a video from home has everyone feeling their emotions.

episodes.name: Bathroom Hunties
episodes.overview: After the queens design and showcase bathrooms, Plane Jane gets vulnerable, the girls talk teamwork, and Mayan Lopez pops by with some much needed relief.

episodes.name: Drag Race Vegas LIVE! Makeovers
episodes.overview: After their critiques on the makeovers of dancers from RuPaul's Drag Race LIVE! in Las Vegas, the queens praise Kelsea Ballerini for being a strong ally.

episodes.name: Booked & Blessed
episodes.overview: After their critiques, the queens reflect on the last challenge ahead of the finals, and Ts Madison stops by to offer words of encouragement.

seasons.name: Season 16
seasons.overview: An access-all-areas pass to the drama that you didn't see on the runway of the seventeenth season of RuPaul's Drag Race.

episodes.name: Squirrel Games
episodes.overview: The queens celebrate week one with a champagne toast in the all-new Untucked Lounge. The queens break off into groups wondering how tonight’s Rate-A-Queen vote will turn out. Katy Perry stops by to give her two cents on the talent show.

episodes.name: Drag Queens Got Talent - Part 2
episodes.overview: After the talent show, things start to get real in the Untucked Lounge. It’s time for the week two girls to be judged in Rate-A-Queen and one queen’s strong opinions quickly turns her fellow competitors against her.

episodes.name: Monopulence!
episodes.overview: Tensions still run high in the aftermath of the Monopulence design challenge. The bottom queens are emotional after critiques, and one queen rubs her sisters the wrong way. Queer icon, Sandra Bernhard shares the lessons she’s learned during her amazing career.

episodes.name: Bitch, I'm a Drag Queen!
episodes.overview: The safe queens don’t see eye to eye on the tops and bottoms this week, but they all agree that one queen’s look was the worst on the runway.  Everyone is gagged when a confident queen finally loses her cool. There are tears and anger in the lounge as the queens realize the game is heating up and no one is really safe.

episodes.name: RDR Live!
episodes.overview: Drag delusion settles into the Untucked Lounge. Feeling salty about landing in the bottom, one Queen calls out her sisters. A funny runway divides the room and everyone is bothered. Paul W. Downs gets the Queens out of their heads with some good advice.

episodes.name: Let's Get Sea Sickening Ball
episodes.overview: It's sink or swim after the Sea Sickening Ball. One Queen is shook after her confidence is put to the test. Guest Judge and trans trailblazer Hunter Schafer visits the lounge and gets her flowers from the Queens.

episodes.name: Snatch Game
episodes.overview: After the Snatch Game critiques, a safe placement has left one Queen a little salty. A Queen with a strong track record lands in the bottom. Guest Judge Quinta Brunson uplifts the Queens.

episodes.name: The Wicked Wiz of Oz: The Rusical!
episodes.overview: The safe Queens are feeling playful and decide to mess with the rest of the girls. One Queen questions the difficulty of her sister's role in the Rusical. Guest judge Adam Lambert thrills the Queens by stopping by and sharing his journey.

episodes.name: Heavens To Betsey!
episodes.overview: The Queens are campaigning hard for a particular bottom Queen to be sent home. The critiqued Queens interrupt a chaotic moment in the lounge. Guest judge Betsey Johnson stops by and gets the Queens out of their heads and on their feet.

episodes.name: The Villains Roast
episodes.overview: Unresolved tension from this week's challenge comes to a head in the Untucked lounge; Two friends are torn apart, and two friends strengthen their bond; One Queen makes an enemy after standing up for her sister.

episodes.name: Ross Mathews vs. The Ducks
episodes.overview: Harsh realities are sinking in after the Queens reveal their picks to go home. Two Queens feel defeated after finding themselves in the bottom. Guest judge Sam Smith shares his favorite way to wind down after a long day.

episodes.name: Charisma, Uniqueness, Nerve & Talent Monologues
episodes.overview: The spirit of delusion is alive and well in the Untucked lounge. One Queen does not understand why she is not in the top this week. While another Queen pins her hopes of staying on a long shot.

episodes.name: Drag Baby Mamas
episodes.overview: The Queens and their parents celebrate the completion of an emotionally charged makeover challenge. After the parents leave, the mood in the lounge quickly turns bittersweet. The finale is fast approaching and not everyone is going to make it to the end.

episodes.name: How's Your Headliner?
episodes.overview: The top Queens enter the Untucked lounge for the final time. Their fates are uncertain, but they all agree that they have had the time of their lives. Guest judge, Tracee Ellis Ross stops by to thank the Queens for putting on an amazing show.

seasons.name: Season 17
seasons.overview: An access-all-areas pass to the drama that you didn't see on the runway of the eighteenth season of RuPaul's Drag Race.

shows.name: Severance
shows.overview: Mark leads a team of office workers whose memories have been surgically divided between their work and personal lives. When a mysterious colleague appears outside of work, it begins a journey to discover the truth about their jobs.

episodes.name: Welcome to Lumon
episodes.overview: An introduction to the world.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: At Lumon Industries, employees undergo "severance," a procedure dividing their work and personal memories. Mark, a grieving team leader, begins to uncover the dark secrets of the company, forcing him and his coworkers to confront questions of identity, free will, and corporate control.

episodes.name: Good News About Hell
episodes.overview: Mark is promoted to lead a team who've had their memories surgically divided between their work and personal lives.

episodes.name: Half Loop
episodes.overview: The team train new hire Helly on macrodata refinement. Mark takes a day off to meet with a mysterious former colleague.

episodes.name: In Perpetuity
episodes.overview: Mark takes the team on a field trip, but Helly continues to rebel. A deteriorating Petey struggles to tell Mark about Lumon’s misdeeds.

episodes.name: The You You Are
episodes.overview: Irving finds an intriguing book at work. Helly aggressively pursues a meeting with her Outie. Mark attends a funeral with Ms. Selvig.

episodes.name: The Grim Barbarity of Optics and Design
episodes.overview: Irving and Dylan confront Burt about his lies. Mark and Helly discover a strange new department.

episodes.name: Hide and Seek
episodes.overview: The team angers Cobel by forming an alliance.

episodes.name: Defiant Jazz
episodes.overview: Mark and the team encounter new security measures from Cobel.

episodes.name: What's for Dinner?
episodes.overview: The team prepares a plan. Mark attends Devon and Ricken’s party.

episodes.name: The We We Are
episodes.overview: The team discovers troubling revelations.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Mark and his friends learn the dire consequences of trifling with the severance barrier, leading them further down a path of woe.

episodes.name: Hello, Ms. Cobel
episodes.overview: Mark returns to work under different circumstances. Secrets from the Outie world come to light.

episodes.name: Goodbye, Mrs. Selvig
episodes.overview: Mark contemplates the meaning of a message.

episodes.name: Who Is Alive?
episodes.overview: Mark, Helly, Irving, and Dylan search for answers.

episodes.name: Woe's Hollow
episodes.overview: The team participates in a group activity.

episodes.name: Trojan's Horse
episodes.overview: Tensions emerge after the team suffers a loss.

episodes.name: Attila
episodes.overview: Bonds are tested. Mark continues on his path of discovery.

episodes.name: Chikhai Bardo
episodes.overview: An old romance intersects with a deadly present threat.

episodes.name: Sweet Vitriol
episodes.overview: Discoveries are made.

episodes.name: The After Hours
episodes.overview: Mark and Devon team with an ally. Helly investigates further.

episodes.name: Cold Harbor
episodes.overview: Mark forms a shaky alliance in an all-or-nothing play, while the team makes a dangerous last stand.

shows.name: Shifting Gears
shows.overview: Matt is a stubborn, widowed owner of a classic car restoration shop. When Matt's estranged daughter Riley and her teenage kids move into his house, the real restoration begins.

episodes.name: Restoration
episodes.overview: Widowed car restoration shop owner Matt is forced to confront his estranged daughter, when she and her children move in with him, creating a major upheaval in his life as he navigates the challenges or reconnecting with his family while restoring classic cars in his garage.

episodes.name: Accommodations
episodes.overview: Matt joins Riley at Carter's high school open house, where he's unsettled to learn about the "accommodations" made for his grandson's anxiety. Meanwhile, Riley reconnects with Caitlin, a former classmate, and sets her up with Gabriel.

episodes.name: Job
episodes.overview: Riley, desperate for work, reluctantly takes a job at Matt's shop; Gabriel and Stitch secretly stray from Matt's vision on a high-stakes restomod project.

episodes.name: Grief
episodes.overview: When Riley discovers a closet filled with her late mother’s clothes, she insists Matt hasn’t processed her death and urges him to see a grief counselor. Meanwhile, Gabriel faces a crisis of confidence when he’s put in charge of the shop for a day.

episodes.name: Jimmy
episodes.overview: Riley’s estranged husband, Jimmy, shows up to win her back, much to Matt’s dismay. While Matt struggles to get through to him, Riley finds support in an unexpected place.

episodes.name: Valentine's
episodes.overview: A Valentine's Day visit to his late wife's grave sparks an unexpected connection for Matt in an unlikely place; Riley is thrust into the spotlight for a promotional video at the dance studio.

episodes.name: Picnic
episodes.overview: The feud between Parker Customs and Premiere Dance Lab heats up when Matt confronts the owner over a picnic table placed in the shared alleyway; Carter's need for "me time" sparks a conversation with Matt.

episodes.name: Career
episodes.overview: Georgia invites Matt and Riley to speak at her school's Career Day, where playful competition turns tense when Riley learns Georgia is ashamed of her job; Gabriel mentors Carter's car project until a more urgent piece of business arises.

episodes.name: Gummies
episodes.overview: Riley is horrified when she finds weed gummies in Carter’s pocket, prompting surprising advice from Matt. Meanwhile, Eve inadvertently lands Gabriel and Stitch in hot water after asking them to donate to a charity auction.

episodes.name: Kiss
episodes.overview: Riley is torn between her past and her future.

episodes.name: Secret
episodes.overview: Matt wrestles with his feelings for Eve, and Charlotte convinces him to go to a grief group. Meanwhile, Riley struggles with her own “will she or won’t she” about her feelings for Gabe.

episodes.name: Date
episodes.overview: Matt and Eve go on their first date but have different ideas of what it should entail; Riley befriends the mom of Georgia's new friend; Carter mediates a tiff between Gabe and Stitch.

episodes.name: Passion
episodes.overview: When Carter's job pays more than Riley's, she decides to find her forever career and clashes with Matt over her future; Gabriel "Fluffy" Iglesias drops by Parker Customs; Matt debates letting go of a piece of the past.

episodes.name: Danger
episodes.overview: When a raccoon appears in the Parkers’ yard, Matt sees a chance to teach Carter a lesson about facing his fears. Meanwhile, Riley struggles to navigate the world of dating apps and goes on her first post-divorce date.

episodes.name: Scary
episodes.overview: Matt plans to spend Halloween with Eve, but the real terror begins when she wants to sleep over. With Carter and Georgia out for the night, Riley invites Gabe and Stitch to a party, hoping to relive the crazy, epic Halloweens of her past.

episodes.name: Loyalty
episodes.overview: Matt's dream build turns into a nightmare when controversy threatens to derail everything.

episodes.name: License
episodes.overview: Matt's plan to prove he's the better driving teacher hits a snag when he learns his license is expired; Riley's two worlds collide as she struggles to keep both her business and family afloat.

episodes.name: Nutcracker
episodes.overview: This holiday season, the Parkers discover that romance isn't always a smooth ride as Matt and Eve are on thin ice; Gabe enlists Riley to help Amelie impress his mum; Carter seeks help with his promposal.

shows.name: The Harbor and the Sailor
shows.overview: The story of the struggle of El Araby who owns a fleet of fishing boats in Alexandria but he faces repeated financial crises, and Fares who dreams of traveling to Europe and rejects the idea of ​​marrying his cousin who loved him since she moved in with his family after her father died.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Episode 1 of The Harbor and the Sailor

shows.name: Silo
shows.overview: In a ruined and toxic future, thousands live in a giant silo deep underground. After its sheriff breaks a cardinal rule and residents die mysteriously, engineer Juliette starts to uncover shocking secrets and the truth about the silo.

episodes.name: Questions of the Silo
episodes.overview: A brief, behind the scenes look back at Silo Season 1.

episodes.name: The Rebellion
episodes.overview: Order into chaos. Control into madness. How far would you go to discover the truth?

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: In a bleak dystopian future, humanity clings to survival deep underground within the confines of a colossal silo. Juliette, an engineer tasked with unraveling the mystery behind the death of a colleague, uncovers startling secrets that threaten the very fabric of their enclosed world.

episodes.name: Freedom Day
episodes.overview: Sheriff Becker's plans for the future are thrown off course after his wife meets a hacker with information about the silo.

episodes.name: Holston's Pick
episodes.overview: Juliette, an engineer, pieces together what might have led to a co-worker's mysterious death.

episodes.name: Machines
episodes.overview: In her hunt for a new sheriff, Mayor Jahns clashes with Bernard. Juliette strikes a deal to keep the generator running.

episodes.name: Truth
episodes.overview: Juliette tries gaining the trust of Deputy Marnes as they work to uncover the truth about recent tragedies.

episodes.name: The Janitor's Boy
episodes.overview: Sims appoints Billings as chief deputy to keep tabs on Juliette, whose efforts to solve two murders lead to a showdown.

episodes.name: The Relic
episodes.overview: During her investigation, Juliette uncovers disturbing secrets about someone she thought she knew.

episodes.name: The Flamekeepers
episodes.overview: Bernard seeks Juliette's cooperation as he grows increasingly concerned about the silo's security. Juliette asks her father for a favor.

episodes.name: Hanna
episodes.overview: New information causes Juliette to see her family's past differently—and she finally gains access to the silo's biggest secrets.

episodes.name: The Getaway
episodes.overview: Racked with guilt, Billings sets off on a personal mission, only to discover a mind-blowing clue from Juliette.

episodes.name: Outside
episodes.overview: Juliette's fate seems sealed when certain truths finally come to light.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Stranded outside her silo with a failing suit, Juliette Nichols races against time, stunned to find another silo nearby that could be her only hope for survival. Meanwhile, unrest brews inside her original silo as Bernard Holland rallies citizens to maintain order amid rising questions about their world. As Juliette faces unexpected dangers near the new silo, hidden truths about the silos’ origins and the world beyond begin to surface, deepening the mystery.

episodes.name: The Engineer
episodes.overview: Juliette finds sanctuary in a silo long ago destroyed by war, thinking she's alone.

episodes.name: Order
episodes.overview: In Silo 18, shock and unrest take hold in the wake of Juliette doing what no one's done before.

episodes.name: Solo
episodes.overview: Bernard turns to Judge Meadows for help. Billings begins to wonder if he's being lied to. Juliette finally meets the man in the vault.

episodes.name: The Harmonium
episodes.overview: Juliette sets out on a dangerous quest to retrieve a suit so she can return home and save her silo. Mechanical plans a meeting with Judge Meadows.

episodes.name: Descent
episodes.overview: Sims finds himself with a new position. Juliette learns Solo isn't being honest. Bernard and Lukas make an important discovery.

episodes.name: Barricades
episodes.overview: Bernard enacts a plan to root out Knox, Shirley, and Walker. Billings takes a stand. Solo saves Juliette's life and wants something in return.

episodes.name: The Dive
episodes.overview: Lukas is assigned a mission. Mechanical sends a powerful message. Juliette embarks on a perilous descent—and confronts a new danger.

episodes.name: The Book of Quinn
episodes.overview: Juliette discovers something's happened to Solo. Bernard makes an offer to Walker. Lukas meets with Salvador Quinn's descendants.

episodes.name: The Safeguard
episodes.overview: Billings' faith is shaken. Lukas heads to the down deep. Knox identifies the traitor. Juliette uncovers the truth about Solo's past.

episodes.name: Into the Fire
episodes.overview: The rebels make their move—and so does Juliette.

shows.name: Slow Horses
shows.overview: Follow a dysfunctional team of MI5 agents—and their obnoxious boss, the notorious Jackson Lamb—as they navigate the espionage world's smoke and mirrors to defend England from sinister forces.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: When a young man is kidnapped and threatened with beheading, the slow horses find themselves unexpectedly embroiled in a dangerous case that forces them to prove their worth.

episodes.name: Failure's Contagious
episodes.overview: River Cartwright is ousted from MI5 and finds himself in a place worse than purgatory: Slough House, dumping ground for failed spies.

episodes.name: Work Drinks
episodes.overview: River and Sid join forces. A misfired gun has dire consequences.

episodes.name: Bad Tradecraft
episodes.overview: Slough House is the unlikely venue for a secret romance, but events take a dark turn when a dangerous encounter becomes deadly.

episodes.name: Visiting Hours
episodes.overview: Taverner sends the Dogs to hunt down Lamb and the Slow Horses. River holds the secret to saving the gang.

episodes.name: Fiasco
episodes.overview: The Slow Horses must disappear to avoid capture by MI5. Lamb and River head to The Park to outwit Taverner.

episodes.name: Follies
episodes.overview: Taverner and the Slow Horses attempt different approaches to locate the kidnappers and Hassan. Ho makes a shocking discovery about Sid.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Long-buried Cold War secrets emerge which threaten to bring carnage to the streets of London. When a liaison with Russian villains takes a fatal turn, our hapless heroes must overcome their individual failings and raise their spy game in a race to prevent a catastrophic incident.

episodes.name: Last Stop
episodes.overview: Jackson Lamb is on high alert after a former spy is found dead. Min and Louisa are tempted by an offer from outside Slough House.

episodes.name: From Upshott with Love
episodes.overview: Lamb liaises with a Russian defector who may hold a clue to sleeper agents. River is on the trail of a ruthless assassin.

episodes.name: Drinking Games
episodes.overview: River gets cozy in the Cotswolds while searching for a sleeper agent. Min discovers Russian drinking games are the most brutal of all.

episodes.name: Cicada
episodes.overview: Louisa makes her move on Pashkin. Catherine makes moves of a different kind when she plays high-stakes chess with a sinister stranger.

episodes.name: Boardroom Politics
episodes.overview: Lamb orders his Slow Horses to walk into traps. River believes something alarming is heading toward London.

episodes.name: Old Scores
episodes.overview: Lamb and Katinsky go head-to-head. Ho finds himself trapped on a train with a Russian assassin.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: A romantic liaison in Istanbul threatens to expose a buried MI5 secret in London. When Jackson Lamb and his team of misfits are dragged into the fight, they find themselves caught in a conspiracy that threatens the future not just of Slough House but of MI5 itself.

episodes.name: Strange Games
episodes.overview: A romantic relationship in Istanbul ends badly. Lamb hits the panic button when one of his Slow Horses fails to show up for work.

episodes.name: Hard Lessons
episodes.overview: River has to steal something out of the Park to save a life. Lamb realizes a stranger game is afoot.

episodes.name: Negotiating with Tigers
episodes.overview: Marcus and Shirley face Lamb's wrath. River discovers revenge is a dish best served cold.

episodes.name: Uninvited Guests
episodes.overview: Tearney makes a bold move. The Slow Horses assist the Tiger Team, unaware of their hidden agenda. Lamb and Ho take a road trip.

episodes.name: Cleaning Up
episodes.overview: Taverner and Tearney face off for control of MI5. River and Louisa find themselves caught in the crossfire.

episodes.name: Footprints
episodes.overview: The Slow Horses fight for their lives. Lamb shares some devastating truths with Catherine.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: In season 4, a bombing detonates personal secrets, rocking Slough House's already unstable foundations.

episodes.name: Identity Theft
episodes.overview: A London bombing puts Taverner under pressure. When River grows concerned for his grandfather, Louisa encourages him to go for a visit.

episodes.name: A Stranger Comes to Town
episodes.overview: A naive agent makes a discovery about the Westacres bomber. Lamb suspects that David knows more than he's letting on.

episodes.name: Penny for Your Thoughts
episodes.overview: River is trapped in France. Back at Slough House, the Dogs have come for Lamb.

episodes.name: Returns
episodes.overview: Taverner is desperate to hide dangerous secrets. River seeks answers at his grandfather's house.

episodes.name: Grave Danger
episodes.overview: Lamb questions David about France as River comes face to face with the enemy.

episodes.name: Hello Goodbye
episodes.overview: Impossible decisions are faced and sacrifices are made.

seasons.name: Season 5
seasons.overview: In season five, everyone is suspicious when resident tech nerd Roddy Ho has a glamorous new girlfriend. When a series of increasingly bizarre events occur across the city, it falls to the Slow Horses to work out how everything is connected. After all, Lamb knows that in the world of espionage, the London Rules — cover your back — always apply.

episodes.name: Bad Dates
episodes.overview: A mass shooting rocks London, intensifying a testy mayoral race. Shirley believes one of the Slow Horses was the target of an attempted hit.

episodes.name: Incommunicado
episodes.overview: Lamb intercepts an assassin. Taverner receives a key piece of intel about the Abbotsfield shooting.

episodes.name: Tall Tales
episodes.overview: An act of sabotage grinds London to a halt. Taverner interrogates Roddy. Coe is convinced a destabilization strategy is at play.

episodes.name: Missiles
episodes.overview: Flyte sets out to find Roddy's girlfriend. The gang is dispatched to two different campaign events to prevent another attack.

episodes.name: Circus
episodes.overview: Lamb debriefs River and Coe. Roddy is pulled in to help decipher a piece of code as the destabilization strategy nears its final stage.

episodes.name: Scars
episodes.overview: It's up to the Slow Horses to stop Farouk's team from completing its mission in a final act of mass carnage.

shows.name: Star Trek: Starfleet Academy
shows.overview: A young group of cadets come together to pursue a common dream of hope and optimism. Under the watchful and demanding eyes of their instructors, they will discover what it takes to become Starfleet officers as they navigate blossoming friendships, explosive rivalries, first loves and a new enemy that threatens both the Academy and the Federation itself.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: A young group of Starfleet cadets navigating friendships and rivalries, as well as first loves and a new enemy that poses a threat not to just the Academy, but to the Federation. And, in between all that drama, they strive to meet the standards of their exacting instructors.

shows.name: Star Wars: Maul - Shadow Lord
shows.overview: After the Clone Wars, Maul plots to rebuild his criminal syndicate on a planet untouched by the Empire.

shows.name: Stranger Things
shows.overview: When a young boy vanishes, a small town uncovers a mystery involving secret experiments, terrifying supernatural forces, and one strange little girl.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Strange things are afoot in Hawkins, Indiana, where a young boy's sudden disappearance unearths a young girl with otherworldly powers.

episodes.name: Chapter One: The Vanishing of Will Byers
episodes.overview: On his way home from a friend's house, young Will sees something terrifying. Nearby, a sinister secret lurks in the depths of a government lab.

episodes.name: Chapter Two: The Weirdo on Maple Street
episodes.overview: Lucas, Mike and Dustin try to talk to the girl they found in the woods. Hopper questions an anxious Joyce about an unsettling phone call.

episodes.name: Chapter Three: Holly, Jolly
episodes.overview: An increasingly concerned Nancy looks for Barb and finds out what Jonathan's been up to. Joyce is convinced Will is trying to talk to her.

episodes.name: Chapter Four: The Body
episodes.overview: Refusing to believe Will is dead, Joyce tries to connect with her son. The boys give Eleven a makeover. Nancy and Jonathan form an unlikely alliance.

episodes.name: Chapter Five: The Flea and the Acrobat
episodes.overview: Hopper breaks into the lab while Nancy and Jonathan confront the force that took Will. The boys ask Mr. Clarke how to travel to another dimension.

episodes.name: Chapter Six: The Monster
episodes.overview: A frantic Jonathan looks for Nancy in the darkness, but Steve's looking for her, too. Hopper and Joyce uncover the truth about the lab's experiments.

episodes.name: Chapter Seven: The Bathtub
episodes.overview: Eleven struggles to reach Will, while Lucas warns that "the bad men are coming." Nancy and Jonathan show the police what Jonathan caught on camera.

episodes.name: Chapter Eight: The Upside Down
episodes.overview: Dr. Brenner holds Hopper and Joyce for questioning while the boys wait with Eleven in the gym. Back at Will's, Nancy and Jonathan prepare for battle.

seasons.name: Stranger Things 2
seasons.overview: It's been nearly a year since Will's strange disappearance. But life's hardly back to normal in Hawkins. Not even close.

episodes.name: Chapter One: MADMAX
episodes.overview: As the town preps for Halloween, a high-scoring rival shakes things up at the arcade, and a skeptical Hopper inspects a field of rotting pumpkins.

episodes.name: Chapter Two: Trick or Treat, Freak
episodes.overview: After Will sees something terrible on trick-or-treat night, Mike wonders whether Eleven's still out there. Nancy wrestles with the truth about Barb.

episodes.name: Chapter Three: The Pollywog
episodes.overview: Dustin adopts a strange new pet, and Eleven grows increasingly impatient. A well-meaning Bob urges Will to stand up to his fears.

episodes.name: Chapter Four: Will the Wise
episodes.overview: An ailing Will opens up to Joyce -- with disturbing results. While Hopper digs for the truth, Eleven unearths a surprising discovery.

episodes.name: Chapter Five: Dig Dug
episodes.overview: Nancy and Jonathan swap conspiracy theories with a new ally as Eleven searches for someone from her past. “Bob the Brain” tackles a difficult problem.

episodes.name: Chapter Six: The Spy
episodes.overview: Will's connection to a shadowy evil grows stronger, but no one's quite sure how to stop it. Elsewhere, Dustin and Steve forge an unlikely bond.

episodes.name: Chapter Seven: The Lost Sister
episodes.overview: Psychic visions draw Eleven to a band of violent outcasts and an angry girl with a shadowy past.

episodes.name: Chapter Eight: The Mind Flayer
episodes.overview: An unlikely hero steps forward when a deadly development puts the Hawkins Lab on lockdown, trapping Will and several others inside.

episodes.name: Chapter Nine: The Gate
episodes.overview: Eleven makes plans to finish what she started while the survivors turn up the heat on the monstrous force that's holding Will hostage.

seasons.name: Stranger Things 3
seasons.overview: Budding romance. A brand-new mall. And rabid rats running toward danger. It's the summer of 1985 in Hawkins ... and one summer can change everything.

episodes.name: Chapter One: Suzie, Do You Copy?
episodes.overview: Summer brings new jobs and budding romance. But the mood shifts when Dustin's radio picks up a Russian broadcast, and Will senses something is wrong.

episodes.name: Chapter Two: The Mall Rats
episodes.overview: Nancy and Jonathan follow a lead, Steve and Robin sign on to a secret mission, and Max and Eleven go shopping. A rattled Billy has troubling visions.

episodes.name: Chapter Three: The Case of the Missing Lifeguard
episodes.overview: With El and Max looking for Billy, Will declares a day without girls. Steve and Dustin go on a stakeout, and Joyce and Hopper return to Hawkins Lab.

episodes.name: Chapter Four: The Sauna Test
episodes.overview: A code red brings the gang back together to face a frighteningly familiar evil. Karen urges Nancy to keep digging, and Robin finds a useful map.

episodes.name: Chapter Five: The Flayed
episodes.overview: Strange surprises lurk inside an old farmhouse and deep beneath the Starcourt Mall. Meanwhile, the Mind Flayer is gathering strength.

episodes.name: Chapter Six: E Pluribus Unum
episodes.overview: Dr. Alexei reveals what the Russians have been building, and Eleven sees where Billy has been. Dustin and Erica stage a daring rescue.

episodes.name: Chapter Seven: The Bite
episodes.overview: With time running out -- and an assassin close behind -- Hopper's crew races back to Hawkins, where El and the kids are preparing for war.

episodes.name: Chapter Eight: The Battle of Starcourt
episodes.overview: Terror reigns in the food court when the Mind Flayer comes to collect. But down below, in the dark, the future of the world is at stake.

seasons.name: Stranger Things 4
seasons.overview: Darkness returns to Hawkins just in time for spring break, igniting fresh terror, disturbing memories — and an ominous new threat.

episodes.name: Chapter One: The Hellfire Club
episodes.overview: El is bullied at school. Joyce opens a mysterious package. A scrappy player shakes up D&D night.

episodes.name: Chapter Two: Vecna's Curse
episodes.overview: A plane brings Mike to California — and a dead body brings Hawkins to a halt. Nancy goes looking for leads. A shaken Eddie tells the gang what he saw.

episodes.name: Chapter Three: The Monster and the Superhero
episodes.overview: Murray and Joyce fly to Alaska, and El faces serious consequences. Robin and Nancy dig up dirt on Hawkins' demons. Dr. Owens delivers sobering news.

episodes.name: Chapter Four: Dear Billy
episodes.overview: Max is in grave danger... and running out of time. A patient at Pennhurst asylum has visitors. Elsewhere, in Russia, Hopper is hard at work.

episodes.name: Chapter Five: The Nina Project
episodes.overview: Owens takes El to Nevada, where she's forced to confront her past, while the Hawkins kids comb a crumbling house for clues. Vecna claims another victim.

episodes.name: Chapter Six: The Dive
episodes.overview: Behind the Iron Curtain, a risky rescue mission gets underway. The California crew seeks help from a hacker. Steve takes one for the team.

episodes.name: Chapter Seven: The Massacre at Hawkins Lab
episodes.overview: As Hopper braces to battle a monster, Dustin dissects Vecna's motives — and decodes a message from beyond. El finds strength in a distant memory.

episodes.name: Chapter Eight: Papa
episodes.overview: Nancy has sobering visions, and El passes an important test. Back in Hawkins, the gang gathers supplies and prepares for battle.

episodes.name: Chapter Nine: The Piggyback
episodes.overview: With selfless hearts and a clash of metal, heroes fight from every corner of the battlefield to save Hawkins — and the world itself.

seasons.name: Stranger Things 5
seasons.overview: The fall of 1987. Hawkins is scarred by rifts. Vecna has vanished and the government has placed the town under military quarantine, forcing Eleven back into hiding. To end this nightmare, they'll need everyone together, one last time.

episodes.name: Chapter One: The Crawl
episodes.overview: November, 1987. The gang evades the military to scour the Upside Down for Vecna — but fails to notice a threat lurking closer to home.

episodes.name: Chapter Two: The Vanishing of...
episodes.overview: After a vicious attack at the Wheeler home, Mike and Nancy confront the cost of secrecy, while El and Hopper embark on a rescue mission.

episodes.name: Chapter Three: The Turnbow Trap
episodes.overview: Will gains unique insight into Vecna's next move, giving the crew an opportunity to set a trap. Holly explores her new surroundings.

episodes.name: Chapter Four: Sorcerer
episodes.overview: The military tightens its grip on the town. Mike, Lucas and Robin orchestrate a daring escape. El comes face-to-face with the enemy.

episodes.name: Chapter Eight: The Rightside Up
episodes.overview: The feature-length series finale to the coming-of-age sci-fi phenomenon. To end this nightmare, they'll need everyone — the full party — standing together, one last time.

shows.name: Talamasca: The Secret Order
shows.overview: Guy Anatole joins the clandestine world of the Talamasca, an international spy agency for the immortal universe, as he searches for answers to his family's own part in the supernatural world.

episodes.name: Preview
episodes.overview: Featuring exclusive interviews with Nicholas Denton, Elizabeth McGovern, William Fichtner and more.

episodes.name: Inside Talamasca: The Secret Order Season 1

episodes.name: We Watch. And We Are Always There.
episodes.overview: Guy is recruited to join a top-secret spy organization for the supernatural world. He must choose between his old life in the ordinary world and a new life as an undercover spy. Helen deals with trouble at the New York Mother House.

episodes.name: A Wilderness of Mirrors
episodes.overview: Guy joins the Talamasca, leaving his old life as a lawyer behind. Helen trains him on the ins and outs of undercover work. Guy is sent to London on his first mission - to follow a mysterious hit man.

episodes.name: The Task at Hand
episodes.overview: Guy questions his trust in Helen and the Talamasca in the wake of a dangerous mission. Helen tells Guy the story of the Seven Five Two and its place in the history of the supernatural world. New information comes to light.

episodes.name: Wet Work
episodes.overview: Guy breaks from his undercover identity and comes face to face with Jasper. Jasper puts Guy on a mission to find the Seven Five Two in the hotel of a local vampire coven. Helen continues to investigate her past.

episodes.name: The Puzzle Palace
episodes.overview: Jasper and Guy come head to head at the London Mother House. Helen's motives are questioned. Guy and Doris become closer. Loren and Ridge are on the verge of discovering an important revelation.

episodes.name: The 752
episodes.overview: In the wake of Jasper's actions against the Maida Vale, Ridge takes suspects into police custody. Helen discovers something important about her past. The truth of the 752 comes to light.

shows.name: Ted Lasso
shows.overview: Ted Lasso, an American football coach, moves to England when he's hired to manage a soccer team—despite having no experience. With cynical players and a doubtful town, will he get them to see the Ted Lasso Way?

episodes.name: The Missing Christmas Mustache
episodes.overview: Ted and the crew search for a lost item that ultimately leads him to realize the meaning of the holiday season.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Slowly but surely, Ted makes England his new home. Throughout the season, the down-on-their-luck players cannot help but be charmed and inspired by Ted. Even team owner Rebecca Welton who initially hired Ted to tank the team’s chances and to annoy her cheating ex-husband, was moved by Ted’s boyish innocence, determination, and outrageous tea biscuits.

episodes.name: Pilot
episodes.overview: American football coach Ted Lasso is hired by a wealthy divorcée to coach the English soccer team AFC Richmond.

episodes.name: Biscuits
episodes.overview: It's Ted's first day of coaching, and fans aren't happy. He makes little headway but remains undeterred as the team plays its first match.

episodes.name: Trent Crimm: The Independent
episodes.overview: To arrange an in-depth exposé, Rebecca pairs cynical journalist Trent Crimm with Ted for a day. Ted and Roy venture into the community.

episodes.name: For the Children
episodes.overview: Rebecca hosts the team's annual charity benefit, where Ted stages a reconciliation between Roy and Jamie.

episodes.name: Tan Lines
episodes.overview: With his wife and son visiting from America, Ted makes drastic changes to the lineup during a critical match.

episodes.name: Two Aces
episodes.overview: When Jamie refuses to train, Ted turns to talented new signing Dani Rojas—and the team is struck by an age-old curse.

episodes.name: Make Rebecca Great Again
episodes.overview: Rebecca celebrates her first anniversary as a divorcée as the team plays a match in Liverpool.

episodes.name: The Diamond Dogs
episodes.overview: Ted and Roy are both having relationship problems. Ted consults the Diamond Dogs while Roy has a talk with Keeley.

episodes.name: All Apologies
episodes.overview: After a series of mistakes on the pitch, pressure mounts to bench Roy. Rebecca drops a bombshell.

episodes.name: The Hope That Kills You
episodes.overview: Richmond plays a climactic match that will determine the fates of Ted and his club.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Season 2 will no doubt be a redemption story. While the team will face struggles, Ted’s illuminating, yet often frustrating kindness will encourage the team to move forward. As Ted believes, everything will work out the way it’s supposed to. Struggling to adjust to their lower league status, Ted focuses the team’s attention toward leaving behind their losing streak. Ted adjusts to his life without his now ex-wife Michelle and his young son, Henry, who have returned to the US. A psychologist named Sharon joins the team. The lovable Keeley Jones and newly retired Roy Kent continue dating. Roy is adjusting to his new life on the sidelines. As for Rebecca Welton starts dating again.

episodes.name: Goodbye Earl
episodes.overview: AFC Richmond brings in a sports psychologist to help the team overcome their unprecedented seven game tie-streak.

episodes.name: Lavender
episodes.overview: Ted is surprised by the reappearance of a familiar face. Roy tries out a new gig.

episodes.name: Do the Right-est Thing
episodes.overview: Rebecca has a special visitor shadow her at work. A player's return is not welcomed by the team.

episodes.name: Carol of the Bells
episodes.overview: It's Christmas in Richmond. Rebecca enlists Ted for a secret mission, Roy and Keeley search for a miracle, and the Higginses open up their home.

episodes.name: Rainbow
episodes.overview: Nate learns how to be assertive from Keeley and Rebecca. Ted asks Roy for a favor.

episodes.name: The Signal
episodes.overview: Ted is fired up that the new team dynamic seems to be working. But will they have a chance in the quarterfinal?

episodes.name: Headspace
episodes.overview: With things turning around for Richmond, it's time for everyone to work on their issues—like Ted's discomfort, Nate's confidence, and Roy's attention.

episodes.name: Man City
episodes.overview: Ted and Dr. Sharon realize they might have to meet each other halfway. Tensions are high as the team prepares for the semifinal.

episodes.name: Beard After Hours
episodes.overview: After the semifinal, Beard sets out on an all-night odyssey through London in an effort to collect his thoughts.

episodes.name: No Weddings and a Funeral
episodes.overview: Rebecca is stunned by a sudden loss. The team rallies to show their support, but Ted finds himself grappling with a piece of his past.

episodes.name: Midnight Train to Royston
episodes.overview: A billionaire football enthusiast from Ghana makes Sam an unbelievable offer. Ted plans something special for Dr. Sharon's last day with the team.

episodes.name: Inverting the Pyramid of Success
episodes.overview: Richmond gets their final chance to win promotion as Ted deals with the fallout of Trent Crimm's painfully honest exposé.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: In this third season, the newly-promoted AFC Richmond faces ridicule as media predictions widely peg them as last in the Premier League and Nate, now hailed as the "wonder kid," has gone to work for Rupert at West Ham United. In the wake of Nate's contentious departure from Richmond, Roy Kent steps up as assistant coach, alongside Beard. Meanwhile, while Ted deals with pressures at work, he continues to wrestle with his own personal issues back home, Rebecca is focused on defeating Rupert and Keeley navigates being the boss of her own PR agency. Things seem to be falling apart both on and off the pitch, but Team Lasso is set to give it their best shot anyway.

episodes.name: Smells Like Mean Spirit
episodes.overview: The newly promoted AFC Richmond face mockery as pundits predict they'll finish dead last this season.

episodes.name: (I Don't Want to Go to) Chelsea
episodes.overview: News of a top player looking to move to London sends the English clubs into a frenzy. Richmond play their first game back in the Premier League.
Richmond adjust to an exciting change, but Jamie has reservations. Ted learns there's something new going on back in Kansas as well.

episodes.name: Big Week
episodes.overview: Everyone's feeling the pressure as Richmond gear up to play West Ham. Ted is reunited with an old friend.

episodes.name: Signs
episodes.overview: With their season in a tailspin, Richmond try to right the ship against mighty Manchester City. Off the pitch, everyone faces their own setbacks.

episodes.name: Sunflowers
episodes.overview: A friendly match takes the team to Amsterdam, where one night out unlocks truths for many.

episodes.name: The Strings That Bind Us
episodes.overview: The Greyhounds try a new strategy that has everyone thinking outside the box. Sam prepares to host a VIP guest at Ola's.

episodes.name: We'll Never Have Paris
episodes.overview: While watching Henry, Ted fights the urge to spiral when Michelle and Dr. Jacob go on a romantic trip. An online leak has massive implications for Keeley.

episodes.name: La Locker Room Aux Folles
episodes.overview: Colin and Isaac's friendship is tested. Roy is asked to do a press conference.

episodes.name: International Break
episodes.overview: While some of the Greyhounds head home to play for their countries in international matches, Edwin Akufo brings a business proposal to Rebecca.

episodes.name: Mom City
episodes.overview: An unexpected guest has Ted on edge. When Richmond travel to Manchester for a big match, Roy and Keeley become concerned about Jamie.

episodes.name: So Long, Farewell
episodes.overview: AFC Richmond play their final game of the season.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: In season 4, Ted returns to Richmond to coach a second division women's team. Throughout the course of the season, Ted and the team learn to leap before they look, taking chances they never thought they would.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: In 1795, three teenage boys discovered a strange, man-made depression in the ground on Oak Island–a small, wooded island just off the coast of Nova Scotia, Canada. As the boys began to dig, they found a number of intriguing artifacts. It was the end of the piracy era and rumors of buried treasure were rampant. The boys’ discovery launched a treasure hunt that has spanned more than 200 years.The search had gone dormant, but last year, Rick and Marty Lagina, two brothers from Michigan with a life-long interest in the mystery, renewed the efforts to discover the legendary treasure.

episodes.name: What Lies Below
episodes.overview: Brothers Rick and Marty Lagina now own most of the mysterious Oak Island. Determined to resurrect the 200 year old search for treasure, they explore an abandoned shaft called 10-X. What they find gives them reason to believe that the stories of something buried on the island may very well be true.
