shows.name: The Last Frontier
shows.overview: When a prison transport plane crashes in the remote Alaskan wilderness—freeing dozens of violent inmates—the region's lone marshal must protect the town he's vowed to keep safe.

episodes.name: Blue Skies
episodes.overview: An unprecedented emergency sends Fairbanks into lockdown. Frank gathers every resource available to mount a full-scale response.

episodes.name: Wind of Change
episodes.overview: Luke tries to get back home as the manhunt for Havlock intensifies. Frank weighs whether he should give in to a set of demands.

episodes.name: Country as F**k
episodes.overview: Sarah's disappearance adds urgency to Frank's search. Havlock's master plan takes an unexpected turn, increasing the number of hostages.

episodes.name: American Dream
episodes.overview: A state trooper goes missing, widening Frank's investigation. Armed locals join the manhunt. Sarah grows concerned over Luke's whereabouts.

episodes.name: Arnaq
episodes.overview: Frank focuses on tracking down Luke. The CIA's involvement ramps up as Havlock's plan enters a new phase.

episodes.name: The Devil Wears a Suit and Tie
episodes.overview: Fairbanks is hit with a mass power outage. Sarah spots someone suspicious in the ER. Sidney tries to get control of a key piece of evidence.

episodes.name: Change of Time
episodes.overview: A mysterious new suspect is interrogated. Frank's secret comes to light. Havlock works on retrieving the contents of his hard drive.

episodes.name: L'air Perdu
episodes.overview: Sidney learns about her father's past, the Atwater Protocol, and the classified intel in Archive 6.

episodes.name: Converge
episodes.overview: Bradford lands in Fairbanks with a CIA task force and new primary target. Sidney makes a desperate attempt to expose the truth.

episodes.name: Everything Trying
episodes.overview: Sidney and Havlock risk it all to gain possession of the archive. Frank sets out on a life-saving mission.

shows.name: The Librarians: The Next Chapter
shows.overview: A Librarian from the past time travels to the present and finds himself stuck here. When he returns to his castle, which is now a museum, he inadvertently releases magic across the continent. He is given a new team to help him clean up the mess he made, forming a new team of Librarians.

episodes.name: And the Deadly Drekavac
episodes.overview: When a Librarian from 200 years ago reappears today, he brings back to life a long-closed magical Library and accidentally resurrects an evil Drekavac. The Librarian, along with a quickly assembled team, must stop the Drekavac before it can kill and multiply.

episodes.name: And the Dance of Doom
episodes.overview: Our newly assembled Librarians crew investigates a mysterious "dancing sickness," leading them to a showdown with a powerful magical factioneer at a professional ballet company.

episodes.name: And the Ghost Train
episodes.overview: Half of the team becomes trapped on a runaway ghost train, and the rest of the team must help solve the unresolved business of the ghosts on board.

episodes.name: And the Thief of Love
episodes.overview: The Librarians head to Paris after a string of robberies leaves mysteriously lovestruck victims in their wake.

episodes.name: And the Memory Crystal
episodes.overview: The team goes to a college campus with a world-class observatory to discover who is using the Crystal of Dr. John Dee to steal people's memories, in order to own the future.

episodes.name: And the House of Cards
episodes.overview: When the magic door reroutes Charlie, Lysa and Connor to a bizarre manor where a series of Agatha Christie-style murders take place, they must figure out whodunnit, while Vikram tries to track them down with the help of a mysterious tarot card reader.

episodes.name: And the Con-Con
episodes.overview: Connor is forced to reconnect with people from his pre-Library life, and must defeat an old adversary who has grown powerful in his absence.

episodes.name: And the Hangover from Hell
episodes.overview: After a wild bachelorette party with Lysa's childhood best friend, the team wakes up in rough shape and hungover, with no idea how they ended up where they are.

episodes.name: And the Feast of the Vampir
episodes.overview: While on a visit to a small-town festival, Connor encounters the very first vampire, and finds himself fighting the clock to save himself from turning into one.

episodes.name: And Going Medieval
episodes.overview: When Vikram attempts to return to 1847 (via a homemade time machine), he inadvertently travels the entire team back to the days of King Arthur, where they learn the truth about a Knight of the Round Table, Camelot, and ... Elaine.

episodes.name: And the Graffiti of the Gods
episodes.overview: When graffiti starts coming to life and threatening a teenage girl, the team have to work out how these strange events are related to Gregor's Hammer -- and the imminent return of Gregor himself.

episodes.name: And the Unfinished Business
episodes.overview: General Gregor retrieves the Sword of Mars and uses it to take over the country of Caucasylvia (remember from the Train episode), gaining control of their nuclear arsenal. The team must steal the Sword to prevent world calamity.

shows.name: The Masked Singer
shows.overview: Celebrities compete in a singing competition with one major twist: each singer is shrouded from head to toe in an elaborate costume, complete with full face mask to conceal his or her identity. One singer will be eliminated each week, ultimately revealing his or her true identity.

episodes.name: Super Sneak Peek
episodes.overview: Host Nick Cannon and panelists Ken Jeong, Jenny McCarthy, Nicole Scherzinger and Robin Thicke reflect on the show's impact on pop culture; T-Pain makes a special appearance; Season 2's characters are introduced.

episodes.name: Season Premiere: Mask On Face Off
episodes.overview: Six undercover celebrity singers don animal masks to conceal their identity as they perform before host Nick Cannon and panelists Ken Jeong, Jenny McCarthy, Nicole Scherzinger, and Robin Thicke, who try to guess the identity of the singer.

episodes.name: New Masks on the Block
episodes.overview: The 12 competing mystery celebrities have a collection of noteworthy accomplishments between them, such as earning over 60 Grammy nominations, 16 Emmy nominations, four Hollywood Walk of Fame stars, four Super Bowl titles and nine Broadway shows.

episodes.name: Five Masks No More
episodes.overview: The undercover celebrity singers from the series premiere episode take the stage for their second performances. Joel McHale joins as a guest panelist.

episodes.name: Another Mask Bites the Dust
episodes.overview: Guest panelist Joel McHale returns to help figure out who is behind the mask.

episodes.name: Mix and Masks
episodes.overview: The first group of celebrity singers return to the stage to perform individually and as a group to keep themselves in the competition.

episodes.name: Touchy Feely Clues
episodes.overview: The remaining celebrity singers hit the stage to perform and keep themselves masked.

episodes.name: All Together Now
episodes.overview: Actor-comic J.B. Smoove joins as a guest panelist before the remaining six celebrity singers come together for the first time to form one large group.

episodes.name: Semi Finals: Double Unmasking
episodes.overview: Only the top three singers are left after a double unmasking; actor Kenan Thompson serves as a guest panelist.

episodes.name: Road to the Finals
episodes.overview: Before the winner is crowned at the finals, a look back at the best performances on The Masked Singer from season one.

episodes.name: Season Finale: The Final Mask is Lifted
episodes.overview: The three remaining finalists compete for the golden mask, and their identities are revealed; guest panelist Kenan Thompson.

episodes.name: Return of the Masks: Groups A & B
episodes.overview: The first eight undercover celebrity singers face off against one another in head-to-toe costumes. Nick Cannon introduces the first four contestants - Butterfly, Egg, Thingamajig and Skeleton.

episodes.name: Return of the Masks: Group C
episodes.overview: Four new celebrity singers face off against one another. Nick Cannon introduces four more contestants: Black Widow, Leopard, Flamingo and Panda.

episodes.name: Return of the Masks: Group D
episodes.overview: Four new celebrity singers face off against one another. Nick Cannon introduces four more mystery contestants: Flower, Penguin, Eagle, and Fox.

episodes.name: Once Upon a Mask
episodes.overview: Six celebrities take the stage for their second performance. Flamingo, Leopard, Black Widow, Skeleton, Thingamajig and Butterfly perform.

episodes.name: Mask Us Anything
episodes.overview: Six celebrities take the stage for their next performance of the season. Rottweiler, Ladybug, Tree, Penguin, Flower and Fox perform.

episodes.name: Mask-ish
episodes.overview: Actor, comedian, writer and game show host Anthony Anderson joins host Nick Cannon and the panellists as five Hollywood stars perform.

episodes.name: Triumph Over Masks
episodes.overview: Triumph the Insult Comic Dog guest judges. Fox, Ladybug, Flower, Tree and Rottweiler perform.

episodes.name: Mask and You Shall Receive
episodes.overview: Flamingo, Leopard, Flower and Rottweiler perform.

episodes.name: Clash of the Masks
episodes.overview: Four more of the remaining celebrities - Thingamajig, Fox, Tree and Butterfly - take on their next round of dazzling performances.

episodes.name: A Pain in the Mask
episodes.overview: The six remaining contestants compete together for the first time -- with one celebrity unwrapped.

episodes.name: Two Masks Take It Off: Holiday Semi-Finals
episodes.overview: The  five remaining masked celebrities compete for a spot in the finals; two celebrities are unwrapped.

episodes.name: Road to the Finals
episodes.overview: Before the winner is crowned at the finals, a look back at the best performances on The Masked Singer from season two.

episodes.name: Season Finale: And The Winner Takes It All and Takes It Off
episodes.overview: The three finalists go head-to-head as they each try to get their hands on the golden trophy; the contestants are unmasked.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: This season, the 18 fully disguised celebrity singers will be split into three groups of six: Group A, Group B and Group C. Group A will kick off the first three episodes as they are whittled down to three singers, taking off masks as they go. Then Group B will take the stage as they go from six to three, then Group C. The final nine masked contestants from all three groups will then come together as they continue to battle for the Golden Mask Trophy. Season Three will introduce all-new custom-made costumes for the celebrity singers to wear, including The Robot, The Frog, The Banana, The Mouse, Miss Monster and The Llama, among others.

episodes.name: The Season Kick off Mask Off: Group A
episodes.overview: Television’s biggest guessing game returns right after the biggest football game. Superstar Jamie Foxx joins the panel as guest judge as White Tiger, Turtle, Llama, Miss Monster, Kangaroo and Robot perform.

episodes.name: The Playoffs: Group A
episodes.overview: The first contestants, Llama, Miss Monster, White Tiger, Kangaroo, and Turtle, perform again for guest judge Jason Biggs and the rest of the panel; one of the singers is unmasked and sent home.

episodes.name: Masking For A Friend: Group A
episodes.overview: The Group A contestants, Llama, Miss Monster, White Tiger, Kangaroo and Turtle, perform a third time for the panel as they are whittled down to three.

episodes.name: A Brand New Six Pack: Group B Kickoff!
episodes.overview: A second batch of celebrities, Group B, hit the stage - Frog, Elephant, Kitty, Taco, Mouse, and Banana.

episodes.name: Mask-Matics: Group B Playoffs
episodes.overview: Banana, Mouse, Frog, Taco, and Kitty perform for guest judge Gabriel Iglesias and the rest of the panel.

episodes.name: Friends in High Places: Group B Championships
episodes.overview: Kitty, Taco, Banana, and Frog perform for guest judge T-Pain and the rest of the panel as they are whittled down to three

episodes.name: Last But Not Least: Group C Kickoff!
episodes.overview: Group C of the celebrities hit the stage - Night Angel, Bear, Astronaut, T-Rex, Rhino and Swan perform.

episodes.name: It Never Hurts to Mask: Group C Playoffs
episodes.overview: Astronaut, Night Angel, T-Rex, Swan, and Rhino perform for guest judge Joel McHale and the rest of the panel in the Group C playoffs

episodes.name: Old Friends, New Clues: Group C Championships
episodes.overview: Night Angel, Astronaut, T-Rex, and Rhino perform for guest judge Will Arnett and the rest of the panel as they are whittled down to three

episodes.name: The Super Nine Masked Singer Special: Groups A, B & C
episodes.overview: The finalists from all three groups come together for one mega-competition; a singer is unmasked.

episodes.name: The Mother Of All Final Face Offs, Part 1
episodes.overview: Four of the remaining singers pair off to battle on stage; guest panelist Yvette Nicole Brown.

episodes.name: The Mother of All Final Face Offs, Part 2
episodes.overview: Frog, Kitty, Banana, and Rhino perform for guest judge Sharon Osbourne and the rest of the panel.

episodes.name: After the Mask: The Mother of All Final Face Offs, Part 2
episodes.overview: Nick Cannon and celebrity guests discuss the night's best moments.

episodes.name: The Battle of the Sixes: The Final 6
episodes.overview: Kitty, Rhino, Frog, Night Angel, Astronaut, and Turtle perform for guest judge Gordon Ramsay and the rest of the panel.

episodes.name: After the Mask: The Battle of the Sixes: The Final 6
episodes.overview: Nick Cannon and celebrity guests discuss the night's best moments.

episodes.name: A Quarter Mask Crisis: The Quarter Finals
episodes.overview: Frog, Kitty, Rhino, Night Angel, and Turtle perform for guest judge and comedian Jeff Dye and the rest of the panel.

episodes.name: After the Mask: A Quarter Mask Crisis: The Quarter Finals
episodes.overview: Nick Cannon and celebrity guests discuss the night's best moments.

episodes.name: A Day in the Mask: The Semi Finals
episodes.overview: Comic Jay Pharoah joins the panelists; one singer is unmasked.

episodes.name: After the Mask: A Day in the Mask: The Semi Finals
episodes.overview: Celebrity guests discuss the night's best moments, stunts, games and impromptu musical performances.

episodes.name: Road to the Finals
episodes.overview: Fan-favorite moments and performances from all 18 singers throughout the season. Plus, messages of love and encouragement from panelists and celebrities involved across all three seasons.

episodes.name: Couldn't Mask For Anything More: The Grand Finale!
episodes.overview: The final three go head-to-head to be crowned the winner, each hoping to impress the judges and take home the golden mask trophy. One by one, their identities are revealed, including the winner.

episodes.name: The Season Premiere -- The Masks Return
episodes.overview: A brand-new masked bunch of celebrity singers face off against one another in dazzling head-to-toe costumes; a singer is unmasked. — These masked celebrities have stars on the Hollywood Walk Of Fame, have sung at NFL Super Bowls and have a combined 281 million record sales between them. Can you guess who is behind the mask?

episodes.name: The Group B Premiere -- Six More Masks
episodes.overview: Six more contestants are introduced, and the panel try to guess the identity of Crocodile, Baby Alien, Seahorse, Whatchamacallit, Serpent and Gremlin. At the end of the show, one singer is unmasked and sent home.

episodes.name: The Group A Play Offs - Famous Masked Words
episodes.overview: Contestants return for the Group A playoffs and their second performances for their chance to progress in the competition.

episodes.name: The Group B Play Offs -- Cloudy With a Chance of Clues
episodes.overview: The contestants return for the Group B playoffs and their second performances of the season.

episodes.name: The Group C Premiere -- Masked But Not Least
episodes.overview: The final group of celebrity contestants take the stage for their first performances of Season 4.

episodes.name: The Group C Play Offs -- Funny You Should Mask
episodes.overview: The Group C contestants return for their second performance of the season.

episodes.name: The Group A Finals -- The Masked Frontier
episodes.overview: The final three singers from group A take the stage for their final chance at the super six; one singer is unmasked.

episodes.name: The Group B Finals: The Mask Chance Saloon
episodes.overview: The remaining four singers from "Group B" compete for a chance to advance, but with room for only two in the "Super Six," two celebrities must be unmasked.

episodes.name: The Group C Finals: The Masks Give Thanks
episodes.overview: Get an extra helping of America's favorite guessing game, when the final three singers from "Group C" compete for the final two spots in the "Super Six".

episodes.name: The Semi Finals: The Super Six
episodes.overview: The Masked Singer "Super Six" hit the stage, as the finalists from all three groups come together for the semi-finals and one not-to-be-missed super competition.

episodes.name: The Holiday Sing-a-Long
episodes.overview: The final three singers perform never-before-heard holiday songs, with all-new animated clues; the already unmasked celebrities join together to perform their favorite holiday jingles.

episodes.name: Road to the Finals
episodes.overview: A look back at the best moments and performances from Season 4.

episodes.name: The Season 4 Finale  Last Mask Standing
episodes.overview: The three finalists perform one last time before all are unmasked and one singer takes home the trophy.

seasons.name: Season 5
seasons.overview: The Season Five contestants boast a combined 26 Grammy Award nominations, nine multi-Platinum singles, four Academy Award nominations, three Super Bowl appearances, six gold medals and two world records! All will be unmasked, but only one will win the coveted Golden Mask Trophy.

episodes.name: Season 5 Premiere: Return of the Masks
episodes.overview: THE MASKED SINGER returns in its game-changing fifth season, with all-new jaw-dropping costumes, surprise appearances and unexpected twists that will upend the competition. In the season premiere, "Group A" performs as guest host Niecy Nash takes the stage.

episodes.name: Group B Premiere: Shamrock and Roll
episodes.overview: Meet the second group of costumed celebrities, Group "B," in another set of all-new jaw-dropping costumes.

episodes.name: Group A Wildcard Round: Enter The Wildcards
episodes.overview: The highly anticipated, first-ever Wildcard character enters the competition, when the members of Group "A" return to the stage for their second performances of the season.

episodes.name: Group B Wildcard Round: Rule of Claw!
episodes.overview: As if one wildcard entering the ring wasn't enough to shake up the competition, another wildcard contestant debuts when the members of Group "B" return for their second performances of the season and the wildcard's chance to steal a spot in the competition.

episodes.name: Group B Finals: The Ulti 'Mutt' Wildcard!
episodes.overview: Group "B" returns to the stage as the remaining singers battle it out for their spot in the Super Eight! Another wildcard enters the competition for a chance to steal a spot in the game.

episodes.name: Group A Finals: In the Nick of Time!
episodes.overview: Find out who will round out the Super Eight with the Group "A" finals, when one celebrity is unmasked from Group "A" and the remaining singers advance! Meanwhile, another wildcard enters the competition for the chance to steal a spot in the game.

episodes.name: Super 8: The Plot Chickens
episodes.overview: The Top Four singers both from Group "A" and Group "B" unite for the big sing-off in the Super Eight, two-hour, double elimination episode of America's favorite guessing game.

episodes.name: The Sing-A-Long: The Maskie Awards
episodes.overview: For the first time ever, Nick Cannon hosts "The Maskie Awards," a special sing-a-long episode celebrating the "best of" Season Five.

episodes.name: The Spicy 6: The Competition Heats Up!
episodes.overview: The competition is heating up, as the Final Six sing for the golden mask trophy. Special guest panelist Chrissy Metz ("This is Us") brings her vocal expertise to the show for the first time ever.

episodes.name: The Quarter Finals: Five Fan Favorites
episodes.overview: As the competition nears the finish line, the final five singers perform in the quarter-finals to see who will advance to the semi-finals.

episodes.name: Semifinals
episodes.overview: The final four singers sing their hearts out in the semi-finals and Cluedle-Doo finally reveals himself in a not-to-be-missed unmasking.

episodes.name: Finale
episodes.overview: All three remaining singers will perform, all three will be unmasked, but only one singer will be awarded the Golden Mask Trophy in the Season Five finale.

seasons.name: Season 6
seasons.overview: The Season Six contestants boast a combined 85 Grammy Nominations and 27 wins, three Academy Award nominations, 12 Emmy Nominations, 12 Razzie Award Nominations, two Super Bowl appearances and two Lifetime Achievement Awards.

episodes.name: 2 Night Season Premiere, Part 1: Group A Premiere
episodes.overview: The Season Six contestants boast a combined 85 Grammy Nominations and 27 wins, three Academy Award nominations, 12 Emmy Nominations, 12 Razzie Award Nominations, two Super Bowl appearances and two Lifetime Achievement Awards.

episodes.name: 2-Night Season Premiere, Part 2: Back to School
episodes.overview: On Night Two of the special two-night season premiere, Group A returns and is joined by TWO all-new Wildcard contestants for a competition unlike any other, as one more will be unmasked at the end of the night.

episodes.name: Group B Premiere
episodes.overview: Meet the second group of celebrity singers, "Group B," in all-new jaw-dropping costumes and see WHO will be unmasked!

episodes.name: House Party
episodes.overview: The "Group A" members return, and a new wildcard enters the game.

episodes.name: Date Night
episodes.overview: The characters from Group B return for their second performances of the season, and a new wildcard enters the game.

episodes.name: Time Warp
episodes.overview: The Group A celebrities take the stage and another wildcard enters the game

episodes.name: All-Time Countdown
episodes.overview: A special countdown of the greatest performances in the show's history. Watch never-before-seen, behind-the-scenes footage of the unmasked singers from Season 6, while new hints and clues are dropped for those who have yet to be revealed.

episodes.name: Giving Thanks
episodes.overview: The singers from "Group B" return to the stage in a special Thanksgiving-themed episode and the final wild card enters the competition. Joel McHale is back as a guest panelist to keep Ken in check.

episodes.name: Group A Semi-Final
episodes.overview: The final four "Group A" singers will compete in the semifinals and two will be eliminated from the competition. Will.i.am brings his expertise to the panelists' desk and assists Ken Jeong, Jenny McCarthy, Nicole Scherzinger and Robin Thicke breaking down all the clues on America's favorite guessing game.

episodes.name: Group B Semi-Final
episodes.overview: The final four "Group B" singers will compete in the semifinals and two will be eliminated from the competition.

episodes.name: Group A Finale
episodes.overview: The final two singers from "Group A" perform solo, and then with celebrity duet partners Jesse McCartney and Michael Bolton, before one is unmasked and sent home.

episodes.name: Group B Finale
episodes.overview: The final two singers from "Group B" perform solo, and then with celebrity duet partners and show panelists Nicole Scherzinger and Robin Thicke, before one is unmasked and sent home.

episodes.name: Grand Finale (1)
episodes.overview: The final two singers -- the winner from group A and the winner from group B -- perform. [Part 1 of 2]

episodes.name: Grand Finale (2)
episodes.overview: The final two singers -- the winner from group A and the winner from group B -- perform and both are unmasked; one singer is awarded the Golden Mask Trophy. [Part 2 of 2]

episodes.name: The Masked Singer Christmas Singalong
episodes.overview: A Christmas extravaganza, with never-before-seen holiday performances from favorite contestants.

episodes.name: Masks Back: The Good, The Bad & The Cuddly, Round 1
episodes.overview: TV's favorite guessing game returns with an all-new twist -- each new costume will be categorized in one of three groups: The Good, The Bad or The Cuddly. In Round One of Season Seven, characters from each category will duke it out to further themselves in the competition.

episodes.name: Masks at Dawn, Round 1
episodes.overview: The remaining four singers from "Group A" return to the stage for their second performances of the season. One will be unmasked and three will move on to the "Group A" finals.

episodes.name: The Double Unmasking, Round 1 Finals
episodes.overview: "Group A" returns for one final time when the three finalists perform. Two will be unmasked and only one will move on to the finale.

episodes.name: Masking For It: The Good, The Bad & The Cuddly, Round 2
episodes.overview: A brand-new group of contestants take the stage for the first time, each representing Team Good, Team Bad, or Team Cuddly! These new singers kick off Round One of the battle to keep their masks on and make it to the season finale.

episodes.name: Masking for a Duel, Round 2
episodes.overview: Round Two continues, as the remaining four singers in this group return to battle for their second performances.

episodes.name: The Double Mask Off, Round 2 Finals
episodes.overview: The three remaining singers from Round Two will compete for their spot in the finale. Leslie Jordan will bring the funny to the panelists' desk, as it's revealed who will move on from Team Good, Team Bad, and Team Cuddly!

episodes.name: Don't Mask, Don't Tell: The Good, The Bad, & The Cuddly
episodes.overview: A brand-new group of five singers is introduced in the third and final round of the season. Characters from Team Good, Team Bad and Team Cuddly take the stage for the first time and one will be unmasked.

episodes.name: The Mask of Least Resistance, Round 3
episodes.overview: Round Three continues, as the four remaining singers duke it out for Team Good, Team Bad and Team Cuddly. One singer will be unmasked and the final three move on to the Round Three finals.

episodes.name: One Mask Hurrah, Round 3 Finals
episodes.overview: In the third and final round of the competition, the final three singers perform for the last remaining coveted spot this season. Two singers will be unmasked and the final singer will move on to the Season Seven finale.

episodes.name: Road to the Finals
episodes.overview: Before a winner is crowned, take a journey through Season Seven with all of The Good, The Bad and The Cuddly characters. Relive some of the most talked-about moments, watch the best performances and don't miss never-seen-before clues.

episodes.name: Season Finale
episodes.overview: Who will take the golden mask trophy? The winner from each of the three rounds will compete head-to-head in the Season Seven finale. Only one will take home the trophy: will it be a singer from Team Good, Team Bad or Team Cuddly?

seasons.name: Season 8
seasons.overview: The formatting for the season sees three contestants battle in each episode, with one eliminated mid-show while the other two battle out. A king/queen is crowned at the end of each episode who then moves on to the following episode, while the other in the top two gets eliminated. The season also includes themed nights for the first time.

episodes.name: A Royal Season Premiere
episodes.overview: Four celebrities perform, with only one contestant moving on to the next week. Introducing: Harp, Hedgehog, Hummingbird, and Knight.

episodes.name: Vegas Night
episodes.overview: Blue Man Group, jugglers and more visit the show to welcome two new celebrity singers for their first performances of the season; two new characters enter the game and two are unmasked. Introducing: Panther and Pi-Rat.

episodes.name: TV Theme Night
episodes.overview: Two new celebrity singers enter the competition and perform iconic theme songs from TV shows throughout history; two unmaskings.

episodes.name: Andrew Lloyd Webber Night
episodes.overview: Two new celebrity singers enter the competition and perform songs from Andrew Lloyd Webber's legendary music catalog; guest panelist Andrew Lloyd Webber.

episodes.name: Muppets Night
episodes.overview: Miss Piggy serves as a guest panelist, with special appearances and performances by Kermit the Frog, Animal, Fozzie Bear and more Muppet favorites.

episodes.name: '90s Night
episodes.overview: Two new characters enter the competition; the studio audience votes for one singer to be unmasked.

episodes.name: Hall of Fame Night
episodes.overview: Three new characters enter the competition and two are unmasked; guest panelists Leslie Jordan and Joel McHale.

episodes.name: Comedy Roast Night
episodes.overview: The panelists roast one another as two new characters enter the competition; guest appearances by Drew Carey and Jon Lovitz.

episodes.name: Fright Night
episodes.overview: Two new contestants enter the competition, and two are unmasked.

episodes.name: Battle of the Semi Finals
episodes.overview: Three contestants have sung their way to the Semi Finals and for the first time, a three-way battle ensues. One contestant will be eliminated and the remaining two will advance to the finals.

episodes.name: Epic Finale, Pt 1
episodes.overview: Before the winner is crowned, a look back at the best performances on The Masked Singer from season eight.

episodes.name: Epic Finale, Pt 2
episodes.overview: Both finalists sing their hearts out one last time, with only one taking home the trophy.

episodes.name: Opening Night
episodes.overview: TV's favorite guessing game returns with all-new singers, all-new themed episodes and the "Champion of the Masked Singer" style competition. Every episode features sudden elimination and double unmaskings, but there is a new twist entering the competition this season: for the first time ever, panelists will have the opportunity to save a singer from looming elimination with the "Ding Dong Keep it On" Bell.

episodes.name: ABBA Night
episodes.overview: Mamma Mia - it's ABBA night on The Masked Singer! This week's episode is full of pop rock and disco nostalgia, as the reigning champ takes on two new celebrity singers, each performing iconic songs - including "Dancing Queen," "Fernando" and S.O.S." - from the one and only Swedish supergroup, ABBA.

episodes.name: New York Night
episodes.overview: The Masked Singer celebrates the Big Apple! This week's episode embraces both the glam and the grit of the city that never sleeps, as two new contestants take on the reigning champ from last week and sing a collection of songs synonymous with the history of New York.

episodes.name: DC Superheroes Night
episodes.overview: Three new singers enter the game on DC Superheroes night. While the audience and panelists celebrate their favorite iconic DC Superheroes in costume, celebrities vie for their chance at the champion of The Masked Singer in three brand-new costumes!

episodes.name: Sesame Street Night
episodes.overview: Elmo, Big Bird, Cookie Monster, Oscar the Grouch, The Count and Abby Cadabby bring the fun in a special Sesame Street episode.

episodes.name: Country Night
episodes.overview: Grab the cowboy boots and cowboy hats because The Masked Singer has gone country! Three celebrities will perform their favorite country songs, two will be unmasked, but only one singer will advance straight to the quarterfinals with California Roll.

episodes.name: '80s Night
episodes.overview: The Masked Singer goes retro with a trip back to the 80s! A brand-new group of singers belt out hit favorites from the neon decade, but only one will move forward in the competition as the other two unmask!

episodes.name: WB Movie Night
episodes.overview: Get your popcorn and settle in as The Masked Singer celebrates the cinema! The costumed celebrities perform iconic songs from hit Warner Bros. films from their 100 years of movie magic.

episodes.name: Masked Singer in Space
episodes.overview: Houston, we have a problem! The Masked Singer is even more out-of-this-world than usual in a special "outer space" themed episode.

episodes.name: Supreme Six
episodes.overview: In this special episode of The Masked Singer, the road to the finals is underway as we recap the journeys of the three remaining champions and the three remaining underdogs, while also looking back on the season and who has been eliminated thus far.

episodes.name: Battle Of The Saved
episodes.overview: The three "Saved by the Bell" singers - Mantis, Gargoyle and Medusa - compete for their spot in the quarter finals! All three were saved by the new "Ding Dong, Keep It On!" bell, but now two will be unmasked and only one will go on to be named the Group Champion.

episodes.name: Quarter Finals
episodes.overview: It's the Quarter Finals on The Masked Singer, and the British are coming! Watch the final four compete for a spot in the coveted Semi-Finals, performing hit songs from artists across the pond. Only one will be unmasked!

episodes.name: Semi-Finals
episodes.overview: The remaining three celebrity singers perform, but only two move on to compete in the season finale.

episodes.name: Finale
episodes.overview: The final two contestants each perform two songs; one celebrity is crowned the Season 9 winner.

seasons.name: Season 10
seasons.overview: In honor of its milestone 10th season, "The Masked Singer" celebrates with the biggest and boldest costumes in the show's history -- with the buzziest and brightest celebrities underneath. The season features the return of special theme nights.

episodes.name: Season 10 Kickoff
episodes.overview: A special celebrity performance and reveal — one of the biggest unmaskings in the show’s history.

episodes.name: Season 10 Premiere
episodes.overview: Five celebrities perform and one is unmasked.

episodes.name: NFL Night
episodes.overview: Celebrating the NFL with songs that have been performed at the Super Bowl; Le'Veon Bell performs.

episodes.name: 2000s Night
episodes.overview: Five celebrities perform songs from the 2000s and one is unmasked.

episodes.name: A Celebration of Elton John
episodes.overview: The singers celebrate the music of Sir Elton John. Robin Thicke opens the show with a performance of “Tiny Dancer.”

episodes.name: Harry Potter Night
episodes.overview: A special Harry Potter-themed episode; former contestant Adrienne Bailon-Houghton performs.

episodes.name: One Hit Wonders Night
episodes.overview: Who Let the Dogs Out? - it's one hit wonders night on The Masked Singer! The iconic competition series celebrates its milestone 10th season as the legacy continues with a special "One Hit Wonders Night" featuring four new celebrities singing a collection of songs that were once all the rage!

episodes.name: Trolls Night
episodes.overview: The Masked Singer cranks up the color with a night of nonstop pop, grooving to unforgettable boy band chart toppers to celebrate the release of Trolls Band Together, the newest chapter in the blockbuster musical franchise. The Trolls stars, Poppy and Branch, infiltrate the sound studio, delivering a glittery opening song and sneaking special clues to the panel.

episodes.name: Disco Night
episodes.overview: Can you dig it? It's time to boogie as The Masked Singer celebrates the Disco era, kicking off with a special performance by the legendary disco band The Trammps. Group A returns for their final competition and two will be unmasked - unless the panel uses the Ding Dong Keep It On Bell!

episodes.name: I Wanna Rock
episodes.overview: The Masked Singer is with the band! Tonight, the show celebrates Rock 'n' Roll as the Group B finalists rock out to legendary songs from bands like Kiss, Jon Bon Jovi and Mr. Big. The Masked Singer's very own Banana from Season 3 and legendary Poison front man, Bret Michaels, gives a special performance. Two celebrities will be unmasked leaving only one to move on to the season finale.

episodes.name: Holiday Sing-Along
episodes.overview: Holiday splendor and masked merriment collide in this beloved yuletide special featuring all-new jaw-dropping surprise performances from Season 10 contestants, spectacular sing-along fun from Masked Singer alumni and The Masked Singer carolers.

episodes.name: Soundtrack to My Life
episodes.overview: It's the Group C Finals on The Masked Singer and tonight, the finalists perform songs representing key moment in their life, such as "Georgia on my Mind," "I'm Going Down," and "Johnny B Goode." Two celebrities will be unmasked leaving only one to move on to the season finale.

episodes.name: Season 10 Finale
episodes.overview: The final four contestants perform all-new songs before the audience and panel cast their votes. The bottom two singers unmask, and then the final two go head-to-head one last time. Only one will take home the Golden Mask trophy and be crowned the Season Ten Winner!

episodes.name: Season 11 Premiere: Rita We Love Your Ora
episodes.overview: The season premiere kicks off with an exciting performance by new panelist Rita Ora, special celebrity performances and a jaw-dropping reveal no one sees coming.

episodes.name: Group B Premiere: The Wizard of Oz Night
episodes.overview: Join us for a trip down the Yellow Brick Road on the "The Wizard of Oz" night on The Masked Singer. Four new celebrities sing their hearts out and celebrate iconic moments from the legendary "The Wizard of Oz" film. The Masked Singer's very own Sun, LeAnn Rimes, returns to the stage to sing her rendition of "Somewhere Over The Rainbow."

episodes.name: Group C Premiere: Billy Joel Night
episodes.overview: Come "Just The Way You Are" to celebrate "Billy Joel Night" on The Masked Singer! Panelist, Robin Thicke kicks off the episode with a rockstar rendition of "My Life." Then, the last group of celebrity singers belt out classic tunes from the iconic "Piano Man" himself, Bill Joel!

episodes.name: TV Theme Night
episodes.overview: On The Masked Singer's "TV Theme Night," it's time to celebrate the very best of the small screen! Panelists Ken Jeong, Robin Thicke, Jenny McCarthy Wahlberg, and Rita Ora open the show with a performance of one of television's most iconic theme songs from "Gilligan's Island". Then, Season Eleven contestants pay tribute to theme songs including "Scooby-Doo," "The Hills" and "Good Times".

episodes.name: Group C Finals: Shower Anthems Night
episodes.overview: On The Masked Singer's "Shower Anthems Night," it's time to belt out some squeaky-clean tunes! The Season Eleven Contestants start the night with a showstopping group performance, and then serenade the audience with iconic songs that are best sung at full volume in the shower!

episodes.name: Transformers Night
episodes.overview: The Masked Singer's "Transformers Night," celebrates the 40th anniversary of Transformers! Special Guests Optimus Prime and Bumblebee appear throughout the episode to open the show, deliver clues - and even transform into backup dancers! Each celebrity singer will perform a song that was featured in a "Transformers" movie.

episodes.name: Group A Finals: Queen Night
episodes.overview: We Will Rock You on "Queen Night" of The Masked Singer! The group A contestants are put Under Pressure as they pay homage to iconic rock band, Queen! Two celebrities will break free of their masks and one will move on to the quarter finals!

episodes.name: Girl Group Night
episodes.overview: It's "Girl Group Night" on The Masked Singer! Panelists Ken Jeong, Robin Thicke, Jenny McCarthy Wahlberg, and Rita Ora open the show with a group performance of Spice Girls anthem, "Wannabe." Then, Girl Group veterans and The Masked Singer's very own member of the "Lambs" trio, Carnie Wilson, and "Black Widow", Raven Symone, return to The Masked Singer stage before the Season Eleven contestants rock out to Girl Group classics like "Free Your Mind," "I'm So Excited," and "Wide Open Spaces."

episodes.name: Group B Finals:  Soundtrack of My Life
episodes.overview: It's "Soundtrack Of My Life" night on The Masked Singer! The Group B Finalists open the evening with a showstopping performance of "It's My Life" by Bon Jovi. Throughout the episode, contestants perform songs that hold a special place in their hearts like "One Moment In Time," "It's Tricky," and "Carry On Wayward Son." The Season Eleven contestants boast a combined 22 Grammy Nominations, 11 Platinum Albums, 33 Teen Choice Nominations, 108 million Records Sold, 326 Film Appearances and have 1.7 billion Spotify Streams! Two celebrities are unmasked leaving one to move on to the quarter finals.

episodes.name: Quarter Finals: Final Four
episodes.overview: It's "Final Four" night on The Masked Singer! In the Quarter Finals, the final four contestants open the show with panelist Rita Ora's hit song, "Praising You!" Throughout the episode, contestants sing their hearts out to songs like "Price Tag," "I'm Yours," "Get On Your Feet," and "Unforgettable."

episodes.name: Road to the Semi-Finals
episodes.overview: In this special episode of The Masked Singer, take a walk down memory lane to relive the season's most exciting highlights as well as special performances from the final three. Then, see exclusive behind-the-scenes moments from the Season Eleven contestants.

episodes.name: Semi Finals: Then There Were Three
episodes.overview: The three remaining contestants battle it out for the final two spots as they serenade the audience with songs like "You Oughta Know," "Dancing In The Street," and "I Lived."

episodes.name: Finale: One Mask Takes It All
episodes.overview: It is time for the highly anticipated Season Eleven finale of The Masked Singer where "One Mask Takes It All!" Season Eleven culminates in the final two celebrities delivering exceptional performances of songs like, "Latch," "Heart of Glass," "Renegade," and "Don't Let The Sun Go Down On Me" before the winner is revealed!

episodes.name: Who Can It Be Now?
episodes.overview: Celebrity performances from five all-new masked celebrities and a jaw-dropping reveal.

episodes.name: Footloose Night
episodes.overview: Cut loose with Footloose Night as The Masked Singer celebrates the 40th anniversary of the iconic film! Panelist Robin Thicke opens the evening with a showstopping rendition of Kenny Loggins’ Footloose. The four celebrities from Group A belt out fan-favorite songs from the movie soundtrack.

episodes.name: Group A Finals: Soundtrack of My Life
episodes.overview: The three Group A Finalists open with a performance of High Hopes by Panic! At The Disco, followed by sensational renditions of songs near and dear to the contestants including Because The Night, Put Your Records On, and Bittersweet Symphony. Two celebrities are unmasked leaving one to move on to the quarter finals.

episodes.name: Group B Premiere:  Sports Night
episodes.overview: Panelists Robin Thicke and Rita Ora open the show with a performance of “Rock You Like A Hurricane” by the Scorpions. The five brand-new contestants make their grand debut with songs like “Rock Your Body,” “Believe,” “We Belong,” “Sweet Caroline,” and “Lose Control.”

episodes.name: Barbie Night
episodes.overview: Head inside the Barbie Dream House to learn more about the Group B celebrities as they pay tribute to the 65th anniversary of Mattel's Barbie, celebrating over six decades of breaking down boundaries and inspiring girls to explore their limitless potential.

episodes.name: Group B Finals: '60s Night
episodes.overview: The show opens with a rendition of "Fun, Fun, Fun" by The Beach Boys before the Group B finalists sing to secure a spot in the Quarter Finals. The celebrities pay tribute to the grooviest era of all with songs like, "House Of The Rising Sun," "Do You Love Me," and "Ain't No Way". The show ends with a double elimination unless the judges use the Ding Dong Keep It On Bell.

episodes.name: Group C Premiere: Who Are You Fest
episodes.overview: Some familiar faces return to The Masked Singer stage to drop some major clues about their friends' identities. Group C put on show-stopping performances of "You and I," "Under The Bridge," "Tonight Tonight," "Call Me Maybe," and "Slow Burn."

episodes.name: Miley Cyrus Night
episodes.overview: The remaining Group C singers are throwing a "Party In The USA" by opening the show with the iconic hit! Then, the celebrities pay homage to some of Miley's amazing "Bangerz" including, "Used To Be Young," "Midnight Sky," "Wrecking Ball," and "When I Look At You." Who will advance to the Group C finals and who will be unmasked?

episodes.name: Group C Finals: A Peanuts Thanksgiving
episodes.overview: It’s the Peanuts Night extravaganza and the whole beloved Peanuts gang is here to celebrate. Nothing says Thanksgiving like A Charlie Brown Thanksgiving, which has served up over 50 years of family fun, traditions and memories! Panelists Rita Ora and Robin Thicke make turkey day dreams come true with their showstopping rendition of “You Make My Dreams Come True.” Then, the Group C finals commence! The celebrities will give Thanksgiving-themed clues and belt out hits like, “I Hope You Dance,” “Holiday,” and “Ho Hey” culminating in a Battle Royale and Double Elimination!

episodes.name: Quarter Finals: Merging of the Masks
episodes.overview: For the first time, the group champions are all together to battle it out and share some pivotal clues. The celebrities turn up the heat with performances to songs like, “Standing Next To You,” “Iris,” “Closer,” and “You’re Still The One.”

episodes.name: Semi-Finals: The Final Three
episodes.overview: The semi-finalists open the show with a spectacular performance of “Some Nights.” Then, the celebrities pull out all the stops in renditions of “Lose You To Love Me,” “Africa,” and “Beautiful Things.” For the first time ever, the Battle Royale and Smackdown is fusing into the “Smack Royale.” Additionally, clues are given in the form of friendship bracelets, gifted to a panelist each celebrity is friends with!

episodes.name: Finale: A Champion Is Crowned
episodes.overview: Season 5 winner, Piglet (Nick Lachey), returns to the stage to ring in the Holiday season with a joyful rendition of “It’s The Most Wonderful Time Of The Year” while the panel cozy up with each other for the most exciting finale ever. The final two pull out all the stops for the most coveted award in all of entertainment, The Golden Mask Trophy! They bring the house down with showstopping performances of “When I Was Your Man,” “Somebody That I Used To Know,” “I’m Your Baby Tonight,” and “Too Good At Goodbyes.”

episodes.name: Lucky Season 13: Group A Premiere
episodes.overview: Contestants from Group A perform hits like "SexyBack," "Just Give Me a Reason," "The Door," "La Bamba" and "Mad World."

episodes.name: Shrek Night
episodes.overview: Group A channels their inner fairytale by performing songs from or inspired by the "Shrek" movie franchise.

episodes.name: Group A Finals: A Rat Pack Tribute Night
episodes.overview: It's "Rat Pack Night" on The Masked Singer! Get ready for The Masked Singer's resident crooner, Robin Thicke, to Fly You To The Moon when he opens the show with the classic alongside Group A's Ant, Paparazzo and Coral. This evening's tribute to the Rat Pack has even more action than a Vegas casino! Group A will swoon, sing and serenade the audience with some of the Rat Pack's most iconic classics including, "Luck Be A Lady," "Fever," "That's Amore" and "My Way!"

episodes.name: Group B Premiere: Voices of Olympus
episodes.overview: Five new masks appear as the Voices of Olympus; contestants perform showstopping renditions of "I Believe In a Thing Called Love," "Bad Blood," "Rewrite the Stars," "Espresso" and "Saving All My Love For You."

episodes.name: Ghostbusters Night
episodes.overview: The panelists transform into ghost busting detectives along with an iconic visit from an original Ghostbuster, Ernie Hudson! Group B ain't afraid of no ghosts! They bring the house down with amazing performances of "(Don't Fear) The Reaper," "Disturbia," "Cleanin' Up The Town," and "Radioactive" before one celebrity must reveal themselves.

episodes.name: Group B Finals: Grand Ole Opry Night
episodes.overview: The Group B finalists perform "Save a Horse (Ride a Cowboy), and renditions of "Here You Come Again," "Take Me Home, Country Roads" and "Something in the Water."

episodes.name: Group C Premiere: Carnival Night
episodes.overview: The celebrities deliver astounding performances of "Hot To Go," "Jump Around," "Roxanne," "Let's Get Loud," and "Unwell" before one celebrity must reveal themselves.

episodes.name: Boy Band Night
episodes.overview: Paying tribute to boy bands; contestants perform iconic boy band classics like "Tearin' Up My Heart," "Poison," "Step By Step," and "I Swear."

episodes.name: Group C Finals: Decades Night
episodes.overview: Group C opens the show with a rockstar performance of "My Sharona" before the celebrities bring the house down with renditions of "Stop! In The Name Of Love," "Love Yourself," "Can't Fight This Feeling," and "Hard to Handle." One celebrity automatically advances to the Lucky Six while two battle it out in an electrifying Battle Royale to see who moves along to the Lucky Six and who must reveal themselves.

episodes.name: The Lucky 6: Merging of the Masks
episodes.overview: It's time for a "Merging Of The Masks" for the Lucky 6 on The Masked Singer! The final six celebrities in the competition are ready to battle it out to get one step closer to the illusive Golden Mask Trophy and this week, the panelists will have an opportunity to ask some rapid-fire questions to each masked contestant.

episodes.name: Quarter Finals: Soundtrack of My Life Night
episodes.overview: It's "Soundtrack Of My Life Night!" The top five have come to play and open the show with a pitch-perfect performance of "More Than A Feeling." Then, the masks will be singing songs with a special meaning to them and we will get to hear from those closest to them.

episodes.name: The Semi-Finals: Head-To-Head Battles
episodes.overview: It's the Semi Finals on The Masked Singer and the final four are ready to make some hands clap with their superstar rendition of "HandClap!" The four semi-finalists are ready to battle it out ahead of next week's blockbuster season finale.

episodes.name: The Two-Hour Lucky Season 13 Finale
episodes.overview: In the grand culmination of Lucky Season 13, it is time for the final four to battle it out to be crowned the Season 13 Winner of The Masked Singer!

shows.name: The Night Agent
shows.overview: Brought together by a midnight phone call, an FBI agent and a cybersecurity expert must unravel an ever-growing web of political conspiracies.

episodes.name: The Call
episodes.overview: While working the night action desk, FBI agent Peter receives a distress call and is soon put in charge of protecting cybersecurity expert Rose.

episodes.name: Redial
episodes.overview: After looking for a link between the Campbells and the FBI, Peter is forced to go on the run with Rose in search of a hard drive — and more answers.

episodes.name: The Zookeeper
episodes.overview: Peter teams up with Rose for a risky mission at the White House. Elsewhere, a notable agent joins the security detail for the vice president's daughter.

episodes.name: Eyes Only
episodes.overview: Rose and Peter seek out one of the Campbells' recent contacts and uncover new intel. Monks opens up to Chelsea. Paulo makes a move on Maddie.

episodes.name: The Marionette
episodes.overview: Peter visits someone close to Hawkins. Rose makes a key connection. Maddie’s night out takes a dangerous turn, spurring the Secret Service into action.

episodes.name: Fathoms
episodes.overview: With assassins hot on their trail, Peter and Rose split up en route to the White House. A shocking discovery quickly puts their lives in jeopardy.

episodes.name: Best Served Cold
episodes.overview: Now in hiding, Peter and Rose grow closer and investigate a potential bombing suspect. At the White House, the conspirators obtain a disturbing tape.

episodes.name: Redux
episodes.overview: More truths emerge about the bombing suspect's identity. Chelsea and Peter race to find Maddie after she sends a video with a coded message.

episodes.name: The Devil We Know
episodes.overview: After new revelations surface, Peter and Rose scramble to find more evidence with help from Chelsea and Maddie. A bigger threat looms at Camp David.

episodes.name: Fathers
episodes.overview: With lives at stake, the group tries to stop a nefarious plot before it's too late. In the aftermath, Peter confronts the past and begins a new chapter.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: The hunt for a CIA agent accused of leaking secrets puts Peter and Rose in the crosshairs of a ruthless intelligence broker and a deadly war criminal.

episodes.name: Call Tracking
episodes.overview: After a disastrous mission in Bangkok, Peter goes AWOL to track an American agent accused of leaking secrets. Meanwhile, Rose receives a disturbing call.

episodes.name: Disconnected
episodes.overview: Reunited at last, Peter and Rose race to intercept Warren. Noor weighs using her access to classified Iranian intelligence for her own gain.

episodes.name: Government Property
episodes.overview: Catherine aids Peter's off-the-books investigation into Foxglove while Noor stumbles upon an unexpected encounter. A hijacking spirals out of control.

episodes.name: Desperate Measures
episodes.overview: Peter and Rose infiltrate a party at the Iranian ambassador's home, arousing Javad's suspicion. Tomás and Markus lock horns over the Foxglove plan.

episodes.name: A Family Matter
episodes.overview: Eager for intel about Night Action, Jacob makes Solomon a lucrative offer. Javad senses a traitor in his midst. Sami undertakes a covert mission in Iran.

episodes.name: A Good Agent
episodes.overview: Rose grapples with a crisis of conscience. Viktor reveals his true goal to Tomás, and the hunter becomes the hunted when Solomon's team stalks Peter.

episodes.name: Tilt
episodes.overview: Peter plays hardball to force Solomon to talk. Following a lead, Rose seeks answers from a Foxglove scientist — but finds herself in a lethal situation.

episodes.name: Divergence
episodes.overview: Desperate to locate Rose, Peter makes a game-changing deal with Jacob. Tomás discovers just how far Markus is willing to go in service to his father.

episodes.name: Cultural Exchange
episodes.overview: Breaching one of the most high-security locations in New York puts Peter's skills to the test. Rose and Dr. Cole enact a daring plan to stop Markus.

episodes.name: Buyer's Remorse
episodes.overview: With time running out, Peter and Rose scramble to prevent a mass casualty event. Catherine floats an intriguing proposal.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: Coming off the explosive events of Season Two, Night Agent Peter Sutherland is called in to track down a young Treasury Agent who fled to Istanbul with sensitive government intel after killing his boss. This kicks off a sequence of events where Peter investigates a dark money network while avoiding its paid assassins, while putting him on a collision course with a relentless journalist. Working together, they uncover buried secrets and old grudges that threaten to bring the government to its knees -- and get them both killed in the process.

shows.name: The Night Manager
shows.overview: Former British soldier Jonathan Pine navigates the shadowy recesses of Whitehall and Washington where an unholy alliance operates between the intelligence community and the secret arms trade. To infiltrate the inner circle of lethal arms dealer Richard Onslow Roper, Pine must himself become a criminal.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Hotel night manager Jonathan Pine receives a plea for help from a well-connected guest.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: On the Mediterranean island of Mallorca, Roper’s life of luxury and calm is shattered. Six months earlier, Burr continues her recruitment of Pine, sending him to Devon to build his cover story.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: While he continues to recuperate in Roper’s villa, Pine starts to dig up secrets about the other members of the household. Meanwhile, Burr and Steadman seize on an opportunity to recruit a new asset.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Roper welcomes Pine into his inner circle, leaving Corky out in the cold. Meanwhile, Burr has concerns for the safety of her source, when she suspects key information has been leaked to the River House.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: A suspicious Roper gathers his entourage around him in an attempt to root out the traitor, forcing Pine to play a dangerous game. In London, Burr and Steadman face mounting opposition from Whitehall.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Roper and his team return to Cairo for the deal, reuniting Pine with an old enemy. Pine risks it all to put his plan in motion. A discredited Burr makes one last stand.

seasons.name: Series 2
seasons.overview: Jonathan Pine thought he'd buried his past. Now living as Alex Goodwin - a low-level MI6 officer running a quiet surveillance unit in London - his life is comfortingly uneventful. Then one night a chance sighting of an old Roper mercenary prompts a call to action and leads Pine to a violent encounter with a new player: Colombian businessman Teddy Dos Santos. On this perilous new journey, Pine meets Roxana Bolaños, a businesswoman who reluctantly helps him infiltrate Teddy's Colombian arms operation. Once in Colombia, Pine is plunged deep into a deadly plot involving arms and training of a guerrilla army. As allegiances splinter, Pine races to expose a conspiracy designed to destabilise a nation. And with betrayal at every turn, he must decide whose trust he needs to earn and how far he's willing to go before it's too late.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Pine’s past resurfaces after a chance sighting. He’s pulled into a deadly conspiracy reaching from Colombia’s jungles to the heart of MI6.

shows.name: The Old Man
shows.overview: Dan Chase absconded from the CIA decades ago and now lives off the grid. When an assassin arrives and tries to take Chase out, the old operative learns that to ensure his future he now must reconcile his past.

episodes.name: I
episodes.overview: When Dan Chase's past catches up to him, he must flee the town he's called home for three decades.

episodes.name: II
episodes.overview: Chase finds a temporary hideout, but Harold Harper and the authorities are still after him.

episodes.name: III
episodes.overview: Forced to flee, Chase finally tells Zoe the truth about his past, but it might be too late.

episodes.name: IV
episodes.overview: Both Chase and Harper try to move forward with their plans, but their choices backfire.

episodes.name: V
episodes.overview: Chase and Harper face decisive tests. Zoe finds a new path forward as old stories resurface.

episodes.name: VI
episodes.overview: Chase and Zoe enter the lion's den. As Harper ends one partnership, another begins.

episodes.name: VII
episodes.overview: Chase is forced to face the consequences for his past choices. Harper learns an impossible truth.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: In Season 2, former CIA agent Dan Chase and former FBI Assistant Director Harold Harper set off on their most important mission to date --- to recover Emily Chase after she is kidnapped by Faraz Hamzad, a powerful Afghan tribal leader. With all three men claiming her as their daughter, Emily finds herself in an identity crisis that has dire implications.

episodes.name: VIII
episodes.overview: Now in Afghanistan, Dan Chase and Harold Harper have to evade the Taliban in order to save Emily.

episodes.name: IX
episodes.overview: Emily Chase learns of her true identity as the daughter of Faraz Hamzad while outside forces threaten her and her new family.

episodes.name: X
episodes.overview: Dan and Emily Chase reunite for the first time in many years and must protect the Hamzad village from the Taliban.

episodes.name: XI
episodes.overview: Chase and Harper try to convince Morgan Bote to help Emily, but when Zoe McDonald resurfaces, they realize the story's much bigger than they thought.

episodes.name: XII
episodes.overview: Chase, Harper, and Zoe take refuge in Harper's house only to receive tragic news.

episodes.name: XIII
episodes.overview: Chase and Zoe must track down Hamzad's lawyer in London, while Harper must recruit an unlikely partner.

episodes.name: XIV
episodes.overview: Chase is taken captive by Suleyman Pavlovich as he risks everything to save Zoe. Harper must go to the opposite end of the earth to confront his past.

episodes.name: XV
episodes.overview: Everything is on the line as Zoe must save Chase's life, while Harper's misstep puts him in peril.

shows.name: The Pendragon Cycle: Rise of the Merlin
shows.original_name: The Pendragon Cycle: Rise of the Merlin
shows.overview: A retelling of the Arthurian legend set in a Roman-occupied Britain where barbarian invaders threaten to lay claim to the island.

episodes.name: Production Diary 1: The Start of an Epic Adventure
episodes.overview: Behind the scenes of week 1 of production on The Pendragon Cycle. Get a glimpse into the rigorous training, stunts, and more during the filming in Hungary.

episodes.name: Production Diary 2: The Week of Battles
episodes.overview: Behind the scenes of week 2 of production on The Pendragon Cycle. Immerse yourself in the epic battle scenes filled with blood, iron, mayhem and more.

episodes.name: Production Diary 3: Meet the Show’s Villain
episodes.overview: Behind the scenes during week 3 of the production of The Pendragon Cycle. Meet Morgian, Charis' intriguing step-sister, and see the first scenes filmed at the home of the Atlanteans.

episodes.name: Production Diary 4: A Love Story
episodes.overview: Behind-the-scenes during week 4 of the production of The Pendragon Cycle. Embark on a journey alongside the cast and crew as they utilize a Hungarian forest for the mesmerizing backdrop of Myrddin and Ganieda’s meeting and more.

episodes.name: Production Diary 5: The Most Stunning Set Yet
episodes.overview: Behind-the-scenes during week 5 of the production of The Pendragon Cycle. Set out on an adventure with the cast and crew as they journey to northern Italy to film among the stunning mountaintops.

episodes.name: Production Diary 6: The Otherworldly Atlanteans
episodes.overview: Behind-the-scenes during week 6 of the production of The Pendragon Cycle. Behold lost Atlantis and the Palace of the Fisher King, and witness Myrddin’s Wrath in the forest of Celyddon.

episodes.name: Production Diary 7: Recreating Wales in Italy
episodes.overview: Behind-the-scenes during week 7 of the production of The Pendragon Cycle. Join the cast and crew as they face the challenges and triumphs of filming amidst hurricane winds, harsh weather, and the stunning landscapes of Italy.

episodes.name: Production Diary 8: Everyone Told Us We Couldn’t Do This
episodes.overview: Behind-the-scenes during week 8 of the production of The Pendragon Cycle. Watch as the cast and crew bring an epic, yet dangerous bull-leaping sequence from the book to life in one of the most challenging filming weeks yet.

episodes.name: Production Diary 8: Jeremy Boreing AAL
episodes.overview: Join Jeremy for a live Q&A and get a first look at new Pendragon BTS!

Then follow the Hungarian cast and crew to get a peek at building the foundational friendships in the show.

episodes.overview: Behind-the-scenes during week 10 of production of The Pendragon Cycle. Join the cast and crew as they head back to Hungary to shoot some emotionally rich scenes, explore some of the most important props in the story, and capture a bloody duel.

episodes.overview: Join Jeremy for a live Q&A and get a first look at new Pendragon BTS!

episodes.overview: Behind-the-scenes during week 12 of the production of The Pendragon Cycle. See the iconic architecture of Budapest bring the story to life, follow the crew through the Battle of Vortigern’s Tower, and join the characters as they wrestle with the Christian themes in the story.

episodes.overview: Behind-the-scenes during week 13 of the production of The Pendragon Cycle. Watch the series’ historical surroundings come to life through a barbarous clash, a frozen northern kingdom, and the uniting of Britain.
