shows.name: The Peripheral
shows.overview: Stuck in a small Appalachian town, a young woman’s only escape from the daily grind is playing advanced video games. She is such a good player that a company sends her a new video game system to test…but it has a surprise in store. It unlocks all of her dreams of finding a purpose, romance, and glamour in what seems like a game…but it also puts her and her family in real danger.

episodes.name: Pilot
episodes.overview: Stuck in a small town without many prospects, Flynne Fisher is a brilliant gamer who works a dead end job to support her veteran brother and ailing mother. When her brother enlists her help playing an advanced video game known as a SIM , Flynne sees something she shouldn't, bringing real life danger to the family's doorstep.

episodes.name: Empathy Bonus
episodes.overview: Mercenaries raid the family home. Seeking answers, Flynne returns to the headset and learns it is not a game, but a time machine that goes 70 years into the future. Flynne makes a deal with Wilf and Lev and agrees to help find Aelita.

episodes.name: Haptic Drift
episodes.overview: Flynne and Wilf work together to find Aelita. Meanwhile, Burton takes steps to eliminate a new threat.

episodes.name: Jackpot
episodes.overview: Flynne’s health takes a turn. Wilf visits Flynne in Clanton, deepening their relationship. Flynne learns the truth about her future.

episodes.name: What About Bob?
episodes.overview: Flynne’s life is threatened again, forcing her to confront Cherise.

episodes.name: Fuck You and Eat Shit
episodes.overview: Flynne and Wilf discover Aelita’s ties to the Neoprims, who want to destory London as we know it. Inspector Lowbeer makes her appearance in London and demands to meet Flynne, Burton and Conner.

episodes.name: The Doodad
episodes.overview: Flynne, Burton and Conner meet with Lowbeer and are put to the test. Meanwhile, Ella’s life is in danger, and Tommy deals with the Sheriff and Corbell Pickett his own way.

episodes.name: The Creation of a Thousand Forests
episodes.overview: Lev sabotages Flynne’s treatment. Ash finds an unlikely ally. Wilf discovers some unsettling truths about Aelita. Flynne tries to save her world from Cherise.

shows.name: The Pitt
shows.overview: The staff of Pittsburgh's Trauma Medical Center work around the clock to save lives in an overcrowded and underfunded emergency department.

episodes.name: 7:00 A.M.
episodes.overview: While attempting to distract himself from the anniversary of his mentor's death, Dr. Robby introduces a fresh batch of interns to life in the ER.

episodes.name: 8:00 A.M.
episodes.overview: Robby helps siblings navigate their elderly father's end of life care. Later, Samira fends off cops targeting a woman with a misunderstood condition.

episodes.name: 9:00 A.M.
episodes.overview: Samira does her best to keep Whitaker on the right track. A teen overdose sparks conflict in the ER.

episodes.name: 10:00 A.M.
episodes.overview: Bets are taken on the whereabouts of a stolen ambulance, while Santos learns a hard lesson, and Whitaker helps to tame “The Kraken.”

episodes.name: 11:00 A.M.
episodes.overview: Santos and Collins each deal with moral quandaries. Samira’s careful approach earns praise from patients – and reproach from Robby.

episodes.name: 12:00 P.M.
episodes.overview: While Robby handles an ultimatum from the hospital, Mel, Javadi, and Collins each handle unique mother-daughter dynamics.

episodes.name: 1:00 P.M.
episodes.overview: After examining an influencer with strange symptoms, Samira pushes back against Robby. Santos contends with a patient accused of assault.

episodes.name: 2:00 P.M.
episodes.overview: While Robby attends to an elderly patient with ties to Pittsburgh's history, other members of the team attempt to resuscitate a young drowning victim.

episodes.name: 3:00 P.M.
episodes.overview: After a staff debrief from Robby, Dana defuses a waiting room brawl, Whitaker finds common ground with "The Kraken," and McKay faces a crucial error.

episodes.name: 4:00 P.M.
episodes.overview: With the Pitt down a staff member, Robby relies on his team to pick up the slack. Later, Santos finally voices her suspicions.

episodes.name: 5:00 P.M.
episodes.overview: While Robby tries to keep a developing staffing situation under wraps, Collins guides a surrogate through a difficult delivery.

episodes.name: 6:00 P.M.
episodes.overview: When dozens of critical patients flood the ER, Robby and his team struggle to keep up amid quickly diminished supplies.

episodes.name: 7:00 P.M.
episodes.overview: As the night shift begins, Robby refuses to give up on a mass casualty victim. Samira and Santos each attempt risky moves.

episodes.name: 8:00 P.M.
episodes.overview: While Robby struggles with a loss, Abbott coaches Samira through a risky procedure, and Mel treats a teen with a mysterious rash.

episodes.name: 9:00 P.M.
episodes.overview: Robby resorts to unorthodox methods to convince a father to allow treatment for his son. Later, Whitaker tracks down a missing patient.

shows.name: The Recruit
shows.overview: Recruited out of law school by the CIA, a daredevil young attorney leaps unprepared into the dangerous world of international espionage.

episodes.name: I.N.A.S.I.A.L.
episodes.overview: Thrown into the deep end during his first week at the CIA, rookie lawyer Owen Hendricks quickly gets in over his head when he uncovers a possible threat.

episodes.name: N.L.T.S.Y.P.
episodes.overview: While scrambling to learn how to navigate the high-stakes world of international espionage, Owen attempts to track down classified information on Max.

episodes.name: Y.D.E.K.W.Y.D.
episodes.overview: Owen's crash course in CIA protocols continues as he negotiates with Max, goes on a date with a co-worker and contends with a hostile agency employee.

episodes.name: I.Y.D.I.A.A.C.
episodes.overview: When a major snag jeopardizes Max's case, Owen races to find a legal loophole — and urges her not to take matters into her own ruthless hands.

episodes.name: T.S.L.A.Y.P.
episodes.overview: Owen's plan to move on from Max suffers a setback when he's ordered back to Phoenix, where credit cards and prying eyes cause problems at work and home.

episodes.name: I.C.I.N.C.
episodes.overview: On the heels of his risky negotiations on Max's behalf, Owen faces uncomfortable questions from his colleagues — and friends — about their connection.

episodes.name: I.M.F.T.B.S.
episodes.overview: A mission to Geneva to retrieve assets from a Swiss bank account spirals into chaos for Owen and Max, while Hannah's mom pressures her for information.

episodes.name: W.T.F.I.O.H.
episodes.overview: The mission with Max takes a dangerous turn as complications arise, bullets fly — and Owen's personal and professional lives collide.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: A new graymail case sends Owen to Seoul, where a spy threatens to leak U.S. secrets unless the CIA assists him on a dangerous personal mission.

episodes.name: Y.N.A.H.Y.A.L.
episodes.overview: After the chaos in Prague, Owen gets benched. But it's not long before he stumbles on a new case — and into a new den of spies in South Korea.

episodes.name: Y.A.R.A.C.O.T.D.O.P.
episodes.overview: Owen becomes a human target while digging deeper into the graymail case. Nichka has major intel on a kidnapping — but it won't come for free.

episodes.name: H.H.I.I.T.K.A.L.
episodes.overview: An impromptu trip to the Middle East leads to danger. Jang Kyun takes extreme measures to get the answers he seeks.

episodes.name: A.T.N.W.H.Y.P.A.B.H.
episodes.overview: With no one else to trust, Owen and Jang Kyun reluctantly team up. Hannah's new romance proves risky. Oliver arranges a meeting with the yakuza.

episodes.name: W.S.T.W.T.P.
episodes.overview: Owen and his cohorts race to evade capture when the NIS orders their arrest. To save her own skin, Dawn agrees to lead a perilous mission.

episodes.name: I.D.N.W.T.B.D.I.
episodes.overview: Forced to pivot when an operation goes sideways, Owen must rely on new allies, old friends and his own resourcefulness to even the odds.

shows.name: The Righteous Gemstones
shows.overview: The story of a world-famous televangelist family with a history of deviance, greed and, yes, charitable work, all in the name of Jesus.

episodes.name: The Righteous Gemstones
episodes.overview: Upon returning from a baptism marathon in China, Jesse receives a video from blackmailers seeking to sully his reputation. Eli moves forward with plans to expand the Gemstone empire as he continues to mourn his late wife.

episodes.name: Is This the Man Who Made the Earth Tremble
episodes.overview: After discovering Amber, Pontius and Abraham reminiscing about an estranged family member, Jesse tasks his friends with acquiring surveillance footage that could explain the strange events of the night before.

episodes.name: They Are Weak, But He Is Strong
episodes.overview: Aimee-Leigh's elderly brother Baby Billy returns to the Gemstone ministry, bringing along his much younger wife Tiffany. Jesse closes ranks on his co-conspirators to root out the identity of his blackmailers.

episodes.name: Wicked Lips
episodes.overview: Judy and Martin take Gideon behind-the scenes of the Gemstone enterprise. Eli tasks Kelvin with doing a “satanic sweep” for Dot, the rebellious teen daughter of the church’s biggest donors. Jesse and his friends are thrown for a loop when Chad’s wife finds some disturbing emails.

episodes.name: Interlude
episodes.overview: In 1989, young Jesse, Judy and Baby Billy each deal with the news that Aimee-Leigh is pregnant in their own unique way, while Eli looks to grow his family’s prospects.

episodes.name: Now the Sons of Eli Were Worthless Men
episodes.overview: Jealous of Kelvin’s rising star, Judy seeks her moment in the spotlight under Baby Billy’s tutelage. Jesse procures a key piece of evidence he hopes will lead to the blackmailers.

episodes.name: And Yet One of You is a Devil
episodes.overview: Eli informs Jesse, Kelvin and Judy that they’ll each need to be front and center for Easter Sunday service, their biggest telecast of the year. Judy’s deference to Baby Billy threatens her relationship with BJ and with her family.

episodes.name: But the Righteous Will See Their Fall
episodes.overview: Jesse deals with the fallout of the dramatic events of Easter Sunday. Judy attempts to win back BJ after receiving some harsh words from Baby Billy. Kelvin has a crisis of faith.

episodes.name: Better is the End of a Thing Than Its Beginning
episodes.overview: Eli questions his children's future in the Gemstone ministry. Jesse struggles to keep his marriage together. Judy opens up to BJ about her past. A disillusioned Kelvin embraces his dark side. Season One Finale.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Season two finds our blessed Gemstone family threatened by outsiders from both the past and present who wish to destroy their empire.

episodes.name: I Speak in the Tongues of Men and Angels
episodes.overview: As Jesse eyes a business opportunity with an Evangelical couple on the rise, the media cracks down on a fellow preacher. Meanwhile, Eli reconnects with a figure from his mysterious past.

episodes.name: After I Leave, Savage Wolves Will Come
episodes.overview: After doubling-down on their efforts to invest in Zion’s Landing, Jesse and Amber scramble for the cash. Meanwhile, Eli’s attempts to dodge a big-city reporter spell doom for the Gemstones.

episodes.name: For He Is a Liar and the Father of Lies
episodes.overview: The Gemstone siblings seek to pull back the curtain on their father’s past. Eli shares a hard truth, and Kelvin grapples with an unruly God Squad.

episodes.name: As to How They Might Destroy Him
episodes.overview: Still reeling from their father’s revelation, Kelvin and Jesse conspire to put Eli in his place. As BJ’s baptism approaches, Judy clashes with her in-laws, while Baby Billy struggles with his own growing family.

episodes.name: Interlude II
episodes.overview: Christmas, 1993. While Eli considers a tempting offer from an old friend, Baby Billy crashes the Gemstones’ celebrations.

episodes.name: Never Avenge Yourselves, But Leave It to the Wrath of God
episodes.overview: After surviving a harrowing attack, Jesse takes matters into his own hands. Eli attempts to make amends, while Kelvin struggles to control his flock.

episodes.name: And Infants Shall Rule Over Them
episodes.overview: With Eli temporarily out of the picture, the Gemstone siblings are left to quarrel over who’s in charge – until some wise words help pave a way forward. As Tiffany tracks down Baby Billy, Gideon faces his future.

episodes.name: The Prayer of a Righteous Man
episodes.overview: As the dust settles back at the compound, Jesse, Kelvin, and Judy consider where they stand. Baby Billy reconnects with a figure from his past.

episodes.name: I Will Tell of All Your Deeds
episodes.overview: While the Gemstones celebrate the launch of Zion’s Landing, Baby Billy faces a chance to embrace fatherhood.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: When the spoiled Gemstone children finally get their wish to take control of the Church, they discover leadership is harder than they imagined and that their extravagant lifestyle comes with a heavy price.

episodes.name: For I Know the Plans I Have for You
episodes.overview: In the wake of their father’s semi-retirement, Jesse, Judy, and Kelvin must deal with dwindling attendance – and donations. Later, Eli is visited by another figure from his past.

episodes.name: But Esau Ran to Meet Him
episodes.overview: Eli does his best to smooth over relations with the Montgomery boys after a visit to their doomsday prepper compound. Back at the Salvation Center, the siblings face off against the Board of Ministers.

episodes.name: For Their Nakedness Is Your Own Nakedness
episodes.overview: Tired of life in the lap of luxury, Baby Billy pursues a new vocation as gameshow host. The Gemstones host a cousins’ night for Karl and Chuck.

episodes.name: I Have Not Come to Bring Peace, But a Sword
episodes.overview: While Jesse prepares for his initiation into a prestigious secret society, Judy fends off unwanted attention, and Kelvin handles rumors about Keefe. Later, Baby Billy makes an impossible promise.

episodes.name: Interlude III
episodes.overview: 2000. After a Y2K doomsday fails to materialize, Eli and Aimee-Leigh find themselves flooded with criticism from their congregants…and the Montgomerys. Later, the arrival of Jesse’s girlfriend Amber throws an already fragile Judy for a loop.

episodes.name: For Out of the Heart Comes Evil Thoughts
episodes.overview: Threatened with blackmail, Judy turns to Amber for advice, while Jesse goads BJ into a long-simmering fight. As a despondent Kelvin tackles life without Keefe, Baby Billy works on bringing Jesse’s miracle to life… for a price.

episodes.name: Burn for Burn, Wound for Wound, Stripe for Stripe
episodes.overview: After decades of animosity, tensions between the Montgomerys and the Gemstones finally come to a head. As Eli faces an impossible decision, Jesse, Judy, and Kelvin prepare to meet their maker.

episodes.name: I Will Take You by the Hand and Keep You
episodes.overview: The Gemstone siblings reconnect with their loved ones… and each other. As the Montgomery militia fractures from within, Chuck weighs his options, while Peter hatches a new plan.

episodes.name: Wonders That Cannot Be Fathomed, Miracles That Cannot Be Counted
episodes.overview: The siblings compete in an all-out biblical brawl – until a stroke of divine intervention forever alters the fate of the Gemstone family.

episodes.name: Prelude
episodes.overview: 1862. A young scoundrel named Gemstone joins ranks with the Confederates as a preacher, but a case of divine intervention changes the sinner's path for good.

episodes.name: You Hurled Me Into the Depths, Into the Very Heart of the Seas
episodes.overview: While preparing for a Give-a-Thon in honor of their late mother, the Gemstones reunite with Aimee-Leigh's longtime best friend Lori.

episodes.name: To Grieve Like the Rest of Men Who Have No Hope
episodes.overview: When their archrivals encroach on Gemstone territory, Jesse prepares to strike back, while Kelvin receives an honor.

episodes.name: He Goeth Before You Into Galilee
episodes.overview: At the Gemstone family lake house, Baby Billy and the siblings plot to use Aimee-Leigh's memory to tear Eli's new relationship apart – by whatever means necessary.

episodes.name: You Shall Remember
episodes.overview: While Lori finds herself in a precarious position, Baby Billy tries to get the greenlight on his latest project. Later, Kelvin and Vance face off.

episodes.name: Interlude IV
episodes.overview: 2002. While recording an album together, Lori turns to Aimee-Leigh for help with her failing marriage.

episodes.name: For Jealousy Is the Rage of a Man
episodes.overview: Eli confronts a dangerous foe. Baby Billy struggles on the set of Teenjus. Judy has monkey problems. Keefe works to get Kelvin out of his tree house.

episodes.name: On Your Belly You Shall Go
episodes.overview: Judy looks to get rid of BJ's new companion as Eli looks for a new path forward.

episodes.name: That Man of God May Be Complete
episodes.overview: Still reeling from a brush with fate, the Gemstones head to Galilee Gulch, where their faith is put to the ultimate test.

shows.name: The Sandman
shows.overview: After years of imprisonment, Morpheus — the King of Dreams — embarks on a journey across worlds to find what was stolen from him and restore his power.

episodes.name: The Sandman: Unlocked
episodes.overview: The cast and creators of The Sandman – Neil Gaiman, Tom Sturridge, Jenna Coleman, Boyd Holbrook, Vivienne Acheampong, Vanesu Samunyai, and Allan Heinberg – sit down with host Felicia Day for a full-spoilers discussion about the long-awaited adaptation.

episodes.name: Sleep of the Just
episodes.overview: While searching for an escaped nightmare in the waking world, Morpheus falls prey to Roderick Burgess, an occultist looking to summon and imprison Death.

episodes.name: Imperfect Hosts
episodes.overview: Morpheus begins his quest to find his tools of power — his sand, ruby and helm — by paying a visit to a pair of notoriously dysfunctional brothers.

episodes.name: Dream a Little Dream of Me
episodes.overview: Morpheus tracks down the last-known person in possession of his sand — and receives an unexpected lesson on humanity. Ethel pays a visit to her son.

episodes.name: A Hope in Hell
episodes.overview: A lead on the whereabouts of his helm compels Morpheus to seek an audience with Lucifer. A confused John receives a helping hand from a good Samaritan.
With Morpheus caught off guard, John settles in at a diner to watch the people around him — and put his theory about truth and lies to a terrifying test.

episodes.name: The Sound of Her Wings
episodes.overview: Feeling a bit rudderless, Morpheus shadows his hard-working big sister, who offers him advice and encourages him to reconnect with an old acquaintance.

episodes.name: The Doll's House
episodes.overview: Lucienne comes to Morpheus with disturbing news. Rose Walker goes in search of family. Admirers of the Corinthian's work scheme to get his attention.

episodes.name: Playing House
episodes.overview: As Morpheus closes in on one of his missing creations, Rose ramps up efforts to locate her brother — and unwittingly makes a friend's dream come true.

episodes.name: Collectors
episodes.overview: Odd disturbances shake up The Dreaming, Rose sets out on a road trip with a new friend, and The Corinthian arrives with a guest at a creepy convention.

episodes.name: Lost Hearts
episodes.overview: As the Dream vortex grows more powerful and the walls between the realms weaken, Rose must make a difficult choice. Morpheus confronts The Corinthian.

episodes.name: Dream of a Thousand Cats/Calliope
episodes.overview: In this two-part story collection, a Siamese cat dreaming of a new world and a writer in desperate need of inspiration cross paths with Morpheus.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: In the wake of rebuilding his realm, Morpheus faces ancient responsibilities and familial entanglements as he's drawn into a prophecy that challenges his identity and power.

episodes.name: Season of Mists
episodes.overview: When a gathering of the Endless exposes deep-seated grievances, Morpheus embarks on a mission to Hell to free the soul of a condemned mortal.

episodes.name: The Ruler of Hell
episodes.overview: Bequeathed the key to Hell, Morpheus throws a lavish banquet to determine which god, demon or faerie can be entrusted with its dark power.

episodes.name: More Devils Than Vast Hell Can Hold
episodes.overview: All the world's a stage as Morpheus summons history's greatest dramatist to perform an enchanting play for a supernatural audience.

episodes.name: Brief Lives
episodes.overview: Morpheus grudgingly helps Delirium search for their vanished sibling in the waking world — where a deadly force lurks in the shadows.

episodes.name: The Song of Orpheus
episodes.overview: To honor a promise to one sibling, Morpheus must shatter a vow to another. In ancient Greece, a wedding-night tragedy turns a son against his father.

episodes.name: Family Blood
episodes.overview: Morpheus enlists an expert in the occult to smuggle a deeply personal relic out of Paris — and help him and Delirium find the answers they seek.

episodes.name: Time and Night
episodes.overview: With the future of his realm at stake, Morpheus must appeal for help to an authority even greater than the Endless.

episodes.name: Fuel for the Fire
episodes.overview: Morpheus recruits a mortal agent for a dangerous mission in the waking world. A change of heart puts a pair of tricksters on a collision course.

episodes.name: The Kindly Ones
episodes.overview: Confined to his realm, Morpheus conjures up a new nightmare to do his bidding. The God of Deception deals roughly with an intrusive thorn in his side.

episodes.name: Long Live the King
episodes.overview: Fueled by rage, a grieving mother unleashes her wrath upon the Dreaming, as Morpheus confronts the Kindly Ones at the furthest reaches of his kingdom.

episodes.name: A Tale of Graceful Ends
episodes.overview: As deities, dreamers and demons unite to mark a momentous occasion, the Endless assemble for a family reunion unlike any other.

episodes.name: A Special Episode - Death: The High Cost of Living
episodes.overview: In this standalone episode, a journalist overwhelmed by hopelessness has a life-altering 24 hours after crossing paths with Death on her day off.

shows.name: The Umbrella Academy
shows.overview: A dysfunctional family of superheroes comes together to solve the mystery of their father's death, the threat of the apocalypse and more.

episodes.name: The Raincoat Academy Starring King Vader
episodes.overview: What happened to the children who weren’t adopted by Sir Reginald Hargreeves?

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Reunited by their father's death, estranged siblings with extraordinary powers uncover shocking family secrets -- and a looming threat to humanity.

episodes.name: We Only See Each Other at Weddings and Funerals
episodes.overview: Years after they rose to fame as young crime-fighting superheroes, the estranged Hargreeves siblings come together to mark their father's death.

episodes.name: Run Boy Run
episodes.overview: After sharing the story of his time travel with Vanya, Five hunts for the owner of a fake eye. But two mysterious assassins are hot on his trail.

episodes.name: Extra Ordinary
episodes.overview: Worried their mother is hiding something, Luther and Allison call a family meeting. Cha-Cha and Hazel catch a big break in their hunt for Five.

episodes.name: Man on the Moon
episodes.overview: The story of Luther's transformation emerges. At the motel, Klaus puts Hazel and Cha-Cha's training to the test. Allison grows suspicious of Leonard.

episodes.name: Number Five
episodes.overview: Five lets Luther in on his secret, Klaus returns from a harrowing trip through time, and Vanya begins to feel different without her meds.

episodes.name: The Day That Wasn't
episodes.overview: Sparks fly when Vanya finds her siblings holding an emergency family meeting without her. Five starts his new job at HQ. Cha-Cha faces a dilemma.

episodes.name: The Day That Was
episodes.overview: With a second chance at the day, the siblings team up to find the mysterious "Harold Jenkins." Leonard takes Vanya into the woods to test her powers.

episodes.name: I Heard a Rumor
episodes.overview: As Vanya practices controlling her new abilities, Allison tags along with a local cop to find out what happened outside the restaurant.

episodes.name: Changes
episodes.overview: Vanya veers between shock and despair as she makes a string of unsettling discoveries. A serendipitous development leaves Five at loose ends.

episodes.name: The White Violin
episodes.overview: As a lifetime of secrets and resentment bring the Umbrella Academy crashing down, the Hargreeves siblings realize the worst is still to come.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Blasted back in time to 1960s Dallas, the scattered siblings build new lives for themselves — until a new doomsday threat pulls them back together.

episodes.name: Right Back Where We Started
episodes.overview: After dropping his siblings into an alley in Dallas — in different years — Five scrambles to track them all down and stop a new doomsday threat.

episodes.name: The Frankel Footage
episodes.overview: An incident at the bar leads Luther to Vanya. Five finds an unsettling surprise in the film Hazel left behind. The cops come after Allison's husband.

episodes.name: The Swedish Job
episodes.overview: As the sit-in approaches, Allison reconnects with Klaus, the Swedes chase Vanya into a cornfield, and Luther makes a distressing discovery.

episodes.name: The Majestic 12
episodes.overview: While Allison searches frantically for Ray, Vanya contends with a crisis at the farm, and Five, Diego, and Lila crash a party at the Mexican Consulate.

episodes.name: Valhalla
episodes.overview: Summoned to an emergency meeting, the siblings hatch very different plans for how to spend their last six days on Earth. Lila confronts her mother.

episodes.name: A Light Supper
episodes.overview: Allison gives Ray a peek at her powers, Dave visits Klaus's compound, the Handler offers Five a deal, and the siblings meet their father for dinner.

episodes.name: Öga for Öga
episodes.overview: After Five travels to 1982 to carry out his new mission, the siblings face a flurry of difficult decisions. Carl issues a warning to Vanya.

episodes.name: The Seven Stages
episodes.overview: A desperate Five concocts a risky plan to intercept another version of himself. The FBI tortures Vanya. Diego discovers what causes the apocalypse.
As the Fives plot against each other, one of the siblings makes a big sacrifice to help Vanya, and Lila learns the truth about her parents.

episodes.name: The End of Something
episodes.overview: Reeling from the events at Dealey Plaza, the siblings head to the farm to help save Harlan — only to find themselves drawn into a deadly showdown.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: Back at the Academy, the Umbrellas clash with a new squad of Hargreeves siblings as a mysterious force begins to wreak havoc on the city.

episodes.name: Meet the Family
episodes.overview: After averting a doomsday in Dallas, the Umbrella siblings return to a very different Academy — now ruled by the powerful and hostile Sparrows.

episodes.name: World's Biggest Ball of Twine
episodes.overview: With their Number One missing, the Sparrows take a hostage. Allison makes a painful discovery. Klaus takes Five on an eye-opening road trip.

episodes.name: Pocket Full of Lightning
episodes.overview: As people start disappearing in waves, Five and Lila reluctantly team up to solve their time-travel problem. Klaus sees a new side of his father.

episodes.name: Kugelblitz
episodes.overview: Luther and Sloane hatch a plan to end the war between the families. Viktor reconnects with someone from the past. Five has an unsettling encounter.

episodes.name: Kindest Cut
episodes.overview: Klaus's relationship with death proves more complicated than anyone knew. Viktor finally learns what happened to the Umbrellas' mothers.

episodes.name: Marigold
episodes.overview: Five chases down Pogo, Viktor and Harlan attempt a transfer of powers, and Diego and Lila venture beyond the wall of the White Buffalo Suite.

episodes.name: Auf Wiedersehen
episodes.overview: In 1989, Lila digs up one of her mother's secrets. The families join forces to fight the Kugelblitz. Reginald teaches Klaus to harness his powers.

episodes.name: Wedding at the End of the World
episodes.overview: With the universe collapsing around them, the gang gathers for a day of romance, awkwardness and debauchery at the Hotel Obsidian.

episodes.name: Seven Bells
episodes.overview: Reginald goes all out to convince the children to sign on to his plan. Five tries to recover a drunken memory. Allison has a change of heart.

episodes.name: Oblivion
episodes.overview: Shaken, the family confronts the deadly mysteries of the Hotel Oblivion — and the growing suspicion that their mission is not what it seems.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: Six years after the reset, the powerless Hargreeves clan faces a secret society and learns that the greatest threat to the universe... may be themselves.

episodes.name: The Unbearable Tragedy of Getting What You Want
episodes.overview: The family teams up to find a kidnapped Viktor while attempting to adjust to normal life. Lila and Five probe a mysterious group called the Keepers.

episodes.name: Jean and Gene
episodes.overview: With their powers restored, the gang embarks on a mission to find Sy Grossman's daughter. But they soon encounter hostility in a seemingly quaint town.

episodes.name: The Squid and the Girl
episodes.overview: The group splits up to find Jennifer. Later on, they pay Reginald a visit, confronting memories that hold critical clues to their mission.

episodes.name: The Cleanse
episodes.overview: After learning the truth about Jennifer, the crew sets out to find her and Ben. Klaus hustles to escape his plight. Five and Lila try to change the past.

episodes.name: Six Years, Five Months, and Two Days
episodes.overview: Lila and Five get lost traversing various timelines. Meanwhile, Viktor and Reginald aim to stop Ben, whose union with Jennifer sets forth a lethal path.

episodes.name: End of the Beginning
episodes.overview: With Ben and Jennifer in peril and the Cleanse underway, the family unites for one last fight to save the world — and end the infinite devastation.

shows.ref_name: The War Between the Land and the Sea | *
shows.name: The War Between the Land and the Sea
shows.original_name: The War Between the Land and the Sea
shows.overview: When a fearsome and ancient species emerges from the ocean, dramatically revealing themselves to humanity, an international crisis is triggered. With the entire population at risk, UNIT step into action as the land and sea wage war.

seasons.name: Miniseries
seasons.overview: When a fearsome and ancient species emerges from the ocean, dramatically revealing themselves to humanity, an international crisis is triggered. With the entire population at risk, UNIT step into action as the land and sea wage war.

episodes.name: Homo Aqua
episodes.overview: Barclay’s ordinary life becomes a world of terror when an ancient species rises from the sea. As UNIT fights for control, the summit on the Thames reveals terrifying secrets.

episodes.name: Plastic Apocalypse
episodes.overview: Barclay becomes humanity’s ambassador when the mysterious Salt emerges from the Tank. But his family’s life is torn apart when Salt wreaks revenge upon all mankind.

episodes.name: The Deep
episodes.overview: Barclay makes a terrifying descent into the world of Homo Aqua. Back on the land, Kate stands alone as Downing Street conspires with the army to change the course of the war.

episodes.name: The Witch of the Waterfall
episodes.overview: Barclay and Salt go on the run in a war-torn London as UNIT reels from disaster. But when Tide threatens the land and Gunsberg advances his plans, the Severance schemes demand blood.

episodes.name: The End of the War
episodes.overview: Barclay stands alone, Salt is lost, UNIT is powerless, and the oceans rise as the war reaches its climax. While traitors conspire, can Barclay find Salt before it’s too late?

shows.name: The Wheel of Time
shows.overview: The lives of five young villagers change forever when a strange and powerful woman arrives, claiming one of them is the child of an ancient prophecy with the power to tip the balance between Light and Dark forever. They must choose whether to trust this stranger – and each other – with the fate of the world before the Dark One breaks out of His prison, and the Last Battle begins.

seasons.name: Specials
seasons.overview: The Wheel of Time: Origins, and the aftershow, Inside the Wheel of Time. Origins is a series of animated short films that tell several stories set during the years and centuries before the events of the TV series.

episodes.name: Origin Stories - The Breaking of the World
episodes.overview: See how the male side of the One Power was poisoned by the Dark One and brought about the destruction of the world.

episodes.name: "Look Inside" Episode 1
episodes.overview: Delve deeper into Ep 1 with exclusive behind the scenes interviews with cast and crew.

episodes.name: Origin Stories - The Fall of Manetheren
episodes.overview: The story of King Aemon and the battle against a horde of Trollocs and Fades that ended with his life and the total destruction of Manetheren.

episodes.name: "Look Inside" Episode 2
episodes.overview: Delve deeper into Ep 2 with exclusive behind the scenes interviews with cast and crew.

episodes.name: Origin Stories - The Greatest Warder
episodes.overview: A tale about the greatest warder that ever lived and how his legacy has passed on through time.

episodes.name: "Look Inside" Episode 3
episodes.overview: Delve deeper into Ep 3 with exclusive behind the scenes interviews with cast and crew.

episodes.name: Inside the Wheel of Time: Episode 1 (ft Marcus Rutherford)
episodes.overview: In the inaugural episode of the official The Wheel of Time after-show, The Dusty Wheel’s Matt Hatch welcomes actor Marcus Rutherford to talk about his portrayal of Perrin Aybara. Then, the Inside the Wheel of Time panel breaks down Episodes 1-3, shares their thoughts on where the series is headed, and exclusive behind-the-scenes content.

episodes.name: Origin Stories - Saidin, Saidar, Stone
episodes.overview: A lesson on the difference between the male and female side of channeling and the darkness that separated the two.

episodes.name: "Look Inside" Episode 4
episodes.overview: Delve deeper into Ep 4 with exclusive behind the scenes interviews with cast and crew.

episodes.name: Inside the Wheel of Time: Episode 2 (ft Zoë Robins)
episodes.overview: Matt Hatch welcomes actor Zoë Robins to talk about her portrayal of Two Rivers Wisdom Nynaeve al'Meara. Also, the Inside the Wheel of Time panel breaks down Episode 4 - Logain’s story, the Aes Sedai, and if Mat is someone who can be trusted. Plus - more exclusive behind-the-scenes content.

episodes.name: Origin Stories - The White Tower
episodes.overview: An Aes Sedai takes us through the White Tower to learn about her sisters from the various Ajah's.

episodes.name: "Look Inside" Episode 5
episodes.overview: Delve deeper into Ep 5 with exclusive behind the scenes interviews with cast and crew.

episodes.name: Inside the Wheel of Time: Episode 3 (ft Isis Mussenden)
episodes.overview: Matt Hatch welcomes Costume Designer Isis Mussenden to chat about how she and her team created the look of the show’s unique costumes. Also, the Inside the Wheel of Time panel breaks down Episode 5 - Whitecloaks torture two of our heroes, a fan favorite Ogier is introduced, and shockwaves reverberate through the White Tower.

episodes.name: Origin Stories - An Ogier’s Longing
episodes.overview: The story of an Ogier treesings his stedding into the world and takes us on a journey through time to understand the lives they lead.

episodes.name: "Look Inside" Episode 6
episodes.overview: Delve deeper into Ep 6 with exclusive behind the scenes interviews with cast and crew.

episodes.name: Inside the Wheel of Time: Episode 4 (ft Daniel Henney)
episodes.overview: Daniel Henney joins Matt to talk about stepping into the boots of Lan Mandragoran. Also, the Inside the Wheel of Time panel breaks down Episode 6 - White Tower politics lead to Moiraine’s exile, our Two Rivers friends are reunited, and the Dark One stirs at the Eye of the World.

episodes.name: "Look Inside" Episode 7
episodes.overview: Delve deeper into Ep 7 with exclusive behind the scenes interviews with cast and crew.

episodes.name: Inside the Wheel of Time: Episode 5 (ft Nick Dudman & Julian Parry)
episodes.overview: Matt and the panel break down Episode 7 of The Wheel of Time - an epic battle on the slopes of Dragonmount, the group escapes the Black Wind, and Min shares her viewings. Then we go behind the scenes and speak to Make-Up Effects Designer Nick Dudman and Visual Effects Supervisor Julian Parry for exclusive interviews about how the world of The Wheel of Time was created.

episodes.name: "Look Inside" Episode 8
episodes.overview: Delve deeper into Ep 8 with exclusive behind the scenes interviews with cast and crew.

episodes.name: Inside the Wheel of Time: Episode 6 (ft Madeleine Madden)
episodes.overview: We break down the Season One finale of The Wheel of Time. Matt is joined by Madeleine Madden and other special guests. Egwene and Nynaeve unlock their power,  Trollocs march into battle, and Rand faces a showdown with the Dark One. Plus exclusive behind the scenes content about the making of the world of The Wheel of Time.

episodes.name: The Making of the Winternight Sequence
episodes.overview: The Winternight Sequence is one of the wildest scenes in Wheel of Time, see how the cast and crew worked their magic and brought this scene to the screen.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: The lives of five young villagers change forever when a strange and powerful woman arrives, claiming one of them is the child of an ancient prophecy with the power to tip the balance between Light and Dark forever. They must choose whether to trust this stranger – and each other – with the fate of the world before the Dark One breaks out of His prison, and the Last Battle begins.

episodes.name: Leavetaking
episodes.overview: A strange noblewoman arrives in a remote mountain village, claiming one of five youths is the reincarnation of an ancient power who once destroyed the world – and will do so again, if she’s not able to discover which of them it is. But they all have less time than they think.

episodes.name: Shadow's Waiting
episodes.overview: Moiraine and Lan lead the four villagers to safety, unsure which is the one from the prophecy. But the friends are equally unsure about their rescuers, especially once they see how far Moiraine is willing to go for her mission – and how far astray Lan is willing to lead them.

episodes.name: A Place of Safety
episodes.overview: Moiraine and Lan find help in an unexpected – and unwanted – quarter, as the separated villagers try to find their way back to each other, or at least to refuge. But they all soon learn how far the Dark One’s reach extends, and how few they can trust on the road.

episodes.name: The Dragon Reborn
episodes.overview: Moiraine struggles with uncertainty while Lan struggles with their new companion. Rand wonders about Mat and Mat starts to wonder at himself. Egwene and Perrin take their first steps down a different path. An incredible new power is unleashed on the world.

episodes.name: Blood Calls Blood
episodes.overview: Perrin and Egwene run into a familiar face. Mat and Rand see strange ones. Moiraine and Lan mourn their loss.

episodes.name: The Flame of Tar Valon
episodes.overview: Moiraine faces the consequences of her actions. Mat faces the darkness in himself. Egwene faces the most powerful woman in the world.

episodes.name: The Dark Along the Ways
episodes.overview: Moiraine and her charges are diverted from their path by an unexpected encounter. This diversion, though, reveals many things — Moiraine’s true goal, Lan’s past, the fractures that have grown in the group, and the identity of the Dragon Reborn.

episodes.name: The Eye of the World
episodes.overview: For twenty years, Moiraine has dreamed and worked towards this moment. But she can't stop the Dragon Reborn from seeing the appeal of the Dark.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Though Rand thought he destroyed the Dark One, evil is not gone from the world. Threats new and very old seek out the young friends from the Two Rivers, now scattered over the world. The woman who found and guided them is now powerless to help, and so they must find other sources of strength. In each other, or themselves. In the Light... or the Dark.

episodes.name: A Taste of Solitude
episodes.overview: Moiraine, Lan, Nynaeve, Egwene, Perrin, and Mat find themselves more alone than ever.

episodes.name: Strangers and Friends
episodes.overview: The Two Rivers youths forge new relationships, while Lan tries to mend an old one.

episodes.name: What Might Be
episodes.overview: Nynaeve faces her greatest fears. Rand seeks guidance on his powers from an unexpected source.

episodes.name: Daughter of the Night
episodes.overview: Moiraine searches for Rand while Nynaeve mourns her losses.

episodes.name: Damane
episodes.overview: Moiraine and Rand flee for their lives. Egwene and Nynaeve encounter a new foe.

episodes.name: Eyes Without Pity
episodes.overview: Rand makes a risky alliance and Egwene gathers her strength to confront the horror of her circumstances.

episodes.name: Daes Dae'Mar
episodes.overview: A familiar face foils Moiraine and Rand's plans.

episodes.name: What Was Meant to Be
episodes.overview: Fate leads Rand and the others to an inevitable showdown with their most formidable enemies yet.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: With the Forsaken loose in the world, the heroes of the Light must chart their own courses and muster hidden strengths as they face the Darkness within themselves.

episodes.name: To Race the Shadow
episodes.overview: Chaos erupts within the White Tower as our heroes become targets of a new evil.

episodes.name: A Question of Crimson
episodes.overview: A dangerous visitor comes to the White Tower. Perrin returns home. Rand and Egwene forge their own path under Moiraine’s watchful eye.

episodes.name: Seeds of Shadow
episodes.overview: Nynaeve and Elayne are given a deadly mission. Perrin learns the consequences of his rage. Lanfear begins to play a dangerous game.

episodes.name: The Road to the Spear
episodes.overview: Rand faces the forgotten history of his family as Moiraine learns the devastating truth of her future.

episodes.name: Tel'aran'rhiod
episodes.overview: Egwene learns Rand's dark secret. Perrin stages a daring rescue. Nynaeve, Elayne, Mat, and Min hunt the Black Ajah.

episodes.name: The Shadow in the Night
episodes.overview: Tensions flare between Egwene and Rand. Moiraine and Lan come to terms with their destiny.

episodes.name: Goldeneyes
episodes.overview: Perrin begins to embrace his role as a leader among the people of the Two Rivers.

episodes.name: He Who Comes with the Dawn
episodes.overview: Nynaeve, Elayne, Mat, and Min confront the Black Ajah and their futures. Moiraine and Lan prepare to face their fate. Rand and Egwene set their destinies in motion.

shows.name: The White Lotus
shows.overview: Follow the exploits of various guests and employees at an exclusive tropical resort over the span of a week as with each passing day, a darker complexity emerges in these picture-perfect travelers, the hotel’s cheerful employees and the idyllic locale itself.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: First season follows the vacations of various hotel guests over the span of a week as they relax and rejuvenate in paradise. But with each passing day, a darker complexity emerges in these picture-perfect travelers, the hotel’s cheerful employees and the idyllic locale itself.

episodes.name: Arrivals
episodes.overview: As a new wave of guests arrive at the White Lotus, resort manager Armond tries to assuage an unreasonable Shane and his easy-going new wife Rachel, while spa director Belinda calms a grieving Tanya. Meanwhile, Nicole suggests her husband Mark distract himself from a health scare by spending time with their son Quinn, who’s been cast out by his sister Olivia and her friend Paula.

episodes.name: New Day
episodes.overview: A cautiously optimistic Belinda walks a fine line with Tanya, while Armond brainstorms ways to deal with Shane. After her husband belittles her work, Rachel approaches Nicole for advice. Paula and Olivia lose track of their stash, while a revived Mark attempts to connect with Quinn.

episodes.name: Mysterious Monkeys
episodes.overview: Stripped of his gadgets, Quinn reluctantly takes a scuba class with Mark, who’s struggling to process revelations regarding his late father. Hoping to reignite the spark with Rachel, Shane enlists Armond to help plan a romantic evening. Tanya leans on Belinda for support as she scatters her mother’s ashes at sea. Paula keeps a secret from a suspicious Olivia.

episodes.name: Recentering
episodes.overview: After Shane shoots down her latest career plans, Rachel is further blindsided by an unexpected arrival. Just as Belinda begins to take her business proposition seriously, Tanya’s attention turns to an intriguing hotel guest. Meanwhile, Armond’s renewed commitment to sobriety is put to the test.

episodes.name: The Lotus-Eaters
episodes.overview: As Armond attempts to do damage control, Belinda tries to redirect Tanya’s focus to her business proposal. Paula grows increasingly disillusioned with the Mossbachers. A sidelined Rachel begins to question her future. Nicole rebuffs Mark for airing their dirty laundry to Quinn.

episodes.name: Departures
episodes.overview: Rachel shares some harsh truths with Shane and confides in Belinda, who’s reeling from bad news of her own. As the Mossbachers turn the page on their harrowing scare, Quinn reveals major life plans. With nothing left to lose, Armond goes on an all-out bender – and exacts the ultimate revenge on his nemesis.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Set at an exclusive Sicilian resort, follow the exploits of various guests and employees over the span of a week.

episodes.name: Ciao
episodes.overview: Two couples navigate awkwardness, an Italian American family deals with a conspicuous absence, and Tanya arrives with her new assistant.

episodes.name: Italian Dream
episodes.overview: Tanya enlists Greg to help her live out her perfect Sicilian day. Harper questions Cameron and Daphne’s claims about their marriage.

episodes.name: Bull Elephants
episodes.overview: While Daphne loops Harper into an off-resort excursion, Ethan and Cameron get in some bro time. Tanya seeks advice from a tarot reader.

episodes.name: In the Sandbox
episodes.overview: Tanya and Portia spend a day with charming ex-pats Quentin and Jack. Harper is blindsided by shocking evidence from Ethan’s night out.

episodes.name: That's Amore
episodes.overview: Tanya and Portia embark on a whirlwind excursion with Quentin and Jack. Unsure what to believe, Harper gets real with Cam and Daphne.

episodes.name: Abductions
episodes.overview: Ethan grows suspicious of Cam. Tanya gives Portia an opaque warning about Jack. Lucia helps the Di Grassos search for long-lost relatives.

episodes.name: Arrivederci
episodes.overview: Albie asks Dominic for a karmic payment to help Lucia. Tanya grows wary of Quentin’s motives. Ethan confronts Cam.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: Set at a luxurious wellness resort in Thailand, the lives of wealthy guests and dedicated staff intertwine in unexpected ways. The season explores themes of privilege, personal transformation, and cultural contrasts, all set against the backdrop of stunning locales and intricate social dynamics.

episodes.name: Same Spirits, New Forms
episodes.overview: As a new round of guests arrives at the White Lotus Thailand, Belinda settles in, Chelsea deals with a moody Rick, the Ratliffs go separate ways, and Kate, Laurie, and Jaclyn kick off a girls' trip.

episodes.name: Special Treatments
episodes.overview: Timothy gets distressing updates about his business, Chelsea connects with expat Chloe, and Gaitok shares his feelings with Mook.

episodes.name: The Meaning of Dreams
episodes.overview: Jaclyn pushes the idea of a vacation fling on Laurie. Chelsea finds herself in a perilous situation. Gaitok worries about a reprimand.

episodes.name: Hide or Seek
episodes.overview: Jaclyn looks for a different scene. Piper asks for Lochlan's support before sharing a life update. Chelsea finally gets Rick to open up.

episodes.name: Full-Moon Party
episodes.overview: As things get wild during the Full Moon festivities, Rick visits an old friend, and Belinda shares her suspicions about a hotel guest.

episodes.name: Denials
episodes.overview: In the wake of the festivities, Laurie finds herself feeling deceived by Jaclyn, while Saxon tries to bury what happened the night before.

episodes.name: Killer Instincts
episodes.overview: Belinda brings Zion to Chloe’s expat party. Saxon confronts Tim about how strange he’s been acting. Gaitok and Mook have their first date.

episodes.name: Amor Fati
episodes.overview: Laurie, Jaclyn, and Kate reckon with their friendship. Timothy comes up with a shocking plan for his family. Belinda considers a deal.

shows.overview: The fantastic adventures of a plucky literary girl and her friends.

shows.name: Upload
shows.overview: In 2033, people who are near death can be “uploaded” into virtual reality hotels run by 6 tech firms. Cash-strapped Nora lives in Brooklyn and works customer service for the luxurious “Lakeview” digital afterlife. When L.A. party-boy/coder Nathan’s self-driving car crashes, his high-maintenance girlfriend uploads him permanently into Nora’s VR world.

episodes.name: Welcome to Upload
episodes.overview: After a self-driving car crash, Nathan is uploaded to Lakeview, his girlfriend’s family’s digital after-life, where he meets his customer service rep, Nora.

episodes.name: Five Stars
episodes.overview: Nora tries to get her ratings up, so her boss will approve her dad’s upload loan. Nathan acclimates to his new world with the help of a Lakeview therapist.

episodes.name: The Funeral
episodes.overview: Scientists attempt to download a consciousness back into a clone body. Nathan attends his own funeral and Nora uncovers a mystery surrounding his death.

episodes.name: The Sex Suit
episodes.overview: Nora thinks she may have misjudged Nathan. Nathan and his girlfriend Ingrid are interviewed about the challenges of romance between a living person and an Upload.

episodes.name: The Grey Market
episodes.overview: Nora’s Dad’s vape lung worsens while Nathan, his friend Luke, and Dylan, an uploaded teen whose body is not keeping up with his age, visit a hacker’s market in cyberspace.

episodes.name: The Sleepover
episodes.overview: Nathan is thrown when Nora goes on a Nitely date. Ingrid invites Nathan’s niece for a sleepover. Nathan and Nora suspect his damaged memories may lead to a greater conspiracy. Luke gets into a fight with Aleesha.

episodes.name: Bring Your Dad to Work Day
episodes.overview: Nathan takes Nora’s dad on a do-or-die upload decision tour, but things go awry when Luddites sabotage Lakeview. Nora does some sleuthing on Lucy’s computer in the confusion.

episodes.name: Shopping Other Digital After-Lives
episodes.overview: After a surprising revelation, Nathan shops for a new digital after-life. Nora travels to LA to help Ingrid stop him from leaving Lakeview.

episodes.name: Update Eve
episodes.overview: The Uploads are looking forward to the improvements in the new Lakeview Operating System. Nathan and Nora stay up late to recover Nathan’s missing memories.

episodes.name: Freeyond
episodes.overview: Nathan’s restored memories and shifting emotional allegiances put Nora in physical danger.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Nathan is at a crossroads in his (after) life… his ex-girlfriend Ingrid has unexpectedly arrived to Lakeview hoping to strengthen their relationship, but his heart still secretly yearns for his customer service angel Nora. Meanwhile Nora is off the grid and involved with the anti-tech rebel group “The Ludds.”

episodes.name: Welcome Back, Mr. Brown
episodes.overview: While living with Ingrid, Nathan searches for Nora, who has fled off the grid.

episodes.name: Dinner Party
episodes.overview: At a status-obsessed dinner, Nathan faces ghosts from his past. Nora flexes her programming skills as she steps into activism.

episodes.name: Robin Hood
episodes.overview: Frustrated with the inequities at Lakeview, Nathan and Luke decide to redistribute some wealth with Ingrid's unwitting help. Nora undertakes a secretive mission.

episodes.name: Family Day
episodes.overview: Nora's loyalties are stressed as she is called upon to take revolutionary action. Nathan's visiting family prompts him to consider what he wants out of his afterlife. Luke invents a new sport.

episodes.name: Mind Frisk
episodes.overview: Nathan and Nora race to stop a potentially dangerous technological advance. Luke boycotts sleep when he finds Horizen is profiting from his dreams, as Aleesha continues to rise in the Horizen hierarchy. Ingrid is tempted by a new tech offering: digital babies.

episodes.name: The Outing
episodes.overview: Nora and Aleesha pursue the mystery into New York City with Nathan and Luke along on screens. Ingrid receives unexpected visitors.

episodes.name: Download
episodes.overview: Nora rallies the support of unlikely allies and Hyperloops to LA. Meanwhile, the issues in Nathan's personal life come to a head.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: Nora and a freshly downloaded Nathan navigate their relationship while racing to stop the mysterious conspiracy that threatens to destroy millions of lives.

episodes.name: Ticking Clock
episodes.overview: Nora and a recently downloaded Nathan race to stop Freeyond before his head explodes.

episodes.name: Strawberry
episodes.overview: Nathan and Nora struggle to make their relationship work, while Ingrid tries to make the best of her second shot at love.

episodes.name: CyberDiscountDay
episodes.overview: The gang celebrates CyberDiscountDay while Nora discovers something game-changing: Nathan has been copied in Lakeview.

episodes.name: Download Doctor
episodes.overview: Nathan and Nora track down the doctor who invented download, while Aleesha rises higher in the Horizen hierarchy. Ingrid and back-up Nathan grow closer.

episodes.name: Rescue Mission
episodes.overview: Nathan teams up with his own copy to save Luke, but Nora is discovered by the conspiracy.

episodes.name: Memory Crackers
episodes.overview: Nora and Nathan find important clues to expose Freeyond, but the search poses a challenge to their relationship.

episodes.name: Upload Day
episodes.overview: Nathan and Nora try to have a special last day together.

episodes.name: Flesh and Blood
episodes.overview: Nora takes the powerful Upload companies to court, but she may have bitten off more than she can chew.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: In the four-part series finale event, sentient AI rapidly turns evil, threatening to wipe out Lakeview (and the world!). On top of greedy executives, lingering mysteries, plus heartbreak in VR and IRL, our characters are tested like never before. The only way they can get through it all and save humanity from deletion is by teaming up one last time.

episodes.name: Wedding Weekend
episodes.overview: One Nathan celebrates a bitter-sweet wedding, but things are not what they seem and questions of sanity and religious faith are raised. A lonely AI Guy searches for romance. Aleesha prepares for her new responsibilities while Luke agonizes over their kiss back in Lakeview.

episodes.name: Workload
episodes.overview: The bride and groom save up for their honeymoon. Horizen-Betta debuts a new, money-making technology. Luke tries to enjoy his job at Workload, and the AI Elevator Operator splits off an AI Girl and falls head over heels.

episodes.name: Spa Day
episodes.overview: While on their honeymoon, the newlyweds uncover a dark secret. Luke and the AI Gardener head back into the Grey Zone on a rescue mission. Aleesha reveals surprising abilities and Nora and Ingrid share clues.

episodes.name: Mile End
episodes.overview: The residents of Lakeview race to find justice, revenge and peace as the digital and real worlds collide.

shows.name: Watson
shows.overview: A year after the death of his friend and partner Sherlock Holmes at the hands of Moriarty, Dr. John Watson resumes his medical career as the head of a clinic dedicated to treating rare disorders. However, he soon finds that his old life is not done with him yet.

episodes.name: Pilot
episodes.overview: Dr. John Watson resumes his medical career as the head of a clinic dedicated to treating rare disorders six months after the death of his friend and partner, Sherlock Holmes, at the hands of Moriarty.

episodes.name: Redcoat
episodes.overview: Watson and the fellows investigate the perplexing case of a family man with a bullet lodged in his head who insists he is a Scottish soldier and seems to be hiding something nefarious.

episodes.name: Wait for the Punchline
episodes.overview: Watson and the fellows treat a comedian who collapses at an open mic night, but throughout the case her past is revealed to be much more complex than initially believed.

episodes.name: Patient Question Mark
episodes.overview: When Sasha discovers a link between her current patient, who has advanced cancers and distinctive lesions on his tongue indicative of Cowden syndrome, and a cadaver she dissected during medical school, the team traces the case to Amish country.

episodes.name: The Man with the Glowing Chest
episodes.overview: Watson takes a major ethical risk when he decides to treat a sickle cell patient with an unorthodox surgery, and the team faces their own dilemma when they must decide whether to look the other way or help the young woman.

episodes.name: The Camgirl Inquiry
episodes.overview: Stephens musters the courage to ask Watson to help him when his camgirl suddenly collapses during a video call. He does not know anything about her real life, so the team must act quickly to locate her before it's too late.

episodes.name: Teeth Marks
episodes.overview: While Watson and the team help a woman whose memory resets every three minutes, Watson struggles with auditory hallucinations and questions whether someone is behind his current decline. Also, Moriarty plots his next move.

episodes.name: A Variant of Unknown Significance
episodes.overview: Watson runs into brilliant con artist and an old friend of Sherlock Holmes, Irene Adler, when her son Angus is admitted to UHOP for temporary paralysis. The fellows help Watson after he grows fond of Angus and pursue various leads to find a cure to his illness.

episodes.name: Take a Family History
episodes.overview: Ingrid's lies come back to haunt her when her sister Gigi needs to be treated by the team after she develops side effects to the secret treatments Ingrid put her through. Also, Watson and Mary bond over a tragedy.

episodes.name: The Man with the Alien Hand
episodes.overview: Watson is thrown into a detective case when he is unsure whether the patient he is treating for one of the most rare ailments in the world, Alien Hand Syndrome, is guilty of pushing his brother in front of a bus to his death.

episodes.name: The Dark Day Deduction
episodes.overview: Watson confronts a traumatic event from his Army days that still weighs heavily on him when his Army veteran friend’s wife reaches out begging for help when her husband is seemingly having a psychotic break. Meanwhile, Shinwell is asked for one last favor by Moriarty.

episodes.name: My Life's Work (1)
episodes.overview: When part of the team falls ill after becoming targets of a sinister plot, it becomes an all-hands-on-deck situation to save them before it's too late. Meanwhile, Watson announces a new ambitious project that he has been working on.

episodes.name: My Life's Work (2)
episodes.overview: Watson and the team are faced with an impossible choice when two lives hang in the balance, but they only have one vial of antidote available. Meanwhile, Shinwell races to help the team, and Watson goes head to head with Moriarty.

episodes.name: A Son in the Oven
episodes.overview: Watson and the fellows spring back into action when Mary’s mother accidentally poisons herself while suffering from a rare form of dementia that is progressing with impossible speed. Meanwhile, Sherlock Holmes resurfaces after being presumed dead.

episodes.name: Back from the Dead
episodes.overview: A microbiology researcher returns from an expedition to Siberia, leading to a possible outbreak of a revived pathogen. Watson reconnects with Sherlock Holmes.

episodes.name: Expletive Deleted
episodes.overview: Watson and the team work alongside Laila to help a patient named Maxine, a 30-year-old who looks 10 years old.

episodes.name: Happy When It Rains
episodes.overview: Watson and the team jump into action when four new patients are brought to UHOP with wounds that appear to be infected with a flesh-eating bacterium following a tornado. Meanwhile, Shinwell searches for meaning as a nursing student and Adam’s wedding to Lauren risks being halted.

episodes.name: Lucky
episodes.overview: While visiting another hospital, Watson becomes convinced that a coma patient is suffering from locked-in syndrome and has been mistaken for a coma patient for over a decade. After the patient is transferred to UHOP for treatment, he shocks the team with chilling messages. Meanwhile, Sherlock is back in town and is staying with Watson.

episodes.name: Buying Time
episodes.overview: Watson and the fellows race against time to save the life of Xavier, a 21-year-old athlete with a fast-growing, seemingly incurable cancer. Meanwhile, Mycroft Holmes lets Watson know his team’s work at UHOP may no longer have funding available.

episodes.name: Giant Steps
episodes.overview: Watson's father, Hamish, visits UHOP to introduce Watson and the fellows to his protégé, Annabelle, a saxophone prodigy with musically induced blackouts. As Annabelle's condition worsens, Watson must confront his long-standing tensions with his father in order to save her.

episodes.name: Livvy Sees the Doctor
episodes.overview: UHOP veers into terror when Watson and the fellows are taken hostage by a man with a bomb strapped to his chest who is desperate to find a cure for his 9-year-old daughter’s illness.

episodes.name: Shannon Says Bex Loves Micah
episodes.overview: Watson and the fellows help Laila’s son Micah – who was injured in a car accident while pursuing his crush, Bex, with the help of his AI chatbot.

episodes.name: Never Been CRISPR'd
episodes.overview: Watson’s biohacker friend Hobie returns when he rushes his new girlfriend to the Holmes Clinic after they partake in a gene-editing experiment that goes wrong. Meanwhile, Watson becomes suspicious of Sherlock.

shows.name: Wednesday
shows.overview: Smart, sarcastic and a little dead inside, Wednesday Addams investigates twisted mysteries while making new friends — and foes — at Nevermore Academy.

episodes.name: Wednesday's Child Is Full of Woe
episodes.overview: When a deliciously wicked prank gets Wednesday expelled, her parents ship her off to Nevermore Academy, the boarding school where they fell in love.

episodes.name: Woe Is the Loneliest Number
episodes.overview: The sheriff questions Wednesday about the night's strange happenings. Later, Wednesday faces off against a fierce rival in the cutthroat Poe Cup race.

episodes.name: Friend or Woe
episodes.overview: Wednesday stumbles on a secret society. During Outreach Day, Nevermore's outcasts mingle with Jericho's normies in Pilgrim World. Fudge, anyone?

episodes.name: Woe What a Night
episodes.overview: Wednesday asks Xavier to the Rave'N dance, sparking Tyler's jealousy — but Thing's got something up his sleeve. Meanwhile, Eugene stakes out the cave.

episodes.name: You Reap What You Woe
episodes.overview: During Parents Weekend, Wednesday digs into her family's past — and accidentally gets her dad arrested. Enid feels the pressure to "wolf out."

episodes.name: Quid Pro Woe
episodes.overview: Wednesday's friends throw her a surprise birthday party. They mean well... but she'd much rather mark the miserable occasion by solving the murders.

episodes.name: If You Don't Woe Me by Now
episodes.overview: Kooky Uncle Fester pays a visit and shares his theory about the monster. Wednesday begrudgingly agrees to a date with Tyler at Crackstone's crypt.

episodes.name: A Murder of Woes
episodes.overview: Wednesday lands in trouble with Principal Weems, but that's just the start of her problems. To fight an ancient evil, she'll need all her friends’ help.

episodes.name: Here We Woe Again
episodes.overview: After a productive summer break, Wednesday returns to Nevermore as a grudging campus celebrity — and the target of a dangerous stalker.

episodes.name: The Devil You Woe
episodes.overview: Chaos reigns on campus as Nevermore celebrates its annual Prank Day. Wednesday confronts an old enemy and gains an unwanted ally.

episodes.name: Call of the Woe
episodes.overview: Stripped of both her ability and Goody's book, Wednesday is forced to do some old-fashioned detective work on a school camping trip.

episodes.name: If These Woes Could Talk
episodes.overview: It's an Addams family investigation as Fester and Thing commit themselves to Wednesday's case. Trying to conceal one secret, Bianca stumbles on another.

episodes.name: Hyde and Woe Seek
episodes.overview: With Tyler on the loose, Wednesday readies for a risky Día de los Muertos showdown. Slurp's growing hunger poses problems for Pugsley.

episodes.name: Woe Thyself
episodes.overview: An encounter with a spirit from Nevermore's past gives Wednesday and Enid a new perspective on one another — and puts one of their classmates in danger.

episodes.name: Woe Me the Money
episodes.overview: As the school gala looms, Wednesday digs up dirt on Dort, Enid tries not to wolf out and Morticia engages in a battle of wills with Grandmama.

episodes.name: This Means Woe
episodes.overview: When buried family secrets are unearthed, Wednesday must race against time to prevent a dark prophecy from being realized.

shows.name: What We Do in the Shadows
shows.original_name: What We Do in the Shadows
shows.overview: A documentary-style look into the daily (or rather, nightly) lives of a group of vampires in Staten Island who have “lived” together for hundreds and hundreds of years.

episodes.name: After the Shadows Ep. 1 - Kristen Schaal
episodes.overview: For the very first episode of After the Shadows, Harvey Guillen welcomes Kristen Schaal! The two celebrate the return of the show and Kristen’s character, The Guide.

episodes.name: After the Shadows Ep. 2 - Kayvan Novak and Aida Turturro
episodes.overview: Season 3 episode 3 had a LOT going on - a roller coaster of emotions, heartbreak, a rivalry kickball game, and web design. Harvey Guillen welcomes Kayvan Novak and ﻿Aida Turturro to ﻿﻿﻿reminisce about filming the episode and more!

episodes.name: After the Shadows Ep. 3 - Shayne Fox
episodes.overview: Half-mermaid, half-monkey. Anything is possible in the world of What We Do in the Shadows. In this special episode of After The Shadows, Harvey Guillen takes us behind the scenes and into the brilliant mind of Production Designer, Shayne Fox!

episodes.name: After the Shadows Ep. 4 - Anthony Antranik & Marissa Jaret Winokur
episodes.overview: Harvey Guillen welcomes your favorite Staten Island next door neighbors for some fun.

episodes.name: After the Shadows Ep.5 - Doug Jones
episodes.overview: Just when you thought he was gone, we brought him back AGAIN for After the Shadows. Tune in for this very special episode featuring your favorite burnt, crispy vampire.

episodes.name: After the Shadows Ep.6 - Prosthetic Makeup Designer
episodes.overview: On this episode, you don't just go behind the scenes, you go behind the make-up and into the talented mind of Paul Jones, What We Do in the Shadows' Prosthetic Makeup Designer!

episodes.name: After the Shadows Ep. 7 - Cree Summer
episodes.overview: She puts the U in cult. On this episode, Harvey is joined by the very talented, very hilarious, very persuasive Cree Summer.

episodes.name: After the Shadows Ep. 8: Costumer Designer Laura Montgomery
episodes.overview: Harvey Guillen interviews the powerhouse behind all the wardrobe, costume designer Laura Montgomery.

episodes.name: After the Shadows | Season 3 Finale With Paul Simms
episodes.overview: Relationships, realizations, and really heavy moments, oh my! Showrunner, Executive Producer & Writer Paul Simms and Harvey Guillén are diving into it all.
